(brjod bya)/ra༅༅//'og min a rgyan smin grol gling gi gdan rabs mkhan brgyud rim par byon pa rnams kyi rnam par thar pa/smin gling rtsom sgrig lhan tshogs nas gtan 'bebs nus/'phrul yig phab bsgyur sde tshan nanu/ ma phyi gsar du bskrun/snga 'gyur mtho slob mdo rgyud legs bshad gling 'dus spyi nas 'don spepa zhus/ston pa 'i 'das lo 22 phyi lo 2002

(gleng brjod)/tsha/ 'og min a rgyan smin grol gling nges pa don gyi dga' ba'i tshal chen po'i gdan rabs mkhan brgyud rnams kyi rnam par thar pa 'di ni/ smin gling rtsom sgrig lhan tshogs nas drag po lcags 'grug gi lo'i sa zla'i yar tshes bzang por 7skyabs rje smin gling khri chen rin po che mjal zhu dang 'brel rtsom sgrig lhan tshogs gsar du btsugs te/ dus babs dgos gal la dmigs pa'i gsung rab deb ther ci rigs 'don spel gnang rgyu'i 'char bkod mdzad pa ltar/ thog mar smin gling gdan rabs kyi rim pa ji ltar 'byung ba'i tshul la/ yongs grags sminagling sku mched dang /rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ sras mo mi 'gyur dpal sgron/ pad+ma 'gyur med rgya mcho tsam las/ gdan rabs gzhan gyi rnam thar zhib gsal ma rnyed par yun ring 'tshol rtog byas par 'gor/ de nas rim bzhin zur gsal dgrad gzhi'i yig cha khag gcig dang / gsung gros lhad med 'ga' zhig yig thog tu btsud de zin bris mthud ka btab/ mthar 'bras lta bur sna tshogs zhes pa chu pho rta'i lo'i sa zla'i tshes bco lnga nas zhu bcos phab bsgyur thog 'gal 'du nyam song dang 'ol tshod bshad pa rgyun 'byums su ma shor bar mkhas blun kun gyi gzigs bde bklag chog tu sprel zla'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes bcu la re zhig rdzogs par byas so/ //

(stod gzhi deb ther)/ḍi/ gter chen chos kyi rgyal po'i phyi rnam dad pa'i shing rta dang nang rnam yon tan mtha' yas/she) le chen chos dpal rgya mtsho'i rnam thar bden gtam rna ba'i bdud rtsi/sheg rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal gyi rnam thar skal bzang gdung sel/4) rje ba.oṃ mi 'gyur dpal sgron gyi rnam thar dad pa'i gdung sel//) rdzogs chen bzhi pa mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje'i dngos slob mkhas pa gu ru bkra shis kyis mdzad pa'i snga 'gyur chos 'byung mkhas pa dga' byed ngo mtshar gtam gyi rol masnang/7) mkhyen brtse'od gsal mdo sngags gling pa'i gsung thor bu/she) 7skyabs rje bdud 'joms 'jigs bral ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa'i snga 'gyur chos 'byung lha dbang g.yul rgyal dang pad gling 'khrungs rabs kyi kha steng mos pa'i ze'u 'gru/she) mkhan brgyud rnam thar nyung gsal sgron me'i kha skong nges shes 'drenapa'i pho nya/7) smyo shul mkhan po 'jam dbyangs rdo rjes mdzad pa'i rdzogs chen chos 'byung nor bu baiḍūr+ya'i 'phreng ba/1ge) 'u yug pa bstan pa'i sgron mes mdzad pa'i smin gling dkar chag ngo mtshar shel gyi a dar+sha rnams so/

tsa/ dkar chas shag grangs/shen mchod brdzod 1) gleng gzhi 3she) rigs kyi che ba 94) spyi don rdzo/) chos rgyal rat+na gling pa 21ke rig 'dzin pad+ma gling pa 247) sprul sku sna tshogs rang grol 28she) sprul sku bstan 'dzin grags pa 32bla) mkhas grub mdo sngags bstan 'dzin 361ge) gsang bdag phrin las lhun grub 401she) lha 'dzin dbyangs phywa sgrol ma 44tsha/ khri rabs 1she) khri rabs dang po a rgyan gter bdas gling pa snyo1she) khri rabs gnyis pa pad+ma 'gyur med rgya mcho 7414) rje ba.oṃ mi 'gyur dpal sgron 79

1/) khri rabs gsum pa rgyal sras rin za rnam rgyal 95 51tshe) khri rabs bzhi pa 'gyur med pad+ma bstan lon 10317) khri rabs lnga pa 'gyur med phrin las rnam rgyal 1071she) khri rabs drug pa 'gyur med pad+ma dbang rgyal 10917) rje btsun phrin las chos sgron 1112ge) khri rabs bdun pa 'gyur med sangs rgyas kun dga' 1'a2)) khri rabs brgyad pa 'gyur med yid bzhin dbang rgyal 1152she) khri rabs dgu pa 'gyur med bde r+sā mchog grub 1172she) khri rabs bcu pa 'gyur med don grub dbang rgyal 11924) bdud lngoms 'jigs bral ye shes r+sā 1212/) khri rabs bcu gcig pa 'gyur med kun bzang dbang rgyal 'a07/ mkhan rabs/2skye) mkhan rabs dang po rgyal sras bstan pa'i nyi ma 'a627) mkhan rabs gnyis pa lo chen 7 shrī d+ku82she) 'bas drung yid bzhin legs grub 15727) rab 'byums pa a rgyan chos grags 159rashe) rab 'byams pa a rgyan dpal mgon 162

5 7na/ slob dpon bkra shis rgya mtsho 1'anishe) mkhan rabs gsum pa a rgyan bstan 'dzin rdo rje 168rashe) mkhan rabs bzhi pa gsang sngags bstan 'dzin 70sna4) mkhan rabs lnga pa a rgyan chos 'phel 171ra/) mkhan rabs drug pa rig 'dzin bzang po 1྾37) mkhan rabs bdun pa kun dga' tshul khrims rdo rje 17537) mkhan r+sā wom dpal bde ba'i nyi ma 76ni) rngor 'an mkhan po ngag dbang nor bu 179spyo) matso rabs brgyad pa ngas dbang malga brtsenor bu sa04ge) gcung rin po che ngag dbang chos grags 1854rko zhwa di'u 'khrul zhig rin po che sa74she) mkhan rabasadagu pa ngag dbang mkhyen rab rgya mcho 1904she) mjug byang 194

mchod brngod 1ra༅༅/ /'og min a rgyan smin grol gling gi gdan rabs mkhan brgyud rim par byon pa rnams kyi rnam thar g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i dga' ston zhes bya ba/ra༅༅/ /gdod nas 'og min gnas su byang chub kyang / /mtha' yas 'gro khams dong nas sprugs pa'i phyir/ /rnam thar 'dzad med gaṅgā'i klung bzhin pu /ston mdzad nyi ma'i gnyen la gus phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje snying po tshangs pa rnga sgra dang / /tshangs chen bskal ba rgya mtshor zhing kun tu/ /rang byung sku lnga lhun grub spyi dpal che/ /a rgyan rdo rje 'chang la rtag tu bsgen/ /raba'abyams gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i pha mthar son/ /mkhas grub bye ba'i dbus na ri dbang ltar/ /zab rgyas chos kyi ba gam lhun chags pa / r+ṣang zom chos kyi bzang pos 'gro 'di skyongs/ /rgyal kun mkhyen rab ye shes rab rdzogs shing / /phul byung rgyal sras spyod la dbang bsgyur ba/ /gsang chen bsnan pa'i shing rta med po che/ /tshul khrims blo gros zhabs la phyag bgyi'o/ /myos kyi rigs 'khrungs mi yi seng ge gang / /zab gter mnga' bdag gu ru'i 'al skyin nga/ngos/ stsoles las rnam rgyal spyod pas 'gro kun 'dren/ /gter chen

2 mchodabarngodachos kyi rgyal pos shis pa stsol/ /ngur sprig 'dzin pa'i khyu mchog gcig pu pa/ /rab 'byums gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i pha mthar son/ khrung 'jug lam bzang ston pa'i sgron me che/ /chos dpal rgya marlo gtsug gi rgyan du bsnyen/ /lung rtogs chos tshul rgya mtshor mnga' dbang 'byor/ /tshogs gnyis lang rlo rgyas pa'i grags snyan 'bar / khas rgol log smra'i spobs pa bsnyil mdzad pa/ /mi pham 'jam dpal dgrangs la dad phyag brtsegs/ /rigs kun khyab bdag pad+ma'i rgyal tshab che/ /'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i dgongs srog 'dzin/ /snar 'byor dbang phyug he ru ka dpal mchog ṇ+ḍaṃ chen kun bzang dbang rgyal gtsug na mchod/ /mtha' med srid pa gsum gyi yid mā kun/ /mtha' dag duḥkha kun las grol mdzad cing / /mtha' bral zung 'jug lam bzang ston mdzad pa/ /bshes gnyen dam pa rnams la phyag barmi / / phung khams dag pa rjo rje'i grong khyer du/ /maska nyid bde ba chen lo rol r+sā kyis/ /bde bshegs dgyes pa bskyed pa'i yum chen mo/ /ma sring mkha' 'gro tshogs kyis bde legs stsol/ /'phags bod rig 'dzin rnams kyi spyan snga ru/ /rdo rje dam tshig gnyan po'i yal garma gyis/ /thub bstan phyogs brgyar spel ba'i mthu rtsal mā/ /chos srung dam ༅ rgya maspya grogs su bsnyen/ /zhes mchod par brngod pa'i me tog man+da rwa ba'i 'phreng ba tshar du dngar ba dag gis phyogs kun thang mar brdal bas mdun bsus te/ gang gleng bar bya ba 'og min

glengagani 3cici.a rgyan smin grol gling gi gdan rabs mkhan brgyud rnams kyi rnam par thar pa'i rim pa cha tsam bkod pa la/ thog mar gang las 'byung ba'i khungs smos pa dang /rigs kyi che ba bshad pa dang / rnam thar dngos kyi rim pa bstan pa dang gsum las / thog mar chos brgyud gang las byung ba'i khungs ni/ grwa nang dar rgyas chos gling gi gdan rabs las mched pa ste/ chos sde 'di ni thog mar gter chen rat+na gling pa'i sprul sku sna tshogs rang grol gyis phyag btab/ bsdu ba rnam bzhi'i phrin las kyi sgo 'phar yangs por phyes/ de nas rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma gling pa'i sprul sku bstan 'dzin grags pas gdan sa mdzad/ de rjes sna tshogs rang grol gyi sprul sku smyos ston mkhas grub chen po mdo sngags bstan 'dzin/ de'i sras gsang bdag dpa' bo nywan las lhun grub kyi bar ri khrod dar rgyas chos gling du gdan sa mdzad cing bstan 'gro'i dpal mabonon du bzhugs/ 'di dag gi rnam thar yang 'og nas 'byung bar 'gyur la/ de rjes rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub kyi sras su gter chen 'gyur med rdo rje 'khrungs/ rgyal mchog lnga pa chen po sogs mkhas grub kyi bshes gnyen mang du bsten/ dben gnas rnams las dus babs kyi zab gter du ma spyan drangs/ snga 'gyur bstan pa'i chu 'go grwa phyi a rgyan smin grol gling gi gtsug lag khang phyag btab pa nas khri rabs dang mkhan brgyud rnams rim par byung ba yin no/ /de yang ngag sgros lo rgyus kha cig ltar na/ sde srid gtsang pa'i

4 gleng gzhi skabs phyogs nger bka' brgyud pa'i gnas gzhi thar pa gling du grags pa zhig yod kyang / 7gong sa lnga pa chen po'i skabs bsgyur dgon bcu gsum byung ba'i nang thar pa gling 'di gzhung sa nas a rgyan gter bdag gling par phul ba zhig yin zer / lo rgyus yi ger 'khod pa gzhan las ni/ sngon bstan pa phyi dar gyi skabs/rab byung gi gong dus rabs bcu pa'i smad tsam la grwa phyi 'bras kyi phur bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyi mkhan bu dbus gtsang mi bcu'i ya gyal klu mes tshul khrims shes rab kyis phyogs der gdan sa gsar du phyag btab par thar pa gling du grags / phyis su gtsug lag khang zhabs tog med par yun ring song ste shul med du gyur pa na/ slar rab byung bcu gtsig pa'i lcags khyi lor gnas gzhi der gasto chen 'gyur med rdo rjes 'og min a rgyan smin grol gling nges pa don gyi dga' ba'i tshal chen po phyag btab ces 'byung ngo / /ji ltar yang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po mchoge nas chos gzhi grwa rgyun sogs kyi mthun rkyen ma tshang ba med pa sus/ a rgyan sangs rgyasaganyis pa'i ring lugs bga' gaphro zung wīg gi bstan pa rin po che nyi ma bzhin gsal bar mdzad/ gter chen 'gyur med rdo rje dgongs pa zhi dgengs su mnal nas lo gsum song ba rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me bya 177 lor 'gong po'i ngan g.yo cho 'phrul la brten jun gar tshe dbang rab brtan gyi sog dmag bod du lhags nas snga 'gyur dgon snge sgrub gnas mang po bcom brlag tu btang /

spengagazhi 5bsam yas bzhig par brtsams pa na dam mā rdor legs kyis rdo char phab ste has po ri'i rgyab tu dmag mang po tib 'og tu btang ba'i shul da lta'ang yod par grags/7gong sa lnga pa 'a pos rtsernam rgyal grwa tshang du bstan rim labatsugs par mdzad pa'i gshin rje tshe bdag sogs sngags chog gi rgyun rnams rtsamed du bto/ khyad par smin gling lo chen dharma shrī/ rdor brag rig 'dzin pad+ma phrin las/ gter sras pad+ma 'gyur med rgya marlo/ gdung sras sku gzhon 'gyur med yid bzhin legs grub/rdor 'dzin blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs bla chen mang po nyes med du bkrongs / skabs der gdung sras 'gyur med rin chen rnam rgyal dang / gcung rgyalasras nye ba'i mgon po red brgyud nas khams phyogs su gsang bros kyis phebs/rje btsun mi 'gyur dpal sgron dpon g.yog hrag bsdus bcas re zhig 'bras ljongs su byon dgos pa byung / de rjes rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags byi lor jun gar dmag dpung phyir log byas/ de nas rgyal mchog sku phreng bdun pa bskal bzang rgya marlo mchog gis snga 'gyur rnying ma'i chos brgyud nyams pa rnams slar gso dgos pa'i ba/'a khyab stsal ba dang bstun/ rab 'byums pa a rgyan skal bzang dang /rab 'byams pa a rgyan chos grags rnams kyis dbus 'dus tshogs rnams nas rim ba'in nyams gso mdzad/ sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs dang nyag rong khul du pho nya ba ched mngags kyis rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ rje ba.oṃ mi 'gyur

6 gleng gzhidapal sgron rnams gdan drangs te/ rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i thugs bskyed zla med pa'i mtshams sbyor la brten/ chos brgyud nyams pa thams cad slar sor chud de khri rabs bcu pa'i bar lha sde mi sde yongs rdzogs rang dbang gtsang ma'i dpal gyis 'asnang ba las/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa phag lor rgya dmar kla klo'i dpung dmag bod du lhags te khor yug gangs ris bskor ba'i yul ljongs 7rgyal dbang phyag na padre'i gdul zhing gi snod bcud mtha' dag dbang med bdag tu gzung / ris med bstan 'dzin gyi skyes chen mang po 'o brgyal ba'i gnas su sbyar/bod mi rtsam zan yongs rdzogs gzhis byes gnyis su kha bral btang ste/ yul lung gnam gzhis dang bza' btung skad rigs mi gcig pa'i phyogs mtha' mang por byol te sa chu ma 'phrod pas tshe srog bstungs pa grangs kyis mi chod/ mang po zhig ni lam las ngal rtsol gyis 'chi rkyen thebs/ gzhan yang bod dang rgya bal sa mtshams dang gnas chen bgrod lam rnams su rkun jag dang sa srung gis lo bstar bcom pa sogs/ rgyal khab med pa'i khyad gsod dang brnyas bcos myong ba mngon sum yin kyang / de las lngog pa'i thabs gang yang mi rnyed/ phal che ba ni rgya gar yul gru mang por gyar nas tsha dmyal gson por myong bzhin mchis/'ornakyang bsam bzhin srid pa bzung ba gangs can lha gcig pad dkar 'chang ba ngur smig 'dzin pa'i gar gyi rnam par rol ba 7gong sa rgyal ba'i dbang po mchog dang /

gleng gzhi 7ris med bstan 'dzin gyi skyes chen rnams kyi thugs bskyed dang phrin las med du byung ba'i stobs kyis rgya bal 'bras 'brug phyi gling rnams su chos sde mang po rim gyis chags / mdo sngags gzhung lugs rnams la 'chad nyan sgom sgrub kyi grwa tshugs/gzhan yang la dwags khu nu spi snyi sogs dang / rgya gar khams pa/ 'grug 'bras ljongs gnyan shang shar pa blorwa 1 mu khum nub ri rta mang sogs mtha' mtshams bod rigs rnams la'ang btsan byol bod mi rnams dang spyi mtshungs chos dang zang zing gi mthun rkyen 'bad pa med par phyes/ de ltar bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung gi grags snyan bzang po ni mnga' bdag mes dbon rnams dang mkhas grub kyi skyes bu zam ma chad par byon pa rnams kyi sku drin la brten lan grangs bcu drug gis bzhu btul song ba'i gser bzang po bzhin 'dzam gling mkhas dbang gzur gnas kun gyis bsngags brngod kyi tshetog 'thor ba'i gnas su gyur pa sogs spyi tshul rnams ni spros pas chog la bye brag gi dbang du na// spyi lo 1967 lor snga 'gyur bstan pa'i sgron me 7skyabs rje rdzong nang rin po che dpal sprul 'jam dpal blo gros mchog dang 7skyabs rje mkho sprul rin po che 'gyur med mdo rgyud rgya mcho rnam gnyis nas rgya gar byang phyogs sa la'i sman ljongs stus pos yongs su bskor ba'i nags khrod 'dir/rang lugs snga 'gyur rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i lam srol bod du grags che ba rlingari ma'i ma dgon chen po drus gi ya gyal morog min gnyis pa a rgyan smin grol gling rten dang

8 gleng gzhibarten par bcas pa gsar du bzhengs/ phyogs 'dus dge 'dun gyi sdes rtag tu rnam dkar gyi bya ba rgya chen po la 'jug pa'i bsod nams kyi sgo 'phar bzang po phyis shing / yang sgos gsang chen bla na med pa'i shing rta chen po kun mkhyen rong klong rnam gnyis dang / rig lon gter bdag gling pa/ lo chen dhame shrī/ wom mgon mi pham rin po che sogs kyi dgongs pa ltar rang lugs kyi grub mtha' rang rkang tshugs pa'i bshad khrid dang thun mong ma yin pa'i snga 'gyur gyi bzhed pa rnams mi nyams nan to 'byung bar dmigs te/ sa 'brug phyi lo 1988 zla 4 tshes 26 nyin snga 'gyur ches mtho'i bshad grwa mdo rgyud legs bshad gling gsar du btsugs/mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung 'chad nyan sgokha sgrub kyisrol ma nyams par sor chud par mdzad do/ /slad du yang 7rgyal dbang phyag na pad+mo sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chenapo ngag dbang blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mcho mchog gis dbus ris med skyes chen rnams dang / 'phags yul smin grol gling du khri rabs bcu gcig pa khri chen kun bzang dbang rgyal mchog gsang gsum mi shigs rdo rje'i khri la 'tsho 'ing bzhes pa dang / mdzad phrin yar zla'i dpal la 'gran cing thugs bskyed bzhed don mtha' dag 'bad med lhun gyis 'grub par rtsagasum lha chogs dam can rgya mcho 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gsol ba rtsegacig tu 'debs pa lags so/ /

rigs kyiche ba 9gnyis pa gang las mched pa'i gdung rigs kyi che ba bshad pa ni/ 'bri yi po snyi bse ru las/ lar skye sa pa'i mis rang gi skye brgyud ma shes na nags gseb kyi spre'u dang 'dra/ mi rang gi cho 'brang ma shes na g.yu 'grug zol ma dang 'dra/ pha mes kyi yig tshang ma shes na mon phrug yal bor dang 'dra/ zhes dang / skyes pa'i mi la dgos pa'i gtam dgos/ /byas pa'i chos la grub pa'i ma tha' dgos/ /che ba'i mi la mthe rdzoba'i rtags dgos/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar gna' dus kyi skye bo bsod nams can rnams la rigs rus ma 'chol ba'i khungs dang yig tshang bshad du yod kyang / deng sang ni ji skad du/ mdzes mdzes gos kyis zag phung khebs pa dang / /zhim 'im/ zas kyis lto ba khengs pa la/ /zab zab snying por sems pa'i blo gros 'di / / blun blun phyugs kyi phu nu las gzhan ci/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rigs rus sgrung gtam gyi rigs la rtsis bzhag med par nyi ma 'phul byed du blta zhing khyi dang glo ba 'phrad pa ltar sang thod thod kyis 'jug cing ma rabs 'dab gshogs rgyas pa'i dus su snang / 'on kyang 'dir dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyi rnam thar brjod pa la gdung rus kyi khyad par bstan pa don yod pa'i phyir phyogs tsam skal bzang dga' ba bskyeng pa'i rna lung du dpyangs pa ni/ spyir bod du dar ba'i gdung rabs la chos rgyal lha/ yi sadung / she sar smug po'i gdung / kha rag smyos kyi gdung /'jam dbyangs 'khon gyi gdung / stag lung ga zi'i gdung / 'bri gung skyu ra'i

10 rigs kyi chebagadung / phag gru rlangs kyi gdung / bya yul smog rtse'i gdung sogs mang du 'byung ba las/ 'dir smyos bya khyung dkar po'i gdung rigs su grags pa ni/ de la spyir byang chub sems dpa'i gdung 'tshob pa'i gang zag rnams kyi rigs rus kyi byung ba brngod pa ni bram ze ngan g.yo mkhan gyi rigs srung ba lta bu ma yin par 'gro ba mang po'i phanabade'i rtsalag gcig tu gnas pa'i phyir tshad med pa'i bsod nams kyi 'jug ngogs su gsungs pas na 'dir yang thog mar rigs rus kyi gtam cung zad cig gleng bar bya ba la/ don yin lugs kyi ngos nas gzhal na/ ji skad du mdo rgyal mtshan dam pa las/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ni/ /yab ni thabs la mkhas pa ste/ /yum ni shes rab pha rol phyin/ /'dren pa rnams ni de las skye / zhes gsungs pa ltar thabs shes khyad par can gyi rigs su 'byungs pa'i phyir bzang ngan gyi rnam gzhag ma mchis mod/ 'on kyang tha snyad rnam 'jog gi tshul dang mthun par 'gro ba rnams kyi+o bkur gnas su byed pa dang bstan pa'i che ba spel ba sogs dgos ched khyad par ba mang du mchis pa las brtsams te smos na/ de yang spyir bod kha ba to gyi sa bkra la/ stod mnga' ris skor gsum rdzing bu lta bu/bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi yur ba lta bu/smad mdo khams sgang drug zhing sa lta bu zhes srid pa'i mi rgan rnams kyi ngag sgros ltar/ gtsung gi ru mtshams g.yag sde ngang 'dabs chags par jo mo kha rag gi ri zhol du gna' bo'i dus su/ gzugs

rigs kyi che ba 11khams 'od gsal lha las mched pa'i skyes bu sngon chad mthong ma myong ba gzugs byad blta bas chog mi shes pa/ rgyud 'jam zhing khong dal ba sogs mtho ris kyi yon tan du mas brgyanapa zhig rmu stag las babs te byung bal yul mi rnams mchog tu ngo mtshar skyes te gong du bkur zhing mchod gnas su byas so/ /ji zhig na mi'i grib kyis lha'i bu nyid myos pa ltar gyur pa la smyos zhes zer ba byung la smyos bya khyung dkar po zhes mtshan du gsol/ de'i rigs las byung ba rnams la dpal lngan smyos rigs zhes grags shing / de la phyi nang gi rus smyos gnyis las/dang po'i brgyud pa ni smyos bya khyung dkar po dang rmu lcam ding mo btsun bshos pa las smyome rje btsan po byung / de dang ljong gza' dkar mo legs 'dus pa las smyos seṅge shākya/ de dang rmu gza' sman mo btsun bshos pa las smyos grwa mkhar rje dang /rje phan/ yag rje/ spyar rje rnams byung / smyos grwa mkhar rjes yul g.yar mo gnung du byon pa las sras thugs rje dang zhang nge gnyis byung / smyos zhang nge g.yor stod zhal gyi khrims mo gung mkhar du byon/ kha rag dang 'brang sil bzung / zhang nge'i sras smyos 'bri lde/ de'i sras smyos 'bri chung / de'i sras smyos dpal gyi yon tan/ de'i sras smyos slob dpon tshul yon/ de'i sras smyos gu ru/ de'i sras smyos lha phan/ de'i sras smyos mthu rgyal dang spang la me shar bya ba'i mched gagi5 byon/ 'di'i ring gsar ma'i yo ga la sbyangs pas de phyin chad gsar rnying

12 rigasakyicheba'adres mar senge bar grags/ smyos mthu rgyal la sras drug byung ba'i thu bo smyos lo yon tan grags dang / de la sras bzhi byung bas thu bo smyos gtsang rdo rje bla ma ste/pha rgyud skor gsum dang bde mchog sogs la shin tu mkhas shing bod kyi mi chen bzhir grags pa'i ya gyal gcig yin/ de la sras gsum gyi 'bring po smyos dpal gyi seṅge/ de la sras gnyis byung ba'i che ba chos rgyal mya ngan med kyi skye bar bsngags pa smyos nag grags pa dpal dang / de la sras bdun byung ba'i gsum pa nag po spyod pa chung ba'i sku skyer grags pa smyos rgyal ba lha nang pa/ de'i sras smyos bkra shis dbang phyug ste skyes chen du ma byon pa'i brgyud pa ni kha rag gi lha sa pa rnams yin par grags la/ phyi ma la mthing ma smyos zhes 'bod pa ste/ de'i brgyud pa ni smyos bkra shis dbang phyug gi sras myos zhig chen po grags pa rdo rje/de la sras drug byung ba las zhang lcam ma'i sras tha chung smyos sgom chen po pad+ma rdo rje/de'i sras smyos ston a mi kirti/ de'i sras smyos ston grags pa bkra shis/ de'i sras smyos ston grags pa rin chen/ de'i sras smyos grags pa 'od zer dang grags pa rgyal mtshan gnyis las/ phyi ma la sras 'jo 'bum dpal zhes bya ba sngon btsan po khri srong gis gra dol gzhung gsum byin pa'i zhang blon sna nam gyi bu che ba lha sras mu rub btsan pos bsad/ chung ba nar son pa 'bangs gyen log gis dwogs te khams su spyugs pa'i brgyud zad du nye ba na/ sku mag tu byon pa las smyos 'phags

rigs kyicheb 13pa dpal dang / de'i sras smyos bsod nams grags pa/ de'i sras smyos den 'grub rnam rgyal/ de'i sras smyos mgon po tshe dbang / de'i sras smyos rnam rgyal lhun grub/ de'i sras smyos ston tshe dbang rdo rje dang yum spa sor gyi rigs las byung ba tshe ring bu dga' gnyis kyi sras su lang 'gro lo tsā'i rnam 'phrul kun mkhyen mdo sngags bstan 'dzin byon/ de dang yum dgos 'dzoms pa'i sras su lcam dral gnyis las gsang bdag dpa' bo nywan las lhun grub dang yum lha 'dzin ma'i sras su a rgyan gter bdag gling pa sogs smyos rigs rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gdung brgyud kyi phreng ba tshar du dngar ba rnams byung ba yin no/ /gsum pa rnam thar dngos kyi rim pa bstan pa la/ spyi don gyi khog phub pa dang / rnam thar dngos kyi rang bzhin bshad pa gnyis so/ /dang po la khams lugs dang / dbus lugs gnyis las/dang po ni/ smyo shul mkhan po 'jam dgrangs rdo rje'i chos 'byung las/ gsang bdag phrin las lhun grub kyi sras khri rabs dang po gter chen 'gyur med rdo rje dang /de nas khri rin chen rnam rgyal/ khri 'gyur med pad+ma bstan 'dzin/ khri 'gyur med phrin las rnam rgyal/ khri 'gyur med pad+ma dbang rgyal/ khri 'gyur med sangs rgyas kun dga'/ khri 'gyur med yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ khri 'gyur med bde chen mchog grub sde/ smyos rigs rdo rje 'dzin pa bar ma chad pa'i khri rabs brgyad dang / de rjes smin gling gi gdung nyams pa gter bdag gling pa'i rnam 'phrul

14 spyidon khams nyag rong gter chen rang rig rdo rje'i sras kyis gsele te khri chen gsar bzhugs gsum dang bcas/ da lta'i bar khri rabs bcu gcig byon par bzhed cing / gsar bzhugs gsum ni/ nyag bla rang rig gi sras khri chen kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de'i sras khri chen don grub dbang rgyal/ de'i sras da ltar 'tsho zhing gzhes pa khri chen kun bzang dbang rgyal bcas so/ /khri rabs gnyis par gter sras pad+ma 'gyur med rgya mcho mi bgrangs pa ni/ gter sras 'di rten rab byung du banugs shing phyag rgya ma bzhes pas rten 'brel gzhan dbang du gyur te dgung lo yun thung du las mi bzhugs pa sogs phyi mtha' gzigs pa'i tshul gyis rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal gnyis par bgrangs pa 'dra ste/ ji skad du/ chos 'khor lhun po'i steng du gser gyi rgya phibs bzo bkod ngo mtshar ba bsgrubs te mdzes par spras nas rab tu gnas par gsol bas/ shin tu legs/ de dus bu chung rin rnam 'di khri chen gyi go sar gon po'i tshab tu che 'don byed/ nged kyis nas chung zhig stsor na rten 'brel che gsungs par/ re zhig sku nyid bzhugs ring la nyid rang khrir bzhugs rgyu las gzhan pa khrisnye'adon mi gnang bar nu zhes nan gyis gsol ba btab ste bshol bas/ 'o na sang nyin rab gnas ston mo'i tshe tshogs nang na nges par 'ong dgos/ da res nged kyis byas pa de legs pa 'dra yang khyed rnams mi nyan 'dug /nged rang pha bu yang yang dus gcig tu 'dzoms pa dka' bas/

spyidon 15sang nyin rin chen rnam rgyal tshogs dbus su phebs dgos gsungs par/ mgron gnyer gyis gdan bkod rnams grub tshar/ sras rin rnam bzhugs gdan gang du byed dgos zhes zhus pas/ gdong gral g.yon mgo der gdan mtho theng nge ba'i khri che mtho zhig shoms la/ de'i steng du zhog gsungs pa ltar/ gdan khri'i khar bzhag nas rigs chos gnyis kyi brgyud 'dzin rtogs pa don gyi rgyal tshab tu bkra shis mnga' gsol gyi rab gnas dang gtad rgya mdzad pa yin no/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar/ phyis su yab rje khri chen gong ma'i rnam thar bskyangs shing mi dbang bsod nams snyobs rgyal gyi tihrīr bkur/ bstan pa la phyag bzhes shin tu che zhing /deng sang gi bar lugs 'di'i bka' gter thams cad ma nyams par bzhugs pa skyes mchog 'di'i phrin las kho nar nges pas na drin can rin chen rnam rgyal zhes grags pa den la gnas pa yin no/ /gnyis pa 'u yug pa bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung smin gling dkar chag ltar na/ rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub kyi sras khri rabs dang po gter chen 'gyur med rdo rje/ khri rabs gnyis pa gter sras pad+ma 'gyur med rgya marlo/ de nas rim par khri rabs gsum pa gter chen gyi sras tha chung rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ de'i sras khri rabs bzhi pa 'gyur med pad+ma bstan 'dzin/ de'i sras khri rabs lnga pa 'gyur med phrin las rnam rgyal/ de'i sras khri rabs drug pa 'gyur med pad+ma dbang rgyal/ de'i sras khri rabs bdun pa

16 spyidona'agyur med sangs rgyas kun dga'/ nge'i sras khri rabs brgyad pa 'gyur med yid ba'in dbang rgyal/ de la sras ma byung bar sacung mkhan po kun dga' tshul khrims rdo rje bslab pa phul nas khri rabs dgu pa mdzad pas khri 'gyur med bde chen mchog grub tu grags/ der sras gcig 'khrungs kyang sku na chung ngu'i skabs bla brang yang thog nas g.yang gzar lhang ste glo bur du sku gshegs/ de nas gter chen rin po che'i dngos kyi gdung brgyud bar mtshams chad/ slar dgos pa'i dbang mang du gzigs te nyag bla pad+ma bdud 'dul gyis lung ltar a rgyan gter bdag gling pa'i sku'i sprul par dngos su grags pa nyag rong gter ston rang rig rdo rje smin gling du gdan drangs te mnga' gsol tsam zhus kyang khri 'dzin ma mdzad/ nge/'i sras khri rabs bcu pa khri chen kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de'i sras khri rabs bcu gcig pa khri chen 'gyur med don grub dbang rgyal/ gang nyid sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs mdzad spyod 'ga' 'ig mi legs par brten rgyal dbang sku 'phreng bcu gsum pa chen po'i bka' 'brel gdung brgyud min kyang rdor 'odzin rin po che rnopa grol rgya mtsho khri tshab tu bsko bzhag mdzad/ rdor 'dzin gshegs rjes rgyal tshab rwa sgreng rin po che thub bstan 'jam ngapal ye shes kyis smin gling gcung rin po che dge slong ngag dbang chos grags khri tshab tu bskos gnang mdzad/ khri rabs bcu gcig pa khri chen 'gyur med don grub dbang rgyal gyi sras 'gyur med kun bzang dbang rgyal ni

spyidon 17gnas dus kyi rkyen pas khri 'don mdzad sgo 'bul khom ma rag kyang da lta 'phags yul du 'tsho zhing gzhes pa bcas so shes 'byung la/ /mkhan rabs kyi tshul la yang / 'dul 'dzin dang po gter chen gyi sku mched 'bring po rgyal sras bstan pa'i nyi ma/ mkhan rabs gnyis pa gter chen gyi sku mched gcung gzhon lo tsā ba dharma shrī/ mkhan rabs gsum pa khri rin rnam pa'i sras mkhan chen a rgyan bstan 'dzin rdo rje/ mkhan rabs bzhi pa khri 'gyur med pad+ma bstan 'dzin gyi sras mkhan chen gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ mkhan rabs lnga pa khri 'gyur med 'phrin las rnam rgyas gyi sras mkhan chen a rgyan chos 'phel/ mkhan rabs drug pa khri 'gyur med pad+ma dbang rgyal gyi sras mkhan chen rig 'dzin bzang po/ mkhan rabs bdun pa khri 'gyur med sangs rgyas kun dga'i sras kun dga' tshul khrims rdo rje ste/phyis bslab pa phul te khri chen mdzad pas bde chen mchog grub tu grags pa 'di nas gter bdag gling pa'i gdung brgyud kyis mkhan po mdzad pa'i mtshams chad/mkhan rabs brgyad pa/ nyag rong sras khri chen kun dga' bstan 'dzin gyi sras mkhan chen ngag dbang mkhyen brtsenor bu zhes pa'i bar 'byung la/ de yi yang srid mkhan rabs dgu pa da ltar 'tsho shing gzhes pa mkhan chen ngag dbang mkhyen rab rgya marlo ste/ 'di rnams kyi rnam par thar pa ni mkhas pa gu ru bkra k+shis dang lo chen chos dpal rgya mtsho'i gsung la skyabs rje bdud 'joms rin po che 'jigs bral ye

18 spyi don shes rdo rje zhabs kyis kha skong mdzad pa las rags rim tsam snang zhing der mi gsal ba rnams lo rgyus deb ther gzhan las 'byung ba bzhin bkod pa ni 'og nas rim par 'byung bas shes so/ /gzhan yang rdor 'dzin 'gyur med tshe dbang bzang po/ rdor 'dzin pad+ma tshe dbang / rdor 'dzizha shes rab bstan dar/ rdor 'dzin 'gyur med bde chen chos 'dzin rnams kyi rnam par thar pa ni dus kyis bskal bas mjal du med cing / phyogs tsam re ni pad gling rim byon gyi rnam thar sogs las mkhyen par 'gyur ro/ /gdung brgyud kyi khongs su ma gtogs pa mkhas grub kyi skyes bu mang du byung yang rnam thar so sor zur tsam gsal ba ni/ dge slong blo gsal rgya mcho/'bum ram pa a rgyan skal bzang / rdor 'dzin bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ rab 'byams pa blo bzang bkra shis/ mtshams pa dpal mgon/ rab 'byams pa bstan dar/ rdor 'dzin kun bzang bstan 'dzin/ rdor lodzan nor bu/ rdor 'dzin tshe dbang / rngor 'dzin rnamagrol rgya mcho/ rdor 'dzin tsho brtan rnams kyang lo rgyus rnam thar gyi gseb dag las cung zad re rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtsedabang po'i gsung thor bu las khri rabs brgyad dang mkhan rabs lnga tsam gsal ba ni bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung dang mthun par snang bas 'dir ma smros so/ /zhar la khri rabs dgu pa'i skabs kyi gsung sgros yi ger bkod du rung ba ni/ khri 'gyur med bde chen mchog grub nas pad gling brgyad pa kun bzang

spyi ngon 19bde chen rjo rje'am nges tho bstan pa'i nyi ma la/ nyid gnyes gdung rtsod med la brten gter chen gdung 'tshob tu smin gling la bzhugs gnang mdzod ces bskul yang ma gsan pa yin ces 7skyabs rje bdud 'joms rin po che'i gsung pad gling 'khrungs rabs las 'byung la/ yang ngag sgros kha cig ltar na de'i tshe snga 'gyur bstan pa'i shing rta chen po mkhyen kong mchog gsum dgongs pa rtsemathun thog lho brag khul bzhugs mnga' bdag nyang gi brgyud pa zhig smin gling gdung 'tshob tu gdan drangs na rten 'brel khyad 'phags yod tshul gsungs na yang / gnung sa mchog dang smin gling bla spyi nas de tsam thugs snang ma mdzad pa yin ces zer ro/ /des na bar skabs kyi smin gling gdan rabs mkhan brgyud rnams kyi rnam thar zhib gsal deng sang mi rmed pa ni/ bar der 'gong po'i cho 'phrul la brten smin gling gi bstan rgyun nyag phrar gyur pa dang / rnam thar lo rgyus bag la zha ba rnams slong ma nus par gtan med lta bur gyur 'dug pa snga 'gyur rnying ma ba spyi dang / khyad par skabs de dag gi smin gling dbu bzhugs bla spyi rnams kyis khur babs ma bzhes par bag yangs lhod che byung ba'i skyon du gnas par mkhas blun sus kyang shes thub pa yin no/ /de ltar lugs gnyis las 'dir gang dang mthun par 'chad ce na/khri rabs bcu gcig tu bzhag pa ni khams lugs dang mthun la/ gter sras pad+ma 'gyur med rgya mtsho khri rabs gnyis par bgrangs pa ni dbus kyi lugs dang

20 spyi thomakhyen brtsedabang po'i gsung thor bu dang yang mthun la/ smyo shul ltar na khri rabs dgu pa'am 'u yug pa'i bzhed paltar na khri rabs bcu pa khri kun dgazha bstan 'dzin bkod du rung yang 'dir mi 'byung ba ni/ 'phags yul smin grol gling gi lha 'babs mchod rten mthong ba rang grol gyi steng khang tshad med bzhi glo 'bur them skas dang bcas pa'i nang / 7skyabs rje mkho sprul rin po che mdo rgyud rgya mtsho mchog nas zhal bkod kyis bzhengs gnang mdzad pa'i lder sku mi tshad ma'i grangs dang go rim ji lta ba bzhin bkod par byas so/ /slad du da ltar 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i rtsod med gdung brgyud rin po che rgya mig rgya sa lta bu rnams dza hu na'i bu mo'i dpal la 'gran zhing / bstan 'gro'i don chen kho na thugs la brnag pa'i smin grol chos kyitsho rgyal thabs phyogs kun tu spel ba la phrin las rgya che rgyun mi chad pa'i ngos/ rnam thar dang pa'i 'jug ngogs bzang po dag kyang skal ldan skyes bu kun gyi rna lung du spud pa dang / phan bde'i sgo 'phar yangs po ci dgar 'gyed cing dam chos bdud rtsi'i gru char rtag tu 'beb par re'o// //

rnamathar 21tsha/ gnyis pa rnam par thar pa'i rang ba'in dngos bshad pa la/ thog mar lang gro dkon mchog 'byung gnas kyi yang sring sprul pa'i gter chen rat+na gling pa ni/lho brag gru shul du yab phyug po ma/detre sde dar zhes pa dang yum sri thar sman gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bdun pa'i chu lug ston zla ra ba'i tshes bco lngar sku 'khrungs/cung nar son nas 'bri klog tshegs med du mkhyen/ dgung lo bcu tsam nas dag pa'i snang ba mang po shar/ spen sbyangs stobs kyis rig pa'i gnas rnams tshegs med par mkhyen cing chos kyi gsan pa'ang rgya cher mdzad/ dgung le— nyir bdun par gu ru rin po che khams pa'i bya bral ba dbu zhwa na bza' ser po byas pa zhig tu sprul nas gter gyi kha byang dngos su gnang 'ing bslab bya mdzad pa lngar/ dgung lo sum cu par khyung chen bras nas gter kha dang po rtsagasum sgrub sgor sogs kyis thog drangs / rim par 'bri thang koro bras nas rta phag yab yum zung 'jug tu sgrub pa/lho brag gnam skas can nas 'dus pa che(ra bzhi sogs/ bla ma 'i drag /thugs chen sasang 'dus/༈ je sas chen klong gas/la nyi ma gtso ber gyur pa'i gter kha nyi shu rtsalnga bton/ mkhar chu dpa/la gyi phug ring nas gter bzhes pa'i tshe rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa ngo zu/tshar can sosas/ mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul bsam las 'das pa bstan / a/ rgyan rin po/ che dngalan grangs nyer lnga mjal/tsā zangs mdog dpal rir phebs pa'i ngag snang sosas mdzod khang bcu gsum gyi rnam thar yi ger 'khod pa

22 /5thar ltar dang / thugs sgrub sman sgrub skye bdun ril sgrub sogs shin tu mang po mdzad cing de dag dang dbang khrid gdams ngag stsal ba sogs kyi skabs su 'ja' 'od me tog gi char dang spos kyi dris khyab pa sogs ngo mtshar brjod kyis mi lang zhing gang la'ang bar chad kyi rnam par cung zad kyang ma byung / rten 'brel rab dang phul du gyur pas sku thog gsum gyi gter skal thog gcig la bton pas/ zhig po sgrung pa/'gro 'dul gling pa/ rat+na gling pa zhes mtshan gsum du grags/ gangs ti se nas khams rgyal mo rong gi bar gyi 'gro ba dpag tu med pa smin grol la bkod/lhag par dus skabs de dag tu bka' 'gyur dkar chag ldan dkar mar gsang sngags nang rgyud rnams ba/'a gnyanapas 'dir ma bkod ces snga 'gyur rnying ma'i rgyud rnams bka' 'gyur sdebs su ma bzhugs stabs dpe lung gnyis ka'i rgyun shinatu dkon par gyur pa la/ zur 'ug pa lung du rgyud 'bum rags rim bzhugs pas mtshoni phyogs mtha' dag nas dbe rgyun rnams thugs rtsol chen pos btsal/lung rgyun yongs rdzogs gtsang gi mes sgom bsam gtan bzang po gcig bu las khams bod gang na'ang med par mkhyen pas lung rgyun chad du nye ba thugs kyis ma bzod de/ rje mes sgom sku na shin tu bsgres kyang yun ring por dpon slob gnyis kas brtson pa chen po'i sgo nas gsan/ slar gru ro/la lhun grub pho brang du rgyud 'bum dkyus gcig tu bsgrigs te sngon du snag bris dang / rjes thogs su gser

rnamathar 23chos gsar bzhengs dang 'brel lung rgyun lan du mar spel bar mdzad pas/ deng sang gsang rgyud yid bzhin nor bu lta bu 'di rnams la longs spyad du yod pa gter chen 'di nyid kyi thugs rje kho nar nges pas na/ snga 'gyur spyi'i bstan pa la gcig tu bga' drin che ba yin no/ /de lta bu'i mdzad pa mthar phyin nas daying lo bdun cu rtsadrug pa la ngo mtshar ba'i cho 'phrul chen po dang bcas te pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang du gshegs / thugs sras snying gi bu bzhi sogs sras brgyud dang slob brgyud bzang la grangs mang ba da lta'i bar du byon cing zab chos kyi phrin las/ ma nyams par gnas bzhin pa'o/ /skal bzang gdul byas mdo dang sngags kyi tshul/ /nyams su len la gzhan dring mi 'jog par/ /bka' dang dgongs pa 'grel ba'i gzhung kun rdzogs / mutsho skyes rgyal ba'i mistan pa rgyas gyur cig/ //

24 rnamathar 7/ gter ston rgyal po lnga'i ba'i par bsngags pa mnga' bdag sras mo lha lcam pad+ma gsal gyi dag pa'i spe+o ba lngali mtha' ma a rgyan pad+ma gling pa ni/ mon bum thang du myos kyi rigs las yab don grub bzang po dang / yum grong ma dpal 'dzoms gnyis kyi sras su rab byung brgyad pa'i lcags pho rta'i lor ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te sku bltams/ kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer gyi skye ba de ma thag par gyur pas chung du nas dam pa'i rigs sad/ yig rigs dang bzo gnas sogs ma bslabs par mkhyen/ khyad par sprel lo ston ra'i tshes bcu'i nyin yi ge drug ma'i gnas su a rgyan rin po ches zhal dngos su bstan nas byin gyis brlabs / gter kha chen po brgya rtsabargyad kyi kha byang phyag tu stsal ba ltar dgung 'o/ nyer bdun par/ zab gter thamarī / cad kyi thog ma rdzogs chen klong gsal gyi skor rnams sna ring bras si snye logs stang chu rgya mdud du 'khyil ba'i me/ 'bar mtshor grags pa nas/ khrom tshogs mang po'i dbus su phyag na sgron me 'ig bsnams nas marlo nang thegs/ meng du gshegs/ slar phyag bi sgron me'ang ma shi bar gter sgrom chen po rdzam/ tsam/ 'ig mchan du bcug nas phebs pas/ thams cad ngo mtshar ying ches kyi dad par bkod pa la brten rtsod pa dang bral ba'i snyan grags kyis sa steng du nyi zla ltar khyab par gyur/ des mtshon te bas/ma yas mchims phu nas dzo+ogs chen kun bzang dgongs 'dus/ gzhan yang gter gnas so so nas rdzogasachen

napa thar 25gnyis med rgyud bu chung gi skor dang / bla ma nor bu rgya marlo/ thugs rje chen po mun sel sgron me/ bka' brgyad thugs kyi me long / phur pa yang gsang srog gi spu gri/ bdud rtsisman sgrub kyi skor te bka' phur sman gsum/ phyag rdo+or dregs 'dul dang ga65 chung / drag po che 'bring chung gsum/ tshe khrid rdo rje phreng ba/tshe sgrub nor bu lam khyer/ nag po skor gsum/ las phran gyi skor sogs mang du bzhes shing / de dang mtshungs par myong grol skye bdun sku tshab pad+ma gu ru sogs dam rdzas rten gsum gyi rigs kyang bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / khyad par lho skyer chu'i lha khang dpal tshab gsum pa'i lha khang dang mtshungs pa de nyid sngon mi snang ba gter ston 'dis ri sul zhig nas sa rdo rnams bsal te lha khang deng sang kun gyis mjal du yod par mdzad/ nor gter kyang chos rgyal gyi bla g.yu rin po che 'od 'bar / bla g.yu stong ri 'od 'bar/ bla g.yu gangs ri khang dmar/ lha lcam gyi na bza' srub med pa/ me long rgyang gsal sogs rgyal brgyud kyi nor sna khyad 'phags mang po'ang gter nas bzhes/ gter kha brgya rtsabargyad kyi kha byang phyag tu byung na'ang phyed tsam las bzhes ma thub/ phyis gter ston sku gshegs khar sras kyis 'don chog par gsol ba btab pas/ khyod kyis gter chos thon par dka' yang dam tshig gtsung mar bsrungs shing bdag rang la gsol ba btab na phran tshegs rnyed pa'ang srid gsungs pa bzhin/ thugs sras zla bas kyang gter kha

26 rnam thar 'ga' zhig spyan drangs par grags/ gzhan yang ya mtshan che ba'i nasdi da pa bsam gyis mi khyab cing / ma 'ongs pa na pad+ma bkod pa'i zhing khams sdo/snari sa rgyas rdo rje snying po 'es bya bar 'gyur ba'i lung bstan dang / da lta'i 'bre' gos rnams kyang zhing der skyes nas sangs rgyas de'i gdul byar 'gyur bar gsudi5 so/ /thugs sras slob ma'i tshogs kyang gter lung las/ las kyis 'dremi ba khri phrag gcig: smon lam 'brel ba stong rtsaganyis: zab mo'i gnad i'abrel bcu gcig: dkyil 'bor 'dzin pa'i bu bdun dang: thugs kyi snying/ 5 gsum du 'byung: zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par bsam gyis mi khyab pa byo'e 'a nang nas/gabo ra gyur pa sprul pa'i gter ston drug /grub thob chen po drug /grub rtags mngon sum thon pa'i bu chen drug /gter ston nyid dang dgongs giskanyam pa'i jo gdan mkhan chen tshul khrims dpal 'byor/ nang so rgyal ba don srub/ sprul sku mchog ldan mgon po ste thugs kyi sras gsum/ rigs gsum mgon po'i sprulapa sku'i sras mched bzhi sogs byon cing / de'i nang nas spyan rasagazigs kyi sprul pa thugs sras zla ba ni byin rlabs nus rtsal bsam gyis mi khyarga cing ya/ba kyi dgongs pa len pa la brten phrin las rgya che bas/ sa skya bdag chen/ 'briguri rin chen phun tshogs/ zhwa dmar ba dkon mchog yan las /dpari bo chosargyal don grub sogs kyis skyes chen dam par bsngags shing bla mar bkur/ dbus

rnamathar 27gtsang lho mon gyi mi chen sna rgas kyang zhabs nas btegs pas gzhan phan phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab kyang sbas pa'i rnal 'byor gyi tshul mdzad/ zab chos kyi rgyun sprul sku sna tshogs rang grol dang / dbu mdzad don grub dpal 'bar te mtshungs med chos rje rnam gnyis su grags pa dang / lho brag lha lung gi gdan sar pad gling nyid kyi gsung sprul dang thugs sras sprul pa'i sku rim brgyud nas bzung zhing spel bas da lta'i bar lto rān dbus gtsang mdo khams yul gyi mthar thug par khyab cing / dbang lung khrid rgyun mtha' dag ma nyams par bzhugs pa yin no/ /bden gsung ba/'a yi rgya mtsho 'eng po la/ /zab mo'i chos gter nor bus mngon par mdzes/ /mdo dang sngags kyi lam bzang zung du 'brel/ /marlo skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig/ //

28 snamathar tsha/ chos brgyud kyi thog ma sprul sku sna tshogs rang grol ni/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i gdung 'tshob dam par dri ma med pa'i lung gis bsngags pa gter chen brgya rtsa/gter phran stong rtsarnams su byon pa las/ gtso bor mchog tu gyur pa mchog gi sprul sku rnam gsum/ gter ston gyi rgyal po lnga/ chos bdag gling pa brgyad du grags pa'i ya gyal gter chen rat+na gling pa'i sprul sku de ma thag pa ste/ yab rje tshe dbang bsam 'grub dang yum a rgyan skyid kyisras su shing ho+ostag gilor dge mtshan bzang po du ma dang bces lho brag sman thang du sku bltams/ chung ngu'i dus nas rgyud 'jam zhing khong dal ba/ kun la byams shing snying brtseb sogs dam pa'i ngang tshul rnams mthun snang du grub par gsal/ dgung grangs bdun brgyad tsam nas yon tanagyi gzhi ma yige 'bri klog dang chos spyod zhal gdams sogs la thugs sbyong mdzad pas thams cad kyang dka' tshegs ma dgos par mkhyen / dgung lo bco lngar babs pa na lha lung du mkhan chen tshul dpal ba dang lhun bkras pa zung mkhan slob du bsden/ khyad par slob dpon lhun bkras pa las dge tshul gyi dngos po bsgrubs te khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung / dus phyis dgung grangs nyi shur son pa'i rjes spos khang ba kun dga' blo gros dang chos lung pa rnam gnyis la mkhan slob zhus te grangs tshang ba'i dge 'dun gyi drung nas nges 'byung gi bsam pa brtan pos bsnyen rdzogs kyi sngom pa nod de dge slong du gyur/ 'dul ba'i gnang

rnam thar 29bkag gi legs bshad dang lag len mtha' dag la legs par sbyangs pas 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i mchog tu grags/ mkhan slob gnyis dang / gzhan yang snga phyi mang por mkhas grub rin chen bzang po/ gter chen pad+ma gling pa/ sprul sku byang chub gling pa/ kun spangs legs pa'i shes rab sogs bshes gnyen dam pa drug cu tsam bsten nas mnyes pa gsum gyis zhabs tog sgrub/ ba/'a gdams gsar rnying / dwags shangs zhi gcod/ jo zhal bo dong sogs gangs ljongs 'dir yongs su grags pa'i rgyal bstan ris su ma chad pa'i chos tshul ji sged pa la gsan sgom ya bral du ma song bar mdzad/ khyad par du mtshungs med kun dga' rgyal mtshan / rdzogs chen pa kun dga' bkra shis/ sman rtseb blo gros rgyal mtshan/mkhas grub chen po ma ti dh+wa dza/ byams lding ba khu dbon sogs thun min gyi bla ma dam pa du ma las rang lugs snga 'gyur ba'i bka' gter rgya mtsho'i chos rgyun yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po lta bu spyi dang / bye brag tu kun mkhyen chos rje'i bsha' srol snying thig ya bzhi/ mdzode bdun/ ngal gso skor gsum/ rang grol skor gsum sogs kyis mtshon phrin las bka' srung dang bcas pa mtha' dag la don gnyer chen pos gsan bsam sgom pa'i pha rol tu phyin par mdzad/ khyad par grub mchog rig 'dzin gong ma'i phyag srol ltar dben pa'i gnas mchog rnams su bganya gter dag snang gi chos sde du ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi zhal phyes te snying po'i sgrub pa la

30 rnamatharartsegacig par gzhol ba'i mthus yi dam gyi lha du ma'i zhal gzigs shing lung bstan thob / rang don bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen gyi dgongs pa la mnga' dbang 'byor/gzhan don bsnyen sgrub las sbyor mthar phyin par thugs su chud pas rgyud gzhung nas bstan pa ltar gsang sngags bon gyer du ma song bar las rab 'byams sgrub pa'i mthu thob/ dgung grangs zhe gnyis pa shing lug gi lor grwa nang dar rgyas chos gling gi ri khrod rten dang brten par bcas pa phyag btab/ thar pa don gnyer gyi tshogs pa lnga brgyar long ba tsam 'dus pa la dbyar dgun ston dged de dus tshigs so so'i dus mchod dang / chos khrid/ dbang lung zhal gdams sogs 'khrigs su bcad pa dang / gdul bya so so'i mos pa dang 'tshams pa'i chos bga' du ma'i khrid nan tan chen pos gsungs par mdzad pa'i mthus mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi slob tshogis mang du bskrun pa ni/ zhwa dmar ba dkon mchog 'bangs/ 'bri gung zur pa sogs dus der grags pa'i skyes chen du ma dang / sprul sku byang chub gling pa/snang rtsepa gar gyi dbang po/ bde chen gling pa sogs gter ston chen po rnams dang /dpal lding rab 'byams pa dang / dpal khang lo tsā ba sogs yongs su grags pa'i mkhas pa du ma dang / khyad pa5 du bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po dang / thugs sras kun dgazha grags pa/ sha mi dpal 'byor rgyal mtshan sogs rang lugs snying po'i bka' srolalon nus pa'i skyes r+sā du ma/ sa skyong yar 'brog pa dang

rnamathar 3sde pa 'phyong rgyas pa sogs mi chen du ma/ gzhan yang dbus gtsang mnga' ris khams dang kong mon tshun chad du chos brgyud 'dzin pa'i slob ma yang slob dang bcas pa mang du byung / mdor na snga 'gyur rnying ma'i bstan lon sas kyi dbus su chos kyi 'phrin las nyi zla ltar gsal ba mngon sum du grub ces bsngags pa don dang lngan/mthar dgung grangs don bdun par g.yo ru khra 'grug gi gtsug lag khang gi nye 'dabs su gsas sku'i bkod pyore zhig chos kyidabyings su stsal༅ tshul bstan pa na sngaphyi thams to du gdul bya dang ba 'dren pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i ltas snang du ma mngon gyur du 'alo bar mdzad do//zab mo'i nang rgyud sde gsum dgongs ye ba༅//thun min man ngag gsang ba'i lam mchog nas/ /'ja' las chos skur gshegs ༄pa'i ngo mtshar 'bar/ /marlo skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig/ //

32 /pa thar7/ chos rje pad+ma gling pa'i sprul sku bstan 'dzin grags pa ni/ gangs ljongs yul dbus kyi sa yi char ldan lung rgan lar grags pa'i grong tsho zhig na/ ya rabs chos ldan gyi rigs las byung ba yab bkra shis dang yum bsam gtan bzang mo gnyis kyi sras su ngo mtshar ba'i dge mtshan gyi rnam pa du ma dang bcas te sku bltams / gter lung tshad thub rnams nas rig lodzin pad+ma gling pa'i sprul skur gsal bar bsngags shing gsung bye ba tsam nas sngon gnas rjes dran gyi bag chags gsal bar bstan pas rtsod med sprul pa'i sku chen por yid ches/ gzhon nu'i dus chug zhi zhing des la snying rje dang phan sems che ba sogs thegapa chen po'i rigs kyi rtags rnams ma 'dres par gsal bas kun gyi yid 'phrog /dgung lo bzhi par pad gling gong ma'i sras rnams kyis bum thang du spyan drangs/ so so'i gdan sa rnams su zhabs sor bkod pas kun gyis mchod cing bkur/ gter sras dkon mchog bzang po'i gdung tshab kyi tshul du rgyun mar bzhugs pa las/ rig gnas phran tshegs rnams dang chos bka' yang ci rigs pa gsan bzhes mdzad pa rnams dka' tshegs med par khong du chud/ daying lo bcu bzhi la babs pa na sprul sku sna tshogis rang grol gyis gangs ljongs sa yi thig le g.yo ru grwa nang dar rgyas chos ldings su bkur bsnyi zab rgyas bcas gdan 'dren zhus/ mdo sngags rig gnas yan lag dang bcas pa dang gsar rnying ris su ma chad pa'i chos rgyun

sathar 33grags che ba phal mo che rnams dang / khyad par rang lugs kun mkhyen chen po dang pad gling chos skor yongs rdzogs kyi smin byed dbang dang / grol byed khrid/rgyab rten lung / man ngag phyag bzhes dang bcas pa thams cad chig rdzogs su gsan sgom sbrags mar mdzad/ nyi shu par lho brag tu byon pas brag dkar dgon gnas sogs kyis mtshon sngon gyi bu slob yon bdag thams cad kyis gas pas btud cing 'bul ba gya nom pas mchod/ der yun tsam bzhugs te bla ma dbu mdzad pa las dbang lung ci rigs pa dang / gdangs dbyangs rol mo dang // gar 'chams phyag rgya sogs la gsan sbyang mdzad/ slar bod du phebs te rigs bdag sprul sku sna tshogis rang grol dang / gzhan yang sa skya bdag chen/ rje btsun grol mchog māng rtserig 'dzin sogs yongs 'dzin du ma las zab rgyas kyi chos sgo rnam grangs mtha' yas pa rnams thugs yid tshim par gsan/ mchims phu sogs sgrub gnas byin rlabs can du mar zab lam snying po'i sgrub pa la nan tan mdzad pas gnas lugs don gyi ye shes rjen cer du gzigs/ lhag pa'i lha du mas zhal gzigs lung bstan thob cing grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por son/ de nas chos rje sna tsho+ogs rang grol nas phyi mtha' gzigs pa'i zhal gdams dang dgon gnas rten gsum bu slob zab chos dang bcas pa pha phog tu stsal te gdan sar dbang bskur gzengs bstod mdzad/ chos kyi rje zhi bar gzims rjes dam pa gong ma

34 /pathararnams dang tshul mthun par dgejas rdzogs rten bzhengs mchod 'bul dang /dgrar dgun sogs kyi+o sgrub mchod che phra/ dbang lung gdams pa'i 'chad spel sogs kyis mtshon bu slob yon bdag rnams bya mos byi'u gsos pa ltar bskyangs pas 'phrin las mtha' ru rgyas/ rgyal sras pad+ma chos rgyal/ byang bdag dbang po'i sde sogs che dgu rnams kyis grus shing b.lo pas mtshon lto rān dang gtsang rong sogs mtha' dbus kyi gdul bya mang po'i don mdzad cing thar pa'i sa la bkod/khyad par du rigs sras pad+ma phrin las nyid chos dang zang zing gnyis kas bskyed bsrings te bstan 'gror sman pa'i skyes bu chen po'i sa la bkod/ 'khrungs yuladu dgon gnas 'debs par bka' bsgos pa ltar 'brug yul sgang steng gsang sngags chos gling gi dgon gzhi rten dang brten par bcas pa bskrun nas bstan 'gro'i dge mtshan gcig tu gyur/ dbus su phebs te rje snatshogs rang grol gyi mchog sprul ngos 'dzin dang 'brel gdan sar spyan drangs/ mdo sngags rig gzhung rnams dang gnas kyi khyad par gong ma'i zab chos rnams kyi dbang lung man ngag dang bcas pa stsal zhing bstan pa'i bdag po chen por mnga' gsol dbugs dbyung dang smon lam mtha' rgyas su mdzad/ de ltar 'gro don mthar phyin te dgung lo drug cu re gnyis pa me mo bya lo nag zla'i tshes nyer brgyad la kun gyi mthun snang du ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas grwa nang dar rgyas chos ldings su gzugs sku re zhig chos
dze— tho byestok+ṣiṃdz+nya/ sbyitso༄snorig/ khaṃrītsūspre+o~X

36 /pathar tsa/ bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan gcig tu gyur pa mkhas grub mdo sngags bstan 'dzin ni/bod ljongs yāl dbus kyi sa yi cha g.yo ru dol zhes bya bar yab smyos ston chen po na rje tshe dbang dang yum mtshan lngan ma bsod nams bu 'khrid gnyis kyi sras su me pho khyi ba'i lor yul gyi snod bcud la dge mtshan du ma mngon gsal mthun snang du 'char ba dang bcas te sku bltams/ che rgu gzhan la re ltos med par rje sna tshogs rang grol gyi sngon rabs gsal bar gsungs pas yang srid 'khrul med du nges pa rnyed/gzhon nu rtsed 'jo la rol ba'i dus nas kyang dam pa'i ngang tshul kho na la gzhol bas theg mchog rigs kyi rtags rnams mngon gyur du gsal/ dgung lo drug pa'i steng gong ma'i gdan sar spyan drangs te 'griklog dang phrin sgrubasogs lathugs sbyong gnang dbu tshugs pas tshegs med du khong du chub pas 'khor rnams dga' ba dang yid ches pa'i sa la bkod/ dgung lo brgyad par zhwa dmar dkon mchog 'bangs las nges par byung ba'i blo dang bcas dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa nos/ mtshan dkon mchog 'od zer du gsol/ bcu gsum par rgyal dbang bstan 'dzin grags pa sogs mkhan slob dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su rab tu byung / mtshan mdo sngags bstan 'dzin bzang por gsol/ bstan 'dzin grags pa sogs bshes gnyen mang du bsten nasakun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po dang pad+ma gling pa'i chos skor yongs rdzogs kyi dbang khrid gdams pa man ngag phyag bzhes dang bcas pa mtha'

snamathar 37rgyas su gsan/ gzhan yang thugs sras kun dga' grags pa/ grub chen kun dga' rdo rje/ sngags 'chang kun bzang dpal 'byor/ rgyal sras nor bu dbang rgyal / byang bdag dbang po'i sde sogs rnying ma dang / sa skya khri chen/ karma pa zhwa dmar nag sogs gsar ma ste ris meng/ bzhes gnyen khyad 'phags du ma las snga phyir chos bka' ji snyed cig gsan bzhes mthil phyin par mdzad/ dgung lo bco brgyad la phebs pa na/ 'bras yul skyed tshal du 'bum ram pa thar pa rgyal mtshan las sdus tshad dbu phar 'dul mngon sogs gzhung chen mo rnams la nan tan du gsan sbyang mdzad pas chos rwa der mtshan snyan gyi grags pas khyab/ bzo gso sgra snyan sdeb sbyor sogs thun mong rig pa'i gnung tshan rnams kyang mkhas par mkhyen/nyer lnga pa la rkarma pa dgu pas thugs 'phrog ste skar chenadam pa'i gdan sa'i 'bel gtam gleng bar bskul ba na/ der lo gsum ring mdo sngags rig gnas lo rgyus dang bcas pa la 'chad rtsod rtsom pa sogs mdzad pas blo lngan rnams kyang ngo mtshar zhing bsngags pa'i me tog 'thor/ dus skabs ci rigs par mchims phu/g.ya' ma lung / lho brag sogs gnas chen rnams su snying po'i sgrub pa la rtsegacig tu gzhol bas bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i ye shes mngon du gyur/ gu ru rin po che dang rje btsun sgrol mas mtshon lhag pa'i lha du mas zhal gzigs shing lung bstan thob pas rang don gyi 'bri ba rbad kyis chad/ gas na lho dbus kyi gdan

38 napa thar sa rnams dang / dad pa'i zhing du mar zhabs btegs te thun mong dang thun min gyi dbang khrid gdams pa du mas gzhan don phyogs med du mdzad/ rigs sras gsang bdag chen po/ rdzogs chen nam mkha' 'grug sgra/ mnga' bdag bstan 'dzin chos dbang / spa gro ba chos dbang lhun grub/ mang thos dam chos bzang po sogs zab gter gyi bka' srol 'dzin pa rnams dang / gzhan yang gsung gi gsang ba 'dzin pa'i slob ma mkhas grub dgongs nyams can du mas dbus gtsang lho mon gyi phyogs thams cad du khyab/ sa skyong sku rab pa/ bya pa khri dpon/ 'phyong rgyas stag rtseb/ yar klung pho brang ba sogs rigs dang longs spyod kyis masoba'i yon bdag du mas dbu yi mchod gnas su bkur/ gdul bya rnams la blang dor lkog gyur gyi gnas rnams gsal por lung bstan/ lho brag bkra shis sgang gi ri bor 'dus sde btab ste yun ring banugs/ chag byang chub gling du rdzogs chen bla brgyud kyis mtshone rten bzhengs du ma dang / chos 'khor bsam yas dang lha sa sogs su snga phyi mang por mchod 'bul dang smon lam/ bshad sgrub kyi 'dus sde rnams su tshogs gsog gi yo byad du mas bsnyen bkur ba sogs bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen po mdzad/ de ltar dgung lo nga gsum pa sa pho 'grug lor rnam thar zhal gsungs ma las/ khyad par brgyud 'dzin bu la dbang lung dang / /man ngag khrid lung mang po bar med bshad/ /gsang chen bstan pa lodzan pa'i rten 'brel

napa thar 39bsgrigs / r+ṣa ni bya ba zin pas 'gyod pa med/ /'chi bar dga' ba'i mdo sngags bstan 'dzin nga / /gdod ma'i sa la gtan srid zin du 'gro/ /zhes sogs 'chi ba 'od gsal chos skur sbyong ba'i gdeng dang bcas tha tshig zhal gdams rgyas par stsal ba'i mthar/ dar rgyas chos ldings kyi dben gnas su ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor re zhig zhi ba'i dbyengs su snyoms par zhugs pa'i tshul bstan to/ /rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs don bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /mkhas grub bye ba'i zhal nas snyan du brgyud/ /rtog ge ngan pa'i rang bzos ma bslad pa/ /mtsho snaskyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig/ /// sdu ༄

stso/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi yang srid gsang bdag phrin las lhun grub ni/ yab smyos kyi gdung rabs sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa brgyud mar byon pa'i rigs las mkhas grub chen po mdo sngags bstan 'dzin zhes bya ba mkhyen brtsenus pa'i bdag nyid chen po de dang / yum rje rigs dgos 'dzoms pa zhes bya ba ma smad pa'i yon tanadang lngan pa gnyis kyi sras su lcags mo phag gi lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes nyer drug res gzar zla ba rgyu skar nam gru la spyod pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar ba dang lhan cig yum la gnod pa med par bltams/ de ma thag yab rje rig 'dzin chen pos tshe dbang dang / gur drag /rta mgrin rnams kyi sgo nas bar chad bsrung ba'i byin rlabs dang blo no ba'i rten 'brel mdzad cing mtshan a rgyan tshe 'phel du gsol/ dgung lo lnga pa nas yi ge 'bri klog rnams byang bar mkhyen/brgyad pa la yab rje'i drung du dge bsgen gyi sngom pa gsan/ de nas brtsams te phrin sgrub phyag bzhed rnams mkhyen par mdzad/ kun mkhyen chen po'i gsung rab rnams dang / sgra rtsis sogs tha snyad rig pa'i gnas kun la'ang sbyangs pa mdzad pas blo gros kyi mthu thob/ khyad par yab rje las bla rdzogs thugs gsum sgrub sde brgyad sogs bga' gteji gyi dbang khrid bzhad lung du ma bum r+pāgang 'thi tshul du gsan cing gtan la phab/ skyes chen gtsug lag rgya mcho las rab tu byung zhing mtshan phrin las lhun grub dpal bzang por stsal/ gsung chos kyang ci

rnam thar 41rigs pa gsan/ gzhan yang gsung sprul tshul khrims rdo rje/ lo chen gzhan phan rdo rje/ lha btsun kun bzang rnam rgyal/ rdzogs chen pa 'grug grags bzang po/ bon lung pa tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ zur chos dbyings rang grol/'khrul zhig nor bu chos brtan sogs rnying ma dang / rgyal tshab grags pa mchog dbyangs / mgon po bsod nams mchog lngan sogs gsar ma ste/ dor na gsar rnying gi bla ma dam pa sum cu lhag tsam bsten nas mdo sngags kyi chos tshul mtha' yas pa ngoms pa med par gsan/ bye brag 'dus pa mdo'i dbang ni dgung lo brgyad pa la sngags 'chang dpal 'gru+or byang chub gling du spyan drangs te yab rje dang lhan du zur lugs dang khams lugs gnyis ka gsan/ nyer gcig pa la lha btsun kun bzang rnam rgyal las kyang khams lugs kyi yi ge'i steng nas gsan par grags/ nyi shu rtsadagu pa sa yos hor zla bzhi par gong ra lhun grub sdings su ma hā lo tsā ba gzhan phan rdo rje'i drung du 'dus pa mdo'i rtsab dang yan lag gi dkyil 'khor thams cad rdul tshon gyis ba'engs par gnyawapa bde legs pa'i yige'i sdeng nas chu bo bzhi rdzogs kyi dbang gtad rgya sgom rim man ngag dang bcas pa sgrub chen gyi las rim dang 'brel zhag bcu bdun gyi b.rayongs su dzo+ogs par gsan/ gong ra lo chen nas kho bos ska/la lngan la chos sbyin lhag par chi la ba las 'am/ bu chos mi 'tshong gsungs nas chos yon mi bzhes par phyir slog mdzad na'ang /

42 rna6/ thararjes 'dis dbang bum gra tshar dgu phul ba mateg mnyepa kyis bdag gir mdzad rtseg grags te dbang gi chu bo'i snod ldan du gzigs shing bstan pa spel ba'i rten 'brel dang brda thabs bstan par 'dod/ de ltar thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs yin lugs su bcad nas dben pa'i gnas du mar snying po'i lam srol ji bzhin par thugs nyams su bzhes pas/ ma dag pa'i snang ba 'gog nus pa'i bskyed rim gyi gsal snang la reg mthong gi mtshan ma thob ste phrin las gang brtsams thogs med du grub/rdzogs rim ka dag gzhi rdzogs 'pho 'gyur med pa'i gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin lam du lhongs pas 'bor 'das bden 'dzin gyi 'khri ba chad/ snang srid lhun grub 'od gsal gyi klong du dengs pas yi dam gyi lha du ma'i gzigs snang shar zhing lung bstan thob/ rang don mtshan 'dzin gyi rtog pa zhig pas gzhan phan mkha' khyab kyi thugs rje rtsol med shugs byung gi snonas thar pa don gnyer gyi skal ldan mchog dmanamang por bshad sgrub kyi chos 'khor rgyun chags su bskor zhing bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgyas par mdzad/ khyad par sku gsung thugs kyi sras mchog gter chen 'gyur med rdo rje la zab rgyas kyi chos thams cad tshang sprugs su stsal te rgyal tshab tu mnga' dbang bskur/ mthar dgung grangs nga gnyis pa chu stag dbo zla'i nyer gnyis la dbu gtsug phyur bur 'phar ba las zla ba'i zil pa skya chil le ba spos dud lta bu'i rlangs pa 'phro bzhin du gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus par grags
khri/d+ngha/dzordzotram̐ skyi/ṣ+yo//t+yā r+shaskyophohūṃlunu k+ṣirborke 44ji yin 5stsu sme/stsu7

44 /pathar 7/ gter chen sku mched rnams kri yum du gyur pa lha 'dzin dgrangs can sgrol ma ni/yab shākya li tsa bi'i rigs las mched pa chos rgyal gyi gdung brgyud dri ma med pa mnga' bdag gnam lde 'od srungs kyi sras dpal 'khor btsan/ de la sras gnyis kyi chung ba bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal/ de la sras gsum gyi 'bring po 'od sde/ de la sras bzhi byung ba las khri chung gi sras 'od 'bar/ de la sras bdun gyi dang po khri sde 'bar/ de la sras drug gi nang nas g.yu thog pa'i brgyud pa la / sna mo ba/ phyi nga ba/ don dkar ba/ thang 'khor ba sde bzhi las/ sna mo/ ba'i brgyud yar rgyab tu mched de grwa'i rtags rje mkhar dang bde skyid gling sogs bzung / bde skyid gling pa las 'jad ldum pa ba'i gdung rigs mched de ldum chen don grub dbang rgyal gyi gcung nor bu dar rgyas dang / yum 'brang brgyud ma rmas pa gzhung se lung rdzong gsar pa'i lcam la/ rab rgyal mig dmar zhes pa shing pho khyi ba'i lo spyi lo 1624 la g.yor po grwa'i phu bkra shis mthong smon gi ga'is khar 'khrungs/ rgyu skar gyi rten 'brel las mtshan lha 'dzin dgrangs can sgrol ma zhes gsol/ yul srol ltar btsas ston dang sgo 'khrid ston mo sogs rgyas par mdzad/ sku chung ngu'i dus nas rigs kyi nus pa sad pa'i rtags su bzod pa ngang / byams snying rje sogs ya rabs dam pa'i spyod tshul lhan skyes su mnga' / rang gi rmo rmo dang / yab yum sku mched sogs kyi yid du 'ong zhing shin

rnamathar 45tu byams pas bskyed bsrings/ 'bri klog rig pa'i gnas rnams tshegs med par mkhyen/ skabs zhig rdzong gsar du theg pa na/ btsan grags pa dgra 'dul khog tu zhugs pa zhig gis/ bu mo 'di bsod nams chen po 'ong / zhes gsungs shing dar mdud cig kyang byin/ sku cung zad nar son pa'i tshe/ sa skya pa zhabs drung sgar chen dang / 'tsher lung pa kun dga' rnam rgyal las tshe rta'i dbang sogs dang / mkhan po shākya rin dbang las tshe dbang grub rgyal ma dang / rnam rgyal ma'i rjes gnang / zhal slob bla ma tshe mtshams par grags pa las bde mchog gi dbang dang / rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs sogs zhus/ yang a mi bgres mo dang mnyam du kun mkhyen mdo sngags bstan 'dzin gyi gcung po na lung 'khrul zhig las/phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid bka' yang gsan/ rtag tu mgon med dbul phongs rnams la byams shing brtsebs zas nor sogs zang zing gi sbyin pas skyong ba dang / gsod du nye ba'i phyugs lug sogs la mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pas dbugs dbyung bar byed pa sogs 'khor g.yog zho shas skyong ba la shin tu mkhas/de nas dgung lo nyi shu rtsagrangs kyi dus su/ gnubs chen gyi rnam sprul rig 'dzin gsang bdag dpa' po phyin las lhun grub la/ tshi ru rin po che'i dbang rten srin po'i bu mo bde chen rgyal mos/ tsā nag shel dkar mcho sgron gyi/ /sprul pa byi lo dbyangs can ming / /rang gnas grwa yi phyogs nas 'byung / /srog la bab 'dra'i

46 satharanyes skyon skyob/ /ces lung bstan pa bzhin/ smon lam dag pa'i byang chub sems ma mi mo'i gzugs su bstan pa lha 'dzin dbyangs can sgrol ma nyid khab tu bsus / me gyi lor sku sras 'gran zla dang bral ba rig 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rje sku bltams/ sa byi lor gcung rgyal sras bstan pa'i nyi ma dang / de'i gcung 'khrungs ma thagagashegs pyoslar lcags mo yos 'a/ srid du 'bor ba sras mo bsod ltas dpalalechas/ shing rta'i lor lo chen rin po che ngag dbang chos dpal rgyal mamo/ de 'og me sprel lor gcung rje dbon phyag mdzod kun dga' tshul khrims / sa phag lor sku'i sring mo lha cig dpal 'dzoms te/ sras lcam sring bdun 'khrungs shing / de dag gi tsha spa gro choso dbang lhun grub dang lhan du yab rje rig 'dzin 'a po las/ rming ma'i rgyud 'bum dang bla ma dgongs 'dus sogs chos bgazhi mtha' yas pa gsan/gzhan yang pad gling gsung sprul tshul khrims r+sā / thugs sras sprul pa'i sku/ bon lung rin d+ku / spa gro 'i rje rnams las kyang chos ba/kha mang du gsanate bla ma dang dkonamachog rnams la dad mos che zhing lta spyod rnam dag gis rgyud bsdams/ gzhan yang rig 'dzin bla ma sgrub pa'i nyams bzhes mdzad pa sogs spong ba bsam gtan gyi 'bor lo la gcig tu brtson par mdzad/ dpal ri sprul pa'i sku sogs las bka' brgyad bde 'dus dang /the se bla ma sogs las pad gling gasto chosatshang ma'i dbang lung khrid bcas gsan/

rnamathar 47yang rig 'dzin chen po dang lhan du gnas chen rnams la mchod pa dang ris med pa'i dge 'dun la ja 'jam mang 'gyed sogs bstab cing / ji zhig na dar rgyas chos gling gi gtsug lag khang rnying zhing khog pa la rtsig meng nas brtsams te/ 'du khang ka ba bcu drug thog brtsegs gsum pa/ bla brang gi khang mig du ma bcas gsar bzhengs mdzad pa'i tshe yum nyid nas shing cha bsgrub pa la byang kha sogs su theg /las mi nyung ngus lo de'i nang du grub nas rab gnas mnga' gsol gyi stonamo rnams mdzad / gzhan yang nyid kyi gse ra g.yang la grang gser btul te bka' brgyad kyi thang mo che bcu gcig dang / pad gling yang gsang skor dgu sogs bris thang mang po dang / pad gling gter chos kyis mtshon bka' gter gyi glegs bam brgya phrag tu nye ba gsar du bzhengs par mdzad pa sogs rig 'dzin chen po'i dgongs pa banin dge tshogs kyilas rlabs po che sgrub pa la spro zhing zhum pa med pa'i snying stobs phul du byung ba sogs mdor na 'khor lo gsum gyi bya bas dus 'da' ba dang gdul bya mtha' dag yal bar mi gtong bar don yod par byas/ de nas chu pho stag spyi lo 1lo2 la yab rje rig 'dzin chen po dgongs pa zhi dbyings su mnal ba na/phyag dzosdo gang yod rnams sku 'dad kyi dgongs rdzogs bsgrubs/ khyad par rang gi zhal phud kyi gser bsdus pas gzhi bsdums nas gser dngul gang yod la phyi rten gser zangs mchod rten dang / dar rgyas chos gling gi dbu rtsedang / gseng

48 rnamatharagayabs kyi 'debs ris/ sman 'dam gyi gzims mal 'dra 'bag dang /'phags yul rig 'dzin brgyad kyi snang brnyan sogs mang du bzhengs/ grwa mang 'dus pa spyi la mang 'gyed/ dam pa rnams la mchod 'bul bsten bkur dang bsngo rten/ ngan long la sbyin gtong sogs mdor na sku chas thams cad sku 'dad la sprugs te btang / zhabs phyi rnams kyis 'di 'dra rang gtong ba che drags/ da dung rang re'i dgon gog 'di 'dzin dgos pa min nam zhu ba byung / de'i skabs nyin mo thugs ngal gyis non par gyur kyang / mtshan mo dag snang zab mo la 'byams klas pa las nyin mo'i bag chags gtan nas mi rgyu ba dang / khyad par nub gcig gi rmi lam na dgon pa rang gi grwa rnying zhing gshegs pa rtogs ldan pad+ma ye shes dang /dbu mdzad bstan 'dzin don lngan zung dang lhan cig bar snang la byon te/ ji zhig na ri chen po rtsemo mkha' la sgegs pa 'dra ba'i logs shig tu phug pa zhig 'dug pa/der dge slong nam mkha'i snying po yin rgyu ba'i rab byung zhig 'dug pa de la mos gus mdzad par phyag spyi bor bzhag nas ru lu'i sngags sogs mang du gsungs pas thugs rgyud la bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams 'bar/ de nas gyen du 'dzegs pas khang bzang yid 'ong zhig 'a dug pa'i nang du byon pas rig 'dzin chen po dang mjal / de nyid a rgyan rin po che'i skur song ba na gsol ba drag tu btab pas/gu ru'i zhal nas/ nga dang rtsaba'i bla ma so sor ma blta/ gcig tu bsdus nas

rnam thar 49gsol ba thob/ 'di phyi'i gnyis don thamasacad 'grub bo gsung / dag pa'i zhing 'di gar bsdad snyam pa la/ gu ru'i zhal nas phaṭa drag po zhig mdzad pas mnal had kyis sad pa byung / yang nub cig sngar rang dgon gyi btsun ma karma g.ya nga can bya ba des rgyal mtshan zhig phyag tu phul byung ba bsnams te mkha' la 'phur ba las ri spomatho 'gru'i phung po spungs pa lta bu zhig gi rtser slebs pa dang rig 'dzin chen po dang mjal zhing / bla ma zlum po bzhi dbang stsal zhing tha tshig gi bslab bya mang du gsungs / khyad par nga dang bral ba la sdug bsngal ma byed/ rig pa'i ngo na rang re 'du 'bral med/ brgyud 'dzin gyi bu sngar gyi lung bstan bzhin nyi zla ltar gsal bar 'ong bas/ khyed kyi don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub bo/ /zhes gsungs shing slar rang nyid bar snang la yer gyis bteg pa dang lhan du mnal sad/ yab rje rig 'dzin chen po gshegs rjes/ dgon pa rang gi grwa rgan mchog 'gyur zhes pa rje bla ma dam pa'i slob dpon che 'dzin du re ba ma 'grub pa'i rkyen gyis/ gsung sprul rin po cher rdzun sgrigs kyi snyan phra mang du phul ba dang / rkyen dbang sogs la brten thugs sras rin po che sogasdori kyis bka' bku+on chen po stsal na'ang / de rnams la ci mdzad legs mthong gi dag snang chen pos dad log ci yang ma mdzad par thusas sbam par gnas pa sogs dge ba'i las la snying stobs phul du byung zhing /ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar du mas brgyan pa rgyal yum dgrangs can sgrol ma'i chos mthun

50 rmam thar gyi mdzad pa rnams btus te bris pa las mdzad pa tha ma'i tshul yig cha ma rnyed nga sa re zhig de tsam gyis mtha' rdzogs par byas so/ /ngo sa ka nas dag pa'i ye shes la/ /rang ba'in lhun gyis grub pa'i gdangs shar bas/ /blun sgom sems las 'das pa'i rdzogs pa che/ /ma skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig/ //994

rnam thar 51tsa/ khri rabs dang po lo ༄na be+e ro'i rnam sprul khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po pad+ma gar dbang 'gyur med rdo rje'5/ a rgyan sater bdag gling pa ni/ de yang tha snyad dag gzigs tshad ma'i dbang du na sngon bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i gong rol nas dpal o ḍi ya na'i slob darngo4ོna chen po dang gnyis su med par mtha' yas zhing khams rab 'byams rnams su sku gsum gyi ston pa rgya mtsho'i ngo thore bzhugs pa las ma g.yos bzhin pu thun mong tshur mthong gdul bya'i ngor zhus pa med pa'i snying stobs mchog gi pha rol tu son cing / bsod nams dang ye shes kyi chu gter zab mo mngon par bsrubs pa'i cha/dzad pa phul du byung ba las/ thub pa'i dbang po 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir byon pa'i tshe nye gnas chen po kun dga' bo dang /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir khyab brdal du dar ba'i lung bstan dus la babs pa'i tshe rgyal po dza'am lung bstan rdo rje dang / grub pa'i rig 'dzin chen po brgyad las phur pa rnge rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas dngos grub rnam pa gnyis la dbang 'byor pa slob dpon sha༈ gasnyi dang / bod yul kha ba can du 'phags pa sems nyid ngal gso'i rnam rol mnga' bdag srong btsan sgam pos dam pa'i chos kyi srol gtod cing babazhi khrims bzang pos gnya' ba mnan pa dang / mtha' yi yul khams mang po dbang du 'du ba'i tshe mdun na 'don gyi gan bor bkur ba thon mi sam bho ṭa dang / gnam ka ba med pa'i 'og rol du lha btsan

52 napatharapo khri srong lde'u ba' gyis 'dzam gling sum gnyis dbang du bsdus shing / mnyam med bu ram shing pa'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che dkar 'byams yug gcig gis gangs ljongs mtha' dbus kun tu khyab par mdzad pa'i tshe sgra bsgyur lo tsā ba thams cad kyi khyu mchog tu gyur pa le chen bai ro tsa na dang / gzhan yang zur shākya 'byung gnas/ gter ston grwa pa mngon shes/ rong zom chos kyi bzang po/ ra shag gter ston chos 'bar/ rdo rje gling pa 'jam dpal chos kyi bshes gnyen/pad+ma kun skyong gling pa/ gter ston mchog ldan mgon po sogs rnam rol 'gag pa med par dag pa dang ma dag pa'i gdul bya rnams kyi khams dbang mos pa dang mthun par bsam bzhin srid pa bzung ba'i tshul re re nas smros kyis mi lang ba nyid do/ /khyad par slob dpon pad+ma sam bha was zab gter gsang ba'i rgyas gdab pa dman pa'i spyod yul du ma gyur zhing dam pa'i chos kyi mnga' thang chen po la mngon par dbang bsgyur ba'i rgyal thabs kyi phrin las rmad du byung ba bdag gir bzhes pa'i dus la babs pa na/ thang yig las/ chos log khrims ral dam nyams lung pa gang:lha mi'i gnas su gtam ngan gragajiṭa pas khyab: sha 'ug ltag sgor sbas pa'i gter kha 'di: mi bzhag 'don pa'i rtags de bstan nas byung: a rgyan gter bdag gling pa zhes bya 'byung: zhes gsungs pa ltar bsil ldan gho ṭa'i ljongs su gdong dmar srin po'i rigs las byung ba'i dmu rgod kyi gdul bya mi srun pa

rnam thar 53rnams thabs la mkhas pa'i phrin las kyis 'dul ba'i phyir/ 'jigs bral gyi slob dpon chen po phyoges thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba pad+ma gar dbang 'gyur med rdo rje zhes grags snyan gyi ba dan dkar po lhab lhub tu g.yo bas/ chos dbyengs sa par dag pa'i mkha' dbyengs su ye shes smi mor byed pa'i dkyiro 'khor 'gro ba rnams kyi skyabs dang skyob pa bla na med par mtshan dbe'i gzugs sku gsar du bzhad pa'i tshul ni/ yab gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi yang srid snga 'gyur bapokha gter thams cad kyi bstan pa'i bdag po mkhas grub chen po smyos ston gsang bdag phrin las lhun grub dang / yum shākya li tsā bi'i rigs las mched cing bod chos rgyal gyi gdung brgyud dri ma med pa rje zlum po 38 grub dbang rgyal sku mched kyi sras mo/ shel dkar rdo rje 'tsho'i sprul par lung gis zin pa'i rnal 'byu+or ma lha 'dzin dbyangs can sgrol ma zhes/ des pa dang bag yod gtong phod pa sogs mdzangs pa'i yon tan du mas brgyan pa gnyis kyi sras su/ rab byung bcu gcis pa'i me khyi dbyed ra dbo nya ba'i yar ngo'i tshes dga'i mawo gyi mthun tha mar nye ba tshos zhag bcu par slebs pa'i dus su sa g.yo ba dang / 'od chen po'i snang ba dang mkha' la 'ja' tshon shar ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i dge mtshan du ma dang bcas te grwa nang rig pa'i 'byung gnas sam dar rgyas chos gling gi gzims spyil 'od gsal/ rtser yum la gnod pa med par sku bltams/ de yang skye ba'i phreng ba bcu gsum

54 /pa thar pa lho nub rnga yab gling du srin po'i rigs las mchog sga dngos grub brnyes pa srin po chos kyi go cha nyid 'chi srid 'od gsal gyi dbyengs su bsdus palas rig mdangs ma 'gags par mkha' 'gro'i snang glus bskul ba'i rkyen gyis ye shes kyi sku he ru ka'i rnam par bzhengs nas lhums su nugs pa na/ yab rje gsang bdag chen po'i mnal lam du mtshan dang ldan pa'i bud med gcig gis hriḥyig dmar po snyim pa gang phul ba zhal du gsol ba dang/ yum la'ang bu mo mtshar sdug can zhig gis mchod rten khru gang tsam pa gcig gtad nas/ 'di nyar tshogs dam par gyis zer ba dang / gzhan yang nyi ma shar ba dang / gtsang chab las sgrol 'don byed pa dang /rol mo 'ule ba sogs ya mtshan pa'i ltas mang po rmis pa byung ngo / /btsas ma thag yab rje rig 'dzin r+sā pos sku khyus gsol zhing zlo rno ba'i rten 'brel dang bar chad srung ba'i cho ga sogs dbang bskur byin rlabs rnams mdzad/ mtshan kun dga' rin chen dbang gyi rgyal po zhes gsol/ pang du 'arlo ba'i dus nyid nas ting nge 'dzin la dbang 'byor ba'i nyams dang lo gsum gyi bar dag pa'i snang bar dzo gi sngo sangs thor tshugs can rus rgyan 'chang ba zhig dang / bud med mdzes sdug can gnyis kyis rgyun du sri zhu byas pa byung / gzhon nu rol rtsed kyi dus nyid nas bshad sgrub las gsum gyi mdzad pa la mos pa'i rnam 'gyur dang / rdzu 'phrul dang mngon par shes pa'i cha shas ston pa sogs byis pa 'i spyod yul las 'das shing dam pa'i

rnam thar 55 sgyurigs sad pa'i mngon rtags bzang rgu ngoms pa ni/ mdo sde rgyan las / sbyor ba'i sngon du snying rje dang / /bzod pa dang ni mos pa dang / /dge la yang dag sbyor ba ni/ /rigs kyi rtags su shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i ngo/na rnams lhan skyes su mnga' ba'i ngang tshul gyis blo ldan rnams dang ba bskye da par mdzad/ dgung lo bzhi pa'i thog yab rje rig 'dzin chen po las bga' brgyad gsang rdzogs kyi dbang gsan pas yul snang thams cad tshom bu dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor rgyas thebs pa dang dbang bzhi'i sa bon thugs rgyud la smin par byas/ khyad par dregs pa'i srog dbang gi dus snod bcud gzugs brnyan thams cad dregs pa pho mor dngos su gzigs pa'i rngams brjid bstul zhugs kyi rnam pa bstan pa na/ rje bla ma'i zhal nas dregs pa las la khol ba'i nus pa'ang yong bar 'dug /ces lung bstan dbugs dbyung stsal/ dgung lo lnga pa'i skabs lha ldan du theg nas jo therdzo rnam gnyis dang mjal ba'i tshe sngar lan mang mjal ba'i thugs snang 'char ba sogs sngon rabs kyi bag chags mang po sad/ de nas ye ge 'bri klog dang / rang lugs kyi chos spyod dang / bla ma zhi drag sogs la thugs 'dzin mdzad/ dus de tsam na rig 'dzin gong ma rnams kyi sgrub 'phrin ci rigs pa'i phyag khrid gsan pa na brda thabs bstan pa tsam gyis tshegs med par mkhyen cing dgu lo brgyad pa nas yab rje'i sku tshab 'pher ba byung / dgung lo dgu par yab rje rig 'dzin chen po las skyabs

56 rnamatharagasum 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen dang / de rjes kun mkhyen lnga pa chen po las yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa nod de nyes spyod spong ba so so thar pa'i sngom pa dang /slar yang yab rje las byang sngom b.lakha srol gsum ka gsan te bdag gzhan brje ba byang chub kyi sems rin po che thugs rgyud du 'khrungs/ gzhan yang gnas dus ci rigs par/ sprul pa'i sku bzang po dpal dang / lho brag rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma phrin las rnam gnyis las/ srol gnyis kyi thugs bskyed gsan pa nyid nyin re bzhin rten gyi drung chag med du bzhes pas thugs ldobogs chen po thon te gzhan don kho na la gcig tu dgongs pa'i snying stobs chen po rtsole med du 'khrungs/ khyad paradu sngar bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs kyi dbang brda don 'phrod pa thog ma'i smin byed du gsan pa nyid/ dgung lo bcu pa shing lug 'bras ldan gyi dus/ yab rje rig 'dzin chen po las slar bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dbang gsan pa na/nub mo'o da gsal gyi gzigs snang la nags tshal yid du 'ong ba'i dbus su/ ngo bo slob dpon chen po pad+ma yin rgyu 0 snam pa rnal 'byor pa gzi mdangs mtshungs pa med pa 'khor bud med mdzes ma lngas bskor te bzhugs pa las/ bud med lnga pos bum pa bdud rtsi'i chus gang ba dang / thod pa mar khus gang ba dang / mar me'i bong bu/ ral gri me ling rnams so sor rim par gtad nas snga gas rgyas byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshul mdzad/ mthar ston 'khor rnams gcig la gcig

rnamathar —ga zhumo gyis bsdus/ de nyid mthing zhun lta bur gyur nas nam mkha' dang 'dres te dbyings rig gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mkha' khyab spros bral gyi ngang du yal/mnal sad nas kyang bde stong gi nyams ma zhig par gnas pa byung ngo/ /de ltar sngar dbang gi sa bon thugs rgyud la thebs pa cher 'phelate bum dbang gi nyams myong yul snang sgyu ma lta bur gtan la phab/ de ltar gzhan gnod gzhi bcas spong ba sdud thar/ gzhan phan gzhir bcas sgrub pa byang sems/ thams cad mnyam par bltab gsang sngags te sngom pa gsum gyis rgyud bsngams shing bslab pa'i gnas phra mo tsam yang spyan gyi 'bras bu ltar gces spras dang / sgo gsum nyes spyod kyi dri mas dben pa'i ngang nas gzhan don 'ba' zhig sgrub cing / snod bcud dag pa'i 'khor lor 'byongs bas thugs rgyud kyi yon tan ma skyes pa bskyed pa dang / skyes zin spel ba'i gzhi rten du bzung bar mdzad do/ dgung lo bcu gcig pa la yab rje dang lhan cig dpal lngan 'bras spungs su byon/ rgyal ba'i dbang po lnga pa chen po'i drung du gtsug phud phul/ mtshan ngag dbang pad+ma bstan 'dzin zhes stsal/ de skabs skyid grong gi rang byung 'phags pa wā ti thog mar phebs pa dang dus 'grigs pas / gong sa nas rten 'brel shin tu bzang zhes dgyes pa'i dbugs dbyung zhing /de dus 'phags pa'i zhal zhi 'dzum chags pa'i nyams gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas nyid kyi sku la thim pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma byung / dgung

58 nas tharalerdzo bcu bdun par slar bsam yas su rje rgyal ba'i dbang po dang mjal ba'i tshe/'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi rnam par dngos su gzigs/ de ltar kun mkhyen lnga pa chen po dang / yab rje gsang bdag phrin las lhun grub gnyis ni sku dngos kyis rjes su bzung ba'i badzi' drin phul du byung ba ma zad/ phyis ye shes kyi skus kyang byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnad kyis bka' drin mtshungs pa med pa'i rtsaba'i bla ma rnam gnyis su grags/ gzhan yang smin grol zab lam gsan pa'i bstan 'dzin chen po bcu drug /zab chos sna tshogs gsan pa'i yongs 'dzin sum cu rtsalnga rnams bsten te/ mdo dgongs pa 'dus pa/ rgyud sgyu 'phrul drwa ba/ sems snge lugs gsum/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ yang dag /phur pa/ gshed skor sogs snga 'gyur bka' ma deng sang rgyun yod do cog dang / gter ma bla rdzogs thugs gsum sgrub sde spyi dang bye brag gi bka' srol zab la mang ba rnams dang /gsar ma'i rngor phreng / sgrub thabs brgya rtsasogs spyi dang / bde mchog sngom 'byung / dgyes pa rdo rje/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo/ gsang ba 'dus pa/gshin rje gshed kyi skor sogs dang / phyi rgyud kri yog gi dbang khrid bshad lung /gzhan yang mdo phyogs du ma dang thams cad kyi rtsabar gyur pa bka' 'gyur dzo cag gi lung sogs chos bka' gsan pa ni mtha' yas/ dgung lo bcu gsum pa'i thos tsam nas bzung rtsargyud gsang ba snying po/ rgyud bla ma/ sems nyid ngal gso/

rnam thar 59mid bzhin mdzod rtsa'agrel rlams thugs la bzung nas yab rje las bshad khrid rim par gsan/ phyis gnubs chen dang zur pa yab sras rom zom chos kyi bzang po'i gsung rab rin po che rnams dang / sa skya paṇ+ḍi tare sdom gsum rab dbye/bcom lngan 'das rig pa'i ral gri'i rgyud sde spyi rnam/ rang byung zhabs kyi zab mo nang don gyi khrid gzhung rnams thugs su btsud/ khyad par kun mkhyen chen po'i gsung rab rnams la mchog tu dad pa'i sgo nas gzigs rtog nan tan mdzad pas chos rab rnam 'byed kyi mthu thogs pa med pa badz+nyas shing shes bya ji snyed pa'i chos thams cad la sgro 'angogs chod/ gzhan yang dwags ston chos rgyal bstan 'dzin la 'dus pa mdo'i dbang chog rin chen phreng ba'i sdeng nas dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu rtsalngar phye ba las chu bo bzhi yongs rdzogs gtad rgya dang bcas pa/ dbang chog sbrang rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi sdeng nas dkyil 'khor nyi shu rtsagacig ras bris la brten pa'i dbang lung gdams ngag dang bcas pa rga/san/ yang rdo rje brag ris/ 'dzin pad+ma phrin las kyi zhal snga nas dkyil 'khor nyi shu rtsabadun du bsdus pa'i rtsadakyil ras bris dang /tshom bu la brten te dbang chos rin chen phreng ba'i thog nas dbang gdams ngag bshad lung dang bcag pa mtha' rgyas su gsan cing mtshan pad+ma gar dbang 'gyuramed rdo rje dam pa'i rtsal du gsol/ khyad par rnying ma bka' ma dang / gter rnying gi dbang lung rgyun dkon pa rnams la thugs rtsol chen pos gsan par mdzad de bka'

60 rnamatharagater bstan pa'i srog mthud par mdzad/ dam pa'i chos kho na rgyu mtshan du mdzad nas bzhes gnyen mtho dman gyi rtsis gdab med par mdo rgyud man ngag gi gnas thams cad gsan/ ris med kyi chos dang grub mtha' la dag pa'i gzigs pas speng len mi mdzad par bdag gir bzhes/ de ltar dus phyis snyigs ma'i rgyud pa stobs su gyur pas snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa bag gis nyag phra ba ston gyi chu bran bzhin bltar mi mngon pa'i gnas skabs su/ gangs can pa rnams kyi gtsug rgyan slob dpon chen po dang / be+e ro tsā na'i thugs bskyed phrag par khyer nas mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas par gsan bsam rgya cher mdzad pa'i tshul zhib par gsan yig gang gā'i chu rgyun las shes par nus so/ /dgung grangs bcu bdun pa chu stag lo'i tha skar zla ba'i tshes bcu dang smin drug zla ba'i tshes nyer gnyis la rdo rje gling pa 'jam dpal chos kyi bzhes gnyen dang lo na bai ro zung gi lung bstan pa bzhin tshes nyer gsum nyin zab gter gyi kha byang phyag tu son/ dgung lo bco brgyad son pa chu yos lo 'o zla bzhi pa'i tshes nyer lnga'i nub mo bsam yas brgyud g.ya' ma lung du byon te bla sgrub rig 'dzin thugs thig gi chos skor dang / gu ru'i sku tshab tshe yi ril bu hrīḥrgya ༅ rnams gter nas bzhes/ dgung grangs nyer gcig pa me rta zla ba dang por lha ldan du pad dkar 'chang ba rgyal mchog lnga pa chen po mjal du theg /zab gter bzhes tshul la bka' 'dri phebs pa bzhin snyan gseng phul bar thugs
