rmemathar 61shin tu dgyes/ rgyal dbang nyid kyi zab mo'i dag snang nor bu rgya mā nas lung bstan pa'i dus babs gter byon gyi skyes bu bod ljongs phan bde'i rtsalas dam par nges shes 'khrungs/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du g.ya' ma lung si gter rdzas rnams ngabu thogatu bzhes pa'i skabs chos rgyal tshangs pa lha yi me tog dang lo chen be+e mo'i sngon rabs rnams thogs med du rjes su dran pa byung / de nas bzung rnying rgyud kyis gtsos ba/'a gter gyi chos bsha' ci rigs gsan par mdzad de dbu'i mchod gnas dam par bkur 'ing / ti shrī zhes pa'i mtshan gnas dang 'brel ba'i tham kha stsal ba bzhin tham phud ljags rtsom dang bcas jo bo la ki shwa rar phul bar mdzad/dgung lo nyer gnyis ba'es pa me lug khrums zla'i tshes gsum la gter srung dam can rdor legs kyis bskul ba ltar/ yar klung shel brag gi brag ngos su rdzu 'phrul gyis byon par gter bdag rnams kyis thug dril dang bse'i gzhu zhig phul ba bzhes pa'i nang gshin rje dregs 'joms kyi chos skor rnams byung / dgung lo nyer gsum phebs pa sa sprel snon zla ba'i tshes nyer gcig nyin kun mkhyen lnga pa chen po che mchog 'dus pa rtsal gyi drung ya ma rā dze'i chos skor rnams spyan lam du bstar ba na / dgyes brtse'i dbugs dbyung dang 'bul dngos spom mtho ba stsal/ dgung grangs so gcis pa me 'grug zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bco lngar ngam shad gnam lcags brag gi zab gter khrag 'thung pad+ma drag po dang / dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i

62 rnacha/thar chos skor gyi gter sgrom rnams sngags srung ma mos dngos su phul ba bzhes/rgyal zla ba'i tshes dge bar gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i gzhal med khang chen por kun mkhyen lnga pa chen po dang / lha sras mu rub btsan po'i rnam 'phrul mi dbang sde srid chen po lhan rgyas par gter gsar brag dmar gyi dbang dang / rdor sems gter shag gi bka' gtad rnams phul/ dgung lo so lnga bzhes pa lcags sprel gro zhun zla ba'i tshes nyer dgu'i nyin sha 'ug stag sgo bde chen ye shes kyi 'khor lo nas/ mon bod kyi skal ldan brgya phrag mang po 'dus pa'i dbus su/ thugs rje chen po bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi zab chos cha lag dang bcas pa 'i shog dril bcu gsum dang /gu ru'i sku tshab mthong grol/ thabs shes bde chen ril bu sogs khrom gter du bzhes / lcags bya zla ba drug pa'i nang kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang po dang / mi dbang sde srid chenapo'i spyan sngar gter rdzas rnams gzigs su phul bar mnyes shing thugs snang gzhin par gyur/ slar chu stod zla ba'i tshes bcu gsum nyin nas thun mong dang thun min gyi dbang bka' yongs rdzogs 'bul bar mdzad/ rdor brag rig 'dzin mchog sprul la yang sha 'ug gter byon gyi tshe dbang gter shag nas ljags lung stsal/ chu phag gi lor thub bstan rdo rje brag e wa cog sgar du byon nas dbang lung yongs dzo+ogs stsal zhing chos bdag gi rten 'brel zab rgu 'grigs/gzhan yang snga phyi ci rigs par bsam yas brag dmar mchims phu/ g.ya' ma

rnamathar 63lung sogs grub pa'i gnas chen ngo mtshar can rnams dang / gdan sa gsar rming gi gzim chung / gzim spyil 'od gsal rtsedang / bsam gakro rtse/smin grol gling gi gtsug lag khang / bla brang chos 'khor lhun po sogs su sku mtshams lo sbre la ma dang / zla drug ma/ zla gsum ma/ zla gcig gi mtha' brten pa yan gyis bla ma zhi drag /rdor sems/ bka' brgyad/ thugs rje chen po / yang dag /phur pa/ gzhin rje/ rta mgrin/ cha/kha' spyod ma/ phyag rdor sogs yi dam gyi lha sum cu rtsalnga tsam gyi bsnyen sgrub la gzhol bar mdzad cing /lhag pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal gzisas dang lung bstan thob/ yul gsum gyad du gyur pa las ma dag pa'i snang ba 'gog pa'i bskyed rim la brtan pa thob sde las bzhi gang yang thogs med du grub/ ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad dbang du 'dus shing rdo rje'i chos skyong rnams kyis phrin las bsgrub par dam nos so/ /khyad par rdzogs pa chen po khregs chod kyi nyams bzhes la snying por dril nas thod brgal dang rlung sbyor sogs kyang dus gnad dang bsdun te thugs nyams su bzhes pas rdzogs rim rtsarlung thig le'i 'gros dhu tīr dag pas zhu bde ye shes kyi phyag rgyar 'bar / rdzogs pa chen po rang snang ris med kyi dgongs pa 'khrungs pas gzung 'dzin gyi mtshan ma rang sar grol/ 'khor 'das kyi 'dzin zhen gzhi la dag pas mnyam rjes ris med 'od gsal khor yug gi ting nge 'dzin la dbang 'gru+or/ snang

64 /pathar spyod thams can ye shes kyi rol pa 'ba' zhig tu shar/ slob dpon hūm̐ ka ra/sangs rgyas gsang ba/ bi ma la mi tra/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma dang / be+e ro tsā na / ye shes marlo rgyal/ mnga' bdag nyang ral/ kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer sogs rgya bod kyi paṇa grub du ma'i ye shes kyi skus rjes su bzung / phur pa rdo rje gzhon nu sogs yi dam gyi lha du mas zhal gzigs shing dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs pa dang / bde ba can dang rnga yab dpal ri pad+ma 'od sogs dag pa'i zhingayongs su 'byongs pa'i ting nge 'dzin la dbang 'byor ba dang / gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro dang rdo rje chos skyong rnams kyis lung ston pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i gzigs snang mtha' yas/ chags thogs med pa'i mngon shes la mnga' dbang 'byor bas mtha' dmag dbus su/ lhags pa dang bod ljongs snod bcud dus kyi 'gyur ldog sogs lung bstan pa rnams kyang phyis thog tu babs nas yid ches pa'i gtan migs su gyur/ de ltar dgung lo so gcig pa yan chad du sngar thugs rgyud la smin byed dbang gi sa bon thebs pa nyid rim gyis 'phel bas/ bum dbang gi nyams myong yul snang thams cad gsal stong sgyu ma lta bur gtan la phab nas/shas cher sku'i 'gro ldan spyod pa'i dus te/ ji skad du mato ting 'dzin rgyal po las/'chag dang 'dug dang 'breng dang nyal ba dang / /mi gang thub pa'i zla ba dran byas pa / /de yi mdun na rtag tu ston pa banugs/ /de ni rgya chen mya ngan 'da' bar

rnam thar 65'gyur / tshes gsungs pa dang tshul mthun par shod chen skyi lung sogs lho byang gi yul gru tha dad pa du mar zhabs kyis bcags nas sku 'i dkyil 'khor mthong ba tsam gyis ris med gdul bu+o bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyud la rnam grol gyi sa bon bstims nas 'khor ba mtha' can du mdzad/ dar rgyas chos sdings/ dar lung sge mdo/ zangs mtsho/ lho brag byang gling / gnas gzhi lcog bu dgon/dge ye/ sngags dgon ri khrod/ rtsele byar gsung snyan/ thang 'brog /bde chen steng / go 'jo mkho khyim dgon/ rtsereng ma bu/ gangs ri ma lag /mon tha se/ ra mo lha khang / dkar mo/ bye ma/ dar sdings/ nyan chad/dgon gsar/ mig bzhi/ chos rdzong / dgon dmar/ dpal 'byor chos sdings / tshes bcu sgrub sde/ nges gsang rjo rje gling sogs chos brgyud 'dzin pa'i dgon sde mang du byung / dgung grangs so gnyis bzhes pa me sbrul dbo zla nas bzung gsang dbang gi nyams myong rang rig gsal/ stong du shar bas gzung 'dzin gyi mtshan ma dbyings su nub/ ma das pa'i las rlung gi rgyu ba dbu mar thim/ mgrin pa'i rtsamadud yongs su grol te/ gsung rnam pa thams cad pa la dbang 'byor ba'i sgo nas gtsobo ra gsung gi 'gro ldan spyod pa'i dus te/ mchog dman bar ma'i skal lngan ris su ma chad pa rnams la dam pa'i chos spyi dang / khyad par bka' gter gyi chos tshul bar med du stsal/ dgung 'oge so brgyad bzhes pa chu phag

66 rnamathar khrums zla nas bzung / pho nya'i lam gyis nu bde'i dpes mtshon pa'i don gyi ye shes rig stong bde ba chen po lhan skyes mi 'gyur ba'i dga' bzhi thugs rgyud la snye2brungs pa'i nyams myong rim gyis 'phel bas thugs kyi 'gro dzin la shas cher spyod pa'i dus yin par gsungs shing / rgyud sde gsar rnying gi dgongs don mthar thug mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi chos bka' ris med spyi dang / khyad par 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i lugs kyi rdzogs rim mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i gnas lugs la dbang 'byor bar nyid do/ /dus de tsam nas zab khrid kyi gdams pas skal ldan rnams btsan thabs su dkri ba'i tshadzad pa kho na bdag gir bzhes pa dang /sgrub pa'i phrin las kyang mnyam rjes khor yug giting nge 'dzin las ma g.yos bzhin du sgom khrid 'bogs pa rnams go yul tsam dz+nya ma lus par mngon sum rig thog tu ngo sprong cing / dbang dus su ye shes kyi byin slob ma'i rgyud la dngos su dbab pa dang bsgen sgrub kyi las rab 'byams thams cad kyang bshad pa tsam du ma lus par phyag bzhes su thebs par mdzad/ de ltar phrin las kyi 'gro don khyab gdal du spyod pa'i dus su'ang 'khums te/ mdzad spyod thams to rang don yid byed kyi 'khri ba med par bstan 'gro'i phan bde 'ba' zhig thugs su gcigs pa'i snying stobs chen pos bshad sgrub las gsum gyi phrin las rnem par dkar bas dus 'da' bar mdzad/de la 'chad pa'i phrin las ni/ gtsobo ra kunamakhyen rgyal mchog lnga pa chen pos

rnamathar 67snga 'gyur rgyud 'bum rin po chos mar+pā zab rgyas kyi chos skor ji snye da pa zhig gsan nas ti shrīr bkur zhing / des mapho te sa phag 'bri stag legs chen tsho go sar bzhugs pa'i skyes mchog du ma dang / dpon chen dang mi chen/ bstan pa gsal bar mdzad pa'i bshes gnyen sku'i sras mched rnams dang / gsung gi sras dam pa mang po dang dbus gtsang khams kong lto ren mnga' ris sogs nas dad 'dus kyi skal ldan mchog dman mtha' yas pa rnams la so so'i blo dang mtshams pa'i snga 'gyur bka' gter dang sngags gsar ma mdo phyogs sogs kyi dbang khrid bshad lung gi chos sgo du ma zhig rgyun chags su stsal ba'i 'chad phrin 'gran zla med pas bstan pa gsal zhing rgyas par mdzad pa dang / bstan pa yun ring du gnas pa'i phyir bka' ma'i chos skor gyi sgrub dkyil dbang chog sogs dang / gter kha gong 'og gi gtsos gter rming khyad par can rnams kyitsho chog bsgrigs sogs snga na med pa'i legs bshad med du byung ba'i bstan bcos kyang / skor tsho bcu gsum la pusnyika bcu drug gi rnam/ par bzhugs shing gdul bya rnams smin cing grol bar mdzad do/ /bya ba las kyi 'khor lo la mtshon na gter lung las gsal ba bzhin srid 'i'i gtsug rgyan gong sa yas ljinachen mo gnas gzhi sa yul lha 'bangs dang bcas pas mtshon mkho dga'i yo byad bla na med pa lhug par stsal ba dang / dad sbyin rnams nas phul ba'i dngos po rnams srid tshogs dang gsog rum gyis mdzod

68 rnamathar phug ma'i sgo lcags mi sdom zhing / bar ma dor chud mi mdza' bar sngom pa na/sum gyis rgyud bsdams pa dang / bshad sgrub kyi bya ba la mngon par gzhol ba'i 'dus sde chen po 'og min a rgyan smin grol gling nges pa don gyi dga' ba'i tshal chen po zhes pa'i mtshan mngon par gsal ba'i chos grwa chen po de nyid drag po lcags khyi lor gsar du phyag btab/ thog mar dge 'dun bzhi bcu skor nas sum brgyar nye ba gsar du bsdu bar mdzad/ dus bzhi'i 'chad nyan gyi chos grwa dang / dkyil 'khor du ma'i sgrub mchod/ gzhi gsum gyi phyag ba'es rnams kyi srol bzang po gtod / de ltar gtong ba phun sum tshoges pa la ches goms pas dus bzhi'i sgrub mchod sogs la rgyun chags su rung ba'i bsnyen bkun gyis mi brel bar mchod sbyin gyi yul dang tshogs gnyis gyi rgyur lhug par gtong ba sogs bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgyas par mdzad pa'i tshul rlabs po che bdag gir bzhes pa'i phrinalas ngo mtshar med du byung ba ni/ gnas mal gyi gtsug lag khang ka ba brgyad cu rtsabazhi'i khyon thog rim gsum pa/ de yi byang ngos su bla brang chos 'khor lhun po ka ba lnga bcu'i khyon thog rim gsum pa/ sgrub mchod lha khang gsang sngags pho brang ka ba bzhi bcu rtsabargyad kyi khyon thog rim gnyis pa/ de rnams su bzhugs pa'i sku rten sman 'dam la 'bur du byas pa dang / rin po che la brdung pa/ lugs su blugs pa/r+sān la brkos pa'i 'bur sku sna tshogs dang / sdeb ris kyi snang brnyan tshar du

rnamathar 69dngar ba/ gzhan yang bris thang mang po dang / bzang gos las grub pa'i thub dbang gnas brtan bcu drug /gu ru mtshan brgyad kyi yol thang / a rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i gos thang chen mo/ rgya dkar nag sogs yul phyogs gzhan nas bsod nams gyi zhing du spyan drangs pa'i li ma sogs sku rten dang / mchod dzos yo byad rgyu bzang zhing bkod mdzes pa'i rim pa mtha' yas pa gsar du bsgrun par mdzad do / ṣesung gi bdud rtsibazhes pa'i slob tshogs bstan pa 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen mang dra 'e/nga ba ni/ gter lung las bshad pa ltar/ dam lngan chos bdag slob ma ni: da lta'i mnga' bdag yab sras sogs: sa thob rje 'bangs skye ba'i mtha':'gro jor+sha nus pa sum cu lnga: rang don thub pa brgya rtsabargyad: chos kyis 'brel ba stong tsho gnyis: smon lam 'brel ba khri phrag lnga: las kyi 'brel ba drug cu bdun: gdugs thogs bdun gyis zhabs nas 'degs: mi chen gsum gyis mnga' thang spel: zhes pa ltar/ ji lta ji sged mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis shes bya thams cad kyi mtshan nyid sgrib bral du gzigs pa'i kun mkhyen rgyal mchog lnga pa chen po / mdun na 'don gnas lnga ris pa'i paṇ+ḍita chen po dpal mi yi dbang po sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mcho ste mchod yon nyi zla zung gcig dang / rdo brag rig 'dzin pad+ma phrin las/ sa skya khri chen kun dga' bkra shis/ rtsegadong zhabs drung khu nga/bon sogs gdan sa gong 'og gi skyes chen/ kam tshang gi bstan 'dzin mtshur phu

70 rnam tharargyal tshab dang / tre hor mchog sprul/ 'bri gung dkon mchog phrin las bzang po / stag lung pa bstan 'dzin srid zhi rnam rgyal/ 'grug pa thams cad mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po/ sgam po mchog sprul bzang po rdo rje dang gdung brgyud/chab mdo rgyal ba 'phags pa lha/ ngag dbang mchog gi sprul sku/ mdo khams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ ta bla gong 'og /kaḥthog rgyal sras bsod nams lde'u baphywa/ rdzogs chen gnyis pa 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin rnams kyis mtshon yongs su grags pa bstan pa 'dzinapa'i bla chen phal mo ces zhabs la ma btud pa med pa lta bu dang / nang thugs kyi sras gcig pu g.yu sgra'i rnam 'phrul gcung lo ༄na dharma shrī/ gdung sras pad+ma 'gyur med rgya marlo/ zhabs drung yid bzhin legs grub/ rgyas sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ rje ba.oṃ mi 'gyur dpal sgron rnams dang / gzhan yang nye bar gnas pa dge slong blo gsal rgya marlo/sngags rab 'byams pa a rgyan chos grags/ 'bum ram pa a rgyan skal bzang sogs bstan pa'i ka chen 'degs nus pa'i zhal slob dang / phun tshogs dge 'dun 'dus pa 'i snge chen po rnams dang / mchog dman gyi skye bo grangs meng pa mang pothugs rje'i sdobya/nga thag gis datris shing bskyangs pas smin cing grol ba'i sa la bkod nge gdul pyi/ 'i don ma/thar phyin par mdzad do/ /de ltar gakho chen 'di nyid gsar rnying gi bstan pa yongs rdzogs la dngos dang brgyud nas b.la' drin tshe bar ma

rnam sa swā1ra ༈jo nang / shangs pa/ zhi byed/ gcod yul/ bo dong ba sogs sgrub brgyudashing rta chen po brgyad kyi chos rgyun phra ba rnams kyang rang stobs dang gzhan bskul la bsten nas gdams ngag gi srog mthud pa lta bu dang / yang sgos khri srong mchod yonacigyi phyag rjes snga 'gyur rnying ma bka' ma mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi gtsos ring lugs med du byung ba rnams kyi bshad sgrub snum zad kyi mar me lta bur mnal du nye ba na/thugs stobs zhus pa med pa'i 'bad rtsol chen pos btsal te/ bshad sgrub las gsam gyi sgonas bstan pa nyams pamengs nas gsos pa'i phyag rjes dang bka'adrin nistong gsum rin poche sna bdun gyis bkang ste phul kyang gsab pa'i spyod yulasris 'das shing 'gran pa'i gnas su gyur pa ma lags te/ 7skyabs rje bdud 'jormās 'jigs bral ye shes rdo rjes don gyi snying po rje btsun chen po 'di nyid mched zhal gdung brgyud dang bcas pa'i bka' drin la brten gsang sngags rnying ma mtshanadon mthun pa 'byul med tshad thub kyi rgyun da lta'i bar ma nyams par gong 'phel du rgyas pa 'di byung bas na ngo mtshar ba'i phyag rjes dang bka' drin la sus kyang 'gran zlaracha/ gyur pas/ slad kyi rnying ma pa'i chos gral du skyes pa rnams nas kyang zab chosu su btags pa'i chog phrin nyi tshe ba tsam la blo li gto+o par bstan pa'i sgrom wo po phyogs 'di'i ring lugs rgyo ྾ 'dzin cing spel ba la brtson pa che thang du bskyed par rigs pa yin no/ /'es gsungs pa ni den la gnas pa lags shing gzhan yang sdogrub

72 satharabastan pa'i nyi ma sogs dam pa mang pos sgro skur dang bral ba'i bsngags brngod kyi me tog 'thor ba gsung rab rnams las gsal bas 'dir rgyas par mi spro'o/ /de ltar sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las sogs gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdzad pa re zhig mthar phyin par nye ba na/ le lo'i gzhan dbang du song zhing rtag 'dzin gyi srad bus bcing pa'i gdul bya rnams nges 'byung gi lam bzang por bkod pa'i slad/ dgung lo drug cu rtsadagur byon pa rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing rta'i lo hor zla dang po nas cung zad bsgun pa'i tshul bstan/ khyad par tshos nyer lnga nas khu dbonarnams la zhal gdams dang / 'chi mtha' gzigs pa'i lung bstan dang bslab bya rnams lhugs par stsal/ de nas bzung rim gro pa rnams kyi ngor nub kyi phyi'i rtsig ngos na yod 'dra bar ma tshogs mkha' 'gro rnams kyi snang glu gdon mi za ba'i sgra shin tu snyan pa rgyun chags su byung zhing / ga bur lta bu'i dri ngad bzang pos gzim chung phyi nang thams cad khyab pa'ang byung / mthar hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gnyis kyi nyi dros tsam la babs pa na/ da shar phyogs su goms pa bdun 'gro dgos pa yod/ ces gsungs te bzhengs nas zhabs kyis gom stabs bdun spos pa'i mthar skyil krung gis banugs te/ snang grags rigs gsum lha sngags chos sku'i ngang / /sku dang ye shes rol par 'byams klas pa/ /zab gsang rnapa 'byu+or chen po'i nyams len la//g.yel med thugs kyi thig ler ro gcig shog /ces 'da' kha zhal chems kyi tshul

rnamathar 73du gsungs rjes/ da ste mkha' 'gro'i bsu ba yang byung ngo gsung ste phyag gnyis ṭ+wāṃ dril 'brol ba'i brda thabs dang spyan lta stangs kyis gzigs bzhin skad cig la ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang rdzu'aphrul chen po mngon par 'du mdzad nas mkha' spyod pad+ma 'od kyi zhing khams chen por dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi tshoges dpon du gshegs so//de'i tshe 'ja' 'od kyi gur khyim dang / me tog gi char dang / sa g.yo ba sogs med du byung ba'i dge ma rnams dang / khyad par gter lung las/ 'das dus gdung dang ring bsrel 'byung: sus myong mkha' spyod btsan sa zin: zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gdung zhugs la phul ba'i skabs thugs dang / dbu thod mes ma smas par phebs shing / sku gdung ring bsrel gyi tshogs dang / nun thig la so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi rang gdangs mngon du gyur pa'i rtags su rgyal ba 'od mtshan stong 'bar gyi sku brnyan gzi byin dar ldan zhing 'jon gtsang phebs pa sogs theg pa mchog gi rtags ma tshang ba med pas gdul bya rnams smin grol dad pa'i gnas la bkod par mdzad do/ /rgyas par gzigs 'dod pa rnams kyis lo chen chos dpal rgya mtsho'i gsung phyi yi rnam thar dad pa'i shing rta dang / nang gi rnam thar yon tan mtha' byung sogs la 'jug par bya ba'o/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mthar thug don/ /zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /rig stong mi shigs rdo rje grub pa'i mtha'/ /maspya skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig/ //

74 sa thar stso/ khri rabs gnyis pa pad+ma 'gyur med rgya mtsho ni/ de la 'dir chos kyi rje rig 4na wo po gasto bdag gling pa'i rdo rje'i gdung 'ah+phu pa'i brgyud pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu mtshar du dngar ba la rtsaba'i dbye ba sras brgyud dang slob brgyud gnyis las 'dir sras brgyud kyi rnam thar brjod pa'i thog mar/ rigs sras kyi thu bo 'di ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gas rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes nyid gdul bya'i dpal du shar ba khro bo rta mchog rol pa'i sprul par lung gis zin pa ste/gter lung las/ rigs sras rta mgrin sprul pa ni: rdo rje'i ming gis 'gro don spyod: ces gsungs pa ltar tshad mas grub pa'i skyes mchog nyid/ yab chos kyi rje rig 'dzin chen po gter bdag gling pa dang / yum rje'u rigs las mkha' 'gro'i rtags kyis mtshan pa yon tan sgrol ma rnam gnyis kyi sras su/ ji skad puji bzhin yang dag gzigasapa'i phyir/ /skye sogs rnams las 'das gyur kyang / /snying rje'i bdag r+sā skye ba dang / /'chi dang rga dang na ba ston/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i tshul du skye ba'i pad mo gsar du bzhad/btsas ma thag tu yab rje rig 'dzin 'a po nyid nas khrus dang byin rlabs srung ba mdzad pa sogs cho ga phun sum tshogs pa dang 'brel gter lung dang mthun par shes rab rnam rgyal rdo rje 'bum zhes pa'i mtshan gyi cod pan gsol/ sku na chung ngu nas byang chub sems pa'i rigs kyi mthu khyad par canasad de dam pa'i ngang tshulakho nal gcig

sa thar 75tu gzholabs 'bor gyi skye dgu rnams mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su bkod / yab rje rig 'dzin gter bdag gling pa dang khu bo lo chen dharma shrī rnam gnyis kyi zhabs pad mnyes pa gsum gyi sgo nas mi 'bral bar mchod cing bkur ba'i mthus/ ji skad du/ bslab pa kun gyi gzhi 'dzin cing / /rig byed smra ba rnams kyi rgyu/ /ming tshig brjod pa kun gyi gzhi/ /yi ge'i sbyor ba bshad par bya/ /zhes pa ltar thun mong gi rig pa'i gzhi ma yi ge 'bri klog gnyis nas bzung thun min nang rigs pa'i b.lakha dang dgongs 'grel gyilta dgongs zab gnad spyi dang khyad par rdo rje theg pa bgazha gter dag snang gis bsdus pa'i chos brka' sa mo mthar thug gi bar du smin byed dbang / grol byed khrid/ rgyab rten lung dang bcas pa zab don rjen la phyungs pa'i man ngag mtha' dag gsan bsam sgom gsum ya bral du cha/ song bar dkyus gcig tu mdzad/ yab rje sku mched rnam gnyis dang gnyis su ma mchis pa'i dgongs pa brnyes/ dasmung grangs nyi shu pa la khu bo mkhan chen lo tsā ba chen po dharma shrī dang kha skong dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i spyan snga nas tshigs gsum bar ma chad pa'i sgo nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes shing / sum lngan rig pa 'dzin pa yongs kyi rgyan du gyur/ gzhan yang gnas dus ci rigs par chos rje gzhan phan dbang po'i drung nas dam chos 'dul ba/ mngon pa gong 'og /phar phyin/ dbu tshad sogs mdo phyogs kyi gzhung lugs chen po rnams la lung rigs rnam dag gis

76 rnam thar bshad pa mtha' rgya chode pa gsan/ lho brag gong dkar chos sde nas slob dpon dbang phyug pa ched du gdan 'dren gyis rdo rje'i phreng ba gtsobo ra gyur pa'i gsar ma'i rgyud sde phal mo che'i dbang dang / bshad khrid sogs kyi rgyun phal mo che la'ang phyogs zhen gyis ma gos shing dad gus chen pos gsan bsam sgom gsum mthil phyin par mdzad pas rnam dgrod kyi lus stobs yongs su rgyas shing ris su ma mchis pa'i rgyal bstan spyi la dag snang phyogs med du rgyas/ mdor na dam pa 'di ni/ji skad du/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin pu /yon to kun gyi gzhi rten logs par gsungaso/ /zhes dang rdo rje rtsemo'i rgyud las/ gol te de dag dge slang 'gyur/ /sngam pa gsum dang yang dag lngan/ /sa sa thar dang byang chub sems / ༈ rig 'dzin sngags kyi sngom pa'o/ /zhes pa ltar phyi so thar/ nang byang sems / sang ba rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa ste sngom pa gsum gyi yon tan bzang pos thugs rgyud bsdams/ thos bsam sgom gsum la gcig tu gzholaba'i ljon shing gi lo 'dab phyogs brgyar rgyas/ rang gzhan phan bde'i dpal la 'god pa'i bzang po'i phrin las kyi 'bras bu g.yur du za bas na mchog dman bar ma'i skye 'gro yongs kyis bsngags pa'i me tog dor ba'i gnas su gyur/ khyad par du sku na chung ngu nas rig pa'i rtsal kha phyogs med du rgyas/ mgrin pa'i rtsamadud grol bas gzhung lugs du ma'i bshad pa ngo mtshar bas skal lngan rnams smin par mdzad/

sa thar 77 —yab rje dam pas kyang chos char pha bas bu lhag ces pa'i dbugs dbyungs thob/phyi rabs kyi gdul bya dang bstan rnga/'i srog rgyun 'thud pa la dgongs te/ ji skad du mgon po byams pas/ gang zhig rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'ba' zhigagi /dbang byas rnam g.yengs med yid ༅ gyis bshad/ /thar pa thob pa'i lam dang rjes mthun pa/ /de ya/nga drang srong bka' bzhin spyi bos blangs/ /zhes pa'i tshul dang mthun par snyan ngag me long gi ṭik+ka/ sher phyin gyi 'bru 'aspel/ spyi don bdud rtsi'i nying khu/ sdom gsum dpag sge'i zur 'debs/ gsang snying spyi don/'da' kha'i smon lamagyi 'grel pa/ bde 'dus dbang gi rnam bshad/ tshe bdag gi las sbyor la gnyes pa'i man ngag sgron ma bdun pa/ gzhan yang dbang dang sgrub phrin/ las kha tshar dang bcas pa'i khrid yig sogs thun mong dang thun min mdo sngags rang gzhung dang bcas pa'i dgongs 'grel ches rmad du byung ba du ma mdzad / a rgyan pad+ma'i lung don ltar dam pa 'dis sngags rgya bzhes pa'i rten 'brel 'grigs na skabs de'i gangs ljongs mtha' dmag gi 'jigs pa rtsad nas zhi zhing snying po'i bstan pa spyi dang khyad par snga 'gyur ba'i chu 'go 'og min gnyis pa'i chos sde brgyud 'dzin dang bcas pa 'di nyid nyams nyes dang nyer 'tshe gang gis mi 'tshugs shing bkra shis la byin chags pa'i dge mtshan yod na yang / bstan 'gro spyi sgos bsod nams kyi skal bas ma 'chun par tshangs spyod kyi rten kho na mdzang /

78 sathar mi ring bar sku tshe mthar ma phyin zhing matso dmag junagar bas bod kyi bstan 'gro spyi dang khyad par smin grol gling pa'i bstan pa de 'dzin dang bcas pa la bar chad kyi 'tsho ba bzod dka' ba brtsams pa las/ dgung grangs so gsum bzhes pa sa khyi hor zla dang po'i tshes nyer drug la log smon can sas kyis chos rje smin gling pa'i chos gzhi spyi dang khyad par dam pa 'di nyid kyi sku srog la bdo ba'i bar chad brtsams pa ni ji skad pu gzhan gyis khro dang mtshoni sogs nye bar brdeg /gshe dang mtshang 'gru la sogs gnod kun la/ /dran shes brtan pos gnyen po legs bsten nas/ /rtag tu bzod pa'i go cha bgo bar shoge khes pa ltar dge sbyong gi chos bzhi'i thugs dam dang / gter sras rat+na bi dzas/ gzhan don spyod la bdag lus mtshone brgya yis//dum bu stong du gsabs kyang rang bde'i dpal/ /yid la skad cig tsam yang mi skye bar / khadag bas gzhan gces bya ba mthar phyin shag /ces pa ltar byams pa chen lo ting 'dzin la rtse gcig pa'i dpa' gdengs dang ba.a te sku gshegs/de'i tshe bsam yas ar+ya r+pālo'i gling gi rta mgrinagyi dbu gtsug nas rta zhal 'tsher sgra bsgrags pa kun gyis thos shing sa la lhung ba sogs yid du mi 'ong ba'i ngan ltas sna gas pa zhig kyang byung bar gragasdo/ so/ /mang du thos pas lung gi sprin 'khrigs shing / kha rol rgol 'joms rig pa'i glong phreng 'bar/ /man ngag gnad kyi bdud rdzisnying la sim/ /mamo skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig/ //

rnams 79༈ rje btsun mi 'gyur dpal gyi sgron ma ni/ dbyengs kyi yum chen kun tu bzang mo nyid rnam pa gangs ༅ mi mo'i tshul gyis gling 'dir byon par gsungs te/sgra thal 'gyur rtsaba'i rgyud las/ de nas mkha' 'gro dpal 'dzin mas/ /bstan pa 'di nyid bzung nas ni/ /tshe lo bcu pa'i dus ngan dar/ /de nas mi gnas rang sa 'o / zhes dang / sha 'ug gter byon gab rgya'i lung byang dum bu mtha' ma las kyang / khyad par bde gshegs kun 'dus man ngag 'di: 'chang byed snod lngan chos kyi bdag po 'ica gsang chen snying thig man ngag bstan pa'i bdag: chos dgengs gnas su kun tu bzang mo dang: po tā la ru ar+ya tā re ma: dpal ri pad+mar ye shes marlo rgyal ste: a rgyan gzungs cha/ da lta'i mkhar chen gza': skye ba 'di nas cho 'phrul grangs med 'byed: ma gcig lab sgron snang sa 'od de 'bum: zur mo dge 'bum la sogs du ma'i mthar: bsam yas lho phyogs grwa zhes g.yor po'i char: mtshan rtags las ga bai ro'i skye mtha' yi: brgyud 'dzin ṭ+wāṃl+lī'i sgrol ma'i ming 'chang ma: mdo rgyud lung gi gdams pas rgyud phyug pa'i2 rab 'byams rgyud sde'i pha mthar brgal ba 'byung: zhes dang / rang bzhin dbyings kyis rgyud btams pa'i: gnas lugs don gyi mkha' 'gro ma:g.yo ru grwa yi phyogs su 'byung: zhes lung gis zin pa'i rje ba.oṃ d+dha/ 'di nyid dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po nas brtsis pa'i lho

80 rnam thar phyogs g.yor po'i char gtogs pa/ sngar klu mes tshul khrims shes rab gyi gdan sa grwa phyi thar pa gling zhes dpal a rgyan chen pos byin gyis brlabs shing lung bstan pa / 'bras bu gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i ring lugs kyi bsnyi gnas dga' tshal yangs por yab rje gter bdag gling pa dang / yum rdo rje phag mo'i sgyu 'phrul phun tshogs dpal 'dzoms gnyis kyi sras mor smyos ldan sa mo yos kyi lo/ hor zla bcu pa'i tshes nyer lnga'i nub ṭ+wāṃl+lī 'du ba'i thun mtshams khyad par can la/ 'og min a rgyan smin grol gling gi bla brang chos 'khor lhun po'i gzims chung bkra shis snangabar ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas sku bltams/ de'i tshe yab rje mchog nas sku drung pa rnams la brgyud 'dzin 'di nyid dbyus mar mi yong bas gtsang sbra la 'bang dgos gsungs pa ltar sku bltams ma thag khu bo lo chen dhame 6rnos khro bo sme ba brtsegs pa'i byabs khrus dang / nangs par gter chen bla ma nyid nas gter gsar drag dmar gyi sku gsung thugs dbang dang / 'chi med yang snying kun 'dus kyi tshe dbang stsal/ chung ngu'i dus nas kyang dpal a rgyan chen po dang / kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer/ gsang bdag 'phrin las lhun grub rnams kyi sku rten rnams mjal dus zhabs rim pa rnams kyis zhu mi dgos par rje btsun nyid kyis ngos 'dzin mdzadacing byin rlabs zhu ba'i tshul dang / gzhon nu rol rtsed kyi dus rnams su byis pa phal gyi spyod yul las 'das pa dam pa'i ngang tshul bzang po rang chas su mnga'/

/za thar 81skabs shig ras gos ljang khu rgyan ldan zhig phyag bstar gyis bzo bar mdzad de gzims dpon 'gyur med chos sgron la gal te 'di ngeng/ rang gnyis nam 'ig mtha' 'khob tu bros nas 'gro dgos pa yong / de'i tshe 'cho ba blugs pa'i snod byed pa/ yin zhes gces spras su mdzad/ gnas skabs kun tu rang nyid dman pa'i tshul bzung zhing phun tshogs kyi dngos po thams cad bla ma'i mthu las 'byung bar yang yang dran bzhin nges shes 'khrungs/ de nas dgung lo bcu gnyis ba'es pa lcags stag zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu dpal a rgyan thod 'phreng rtsal gyi dus mchod la/ bla brang chos 'khor lhun po'i gzims chung kun bzang pho brang du mi shigs gzhom med rdo rje'i khrir rang bi yab dpal a rgyan rdo rje 'chang gi skur bzhengs te/ chos nyid rnal ma shes rab kyi spu gris gtsug phud bzhes te mtshan mi 'gyur dpal gyi sgron mar gsol zhing rab tu gnas pa'i me tog mthor ba'i tshe/ 'og min yang rtse'i rgya phibs kyi rtser 'ja' 'od mdung tshugs su zug pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rtags snang mang du byung /yab rje'i drung du zab chos rig 'dzin thugs thig gi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun gyis smin par mdzad/ grol byed khrid kyi rim pa rnams sngon 'gro thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa nas bzung re re nas rtags thon du sgom khrid 'debs par mdzang cing / sku nar son pa nas sngom gsum 'gal med du dril nas thugs nyams su bzhes / khyad par bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim la nan tan gyi zhal ta yang yang

82 rnamatharaphebs par lam 'di thos pas mi grol bas nges par nan tan sgom dgotra/ zhes gsungs pa ltar nyams su blangs pas bskyed rdzogs kyi 'char sgo ma 'gags pa'i gsal snang 'dzin med bde ba chen por 'char/ dgung lo bcu gsum bzhes pa lcags yos zla ba gsum pa 'i nang/ yab rje bla ma dam pa'i zhabs drung du gter gsar a ti zab don snying po'i gdams pa lhag med zla ba bzhi lanye ba'i bar rje 'tshi nyid la skurkyang du stsalpozhing nyams rtogs kyang rang rgyud la blo dang 'tshams pa'i brtan pa thob/ khyad par rdor sems thugs kyi sgrub pa'i rtsakhrid yongs rdzogs/ rgyab rten lung dang bka' srung gi srog gtad rnams kyang rdzogs par stsal/ de nas dgung lo bcu bzhi bzhes pa chu 'brug zla ba gnyis pa'i nang yab kyi drung du zhal ta ma 'gyur med chos sgron dang / gsol thab 'gyur med g.yang 'dzoms sogs dpon g.yog bzhis zab lam thugs rje chen po bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi spros bcas dang /spros med mchog dbang song ma gsum drod rtags gtor ma'i dbang bskur bcas smin par zhu zhing / gsang mtshan pad+ma dbang phyug tu gsol// lo chen dhame shrīs kyang rje btsun dpon g.yog gnyis la zab lam bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi 'khrul 'khor sku lus kyi 'gyur dang sgo gnad rtsathigarlung gsum gyi man ngag zla ba gnyis su nye bar stsal/ de ltar gdams don dang man ngag mtha' dag rgyud thog tu ma me+ongs par shes rab kyis sgro 'dogs bcad cing brtson 'grus gzhu brdung pa lta bus nyams

/pathar 83su blangs/ gzhan yang yab rje rig 'dzin chen po las gshin rje dregs 'joms kyis mtshon gter gsar yongs rdzogs kyi dbang lung dang / gsung 'bum podachen bcu gsum gyi lung / nyang gter bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa dang /phur pa yang gsang spu gri/ bka' brgyad rdzong 'phrang / rta mgrin/ 'dus pa mdo/sgyu 'phrul zhi ba dang khro bo/ na rag dong sprugs kyi dbang dang sgrub thabs kyi lung /sems klong sde gnyis kyi dbang dang khrid lung / khyad par man ngag gi sde la rim pa mang yang gtso thore snying thig rnam gnyis sogs rdzogs par zhus/ dgung lo bco lngar phebs pa'i tshe sha 'ug gter byon mkha' 'gro'i chos skor rnams shag ser las phab par mdzad de/ gcen rgyal sras pad+ma 'gyur med rgya mtshor dbang lung gtad rgya dang bcas pa stsal/ de ma thag slar dbang lung rnams rje btsun nyid la gcen rgyal sras rin po che nas stsal zhing/ de nas bzung chos bka' 'di'i zab khrid kyi gdams pa rnams yab rje gter chen gyi drung nas zhag lnga la rdzogs par stsal ba'i bka' drin thob/ bar skabs lo 3na dhame shrī las rab tu byung ste yab rje'i gter gsar yongs rdzogs kyi dbang dang khrid lung / na rag dong sprugs/ 'dus pa mdo'i dbang sogs mang po gsan/ rgyal sras pad+ma 'gyur med rgya mtsho tshelas/a ti'i rig pa'i rtsal dbang / phyag rdor dregs 'dul gter kha gsum lngan gyi dbang lung sogs mtha' yas pa gsan/ dgung lo bcu drug la phebs pa hor zla

84 /patharaganyis pa'i tshes gnyis la yab rje chos kyi rgyal po gdul bya gzhan don du ngo mtshar ba'i rtags dang bcas dag pa'i 'ing du gshegs pa la thugs skyo tshad med pa shar ba'i nub mo srod gdong nag gi dus su/ mdun gyi nam mkhar 'ja' 'od kyi klong na yab rje rig 'dzin chen po'i sku'i snang brnyan sasal bar mjal/ de nas me bya dgung lo bcu dgu'i bar lo gsum du bcad rgya dam par bzhugs/ sa pho khyi'i lor hor dmag bod du lhags te snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa nyams nyes par btang / rje btsun nyid sku mtshams las har thon gyis dbu skra sbad mgo dang sku la snam bu rgya khra'i na bza' bzhes te/ skya chas su bsgyur nas zhabs rim ma 'gyur med chos sgron sogs dpon g.yog lnga gter bdag si rgyab ri'i brgyud nas btsan yul sde pa dbang 'dus pa'i sar zhal gtad nas phebs/ de'i skabs hor dmag gis dgon pa bdag tu bzung / gsang sngags pho brang ma satogs gtsug lag khang dang chos 'khor lhun po'i spen bad yan/ mchod rten chen po'i chos 'khor yan chad bzhig /de nas btsan yul du phebs pa'i nub sog pos btsan yul mnan pa na sde pa dbang 'dus kyis rje btsun dpon g.yog rnams thag shur la gdan drangs/ de nas rim par 'bras ljongs su yab rje'i lung bstan ltar phebs rgyur phag ri'i phyogs su zhal gzigs te sprang chas kyis nyin mtshan bar med sku ngal chen pos byon/ de'i tshe lha sar lo chen rin po che dang gcen rgyal sras pad+ma 'gyur med rgya mcho bkrongs pa'i

rnamathar 85gtam ngan gsan pa la thugs skyo tshad med pa'i ngang nas spyan chab bsil zhing mgur 'di gsungs so/ /rje na mo gu ru/ skyabs gnas bslu med kyi bdag nyid/ /drin can marlo skyes kyi rdo rje/ /pha gcig 'gran zla dang bral ba/ /chos rgyal gter bdag gi gling pa/ /zhes sogs gdung dgrangs kyi rgyang 'bod mdzad pas a rgyan yab yum dang rje bla ma dam pa'i sku yi snang brnyan mdun gyi nam mkhar 'ja' 'od kyi klong du gsal bar gzigs shing gdung ba sel ba'i lung dang / bar chad dus kyi 'gyur lngog sogs lung bstan mang po gnang / de nas 'bras ljongs bla brang nas rdzogs chen khrag 'thung dpa' bo 'jigs med rdo rjes ser bsgrengs kyis bkur snyi phun sum tshoges pas gsang sngags pho brang du gdan drangs te zhabs tog tshad med pas ngal bse thob/ de'i sang nyin dge slong a rgyan rab brtan gyis dbu skra bsil bar mdzad de sngar bzhin rab byung du sku lus bsgyur/ de yang yul phyogs der rdzogs chen pa dang mi dbang sa skyong gi bkas zin na ma gtogs bla ma gzhan gyis bsgyur kha dka' yang / rdzogs chen pa dang chos rgyal zung nas rang re 'bras ljongs kyi 'og tu chud pa'i skye bo kun/ rje ba.oṃ rin po che yul phyogs 'dir phebs pa skal ba shin tu bzang / dbang lung sadams pa rnams so so'i gang 'dod bzhin zhu chog ces bka' shog bkrams/ de'i tshe dad can gyi skye bo sa mo stong spya tsam 'dus pa la/gter gsar 'chi med yang snying kun 'dus kyi tshe dbang stsal pa'i tshe rje btsun

86 snam tharabazhugs pa'i dbu thos tu 'ja' tshon kha dog lnga ldan mdung tshugs su zug /tshe dbang tshugs nas ma grol gyi bar rje'i dbu thog gi nam mkhar bya rgod zhis g.yas bskor du 'phur zhing lding ba byung / de ltar mtshan lngan shar ba las gdul bya kun yi rangs shing dad pa'i sa bon bskrun par mdzad pa ngang / rje btsun nyid kyi ma tshan nas 'bod cing 'ur 'dir gyis rkyang phyag 'tshal ba sogs dang dam 'gyur pa med pa'i snang tshul gsal bar bstan/ khyad par rdzogs chen pa dang mi rje sa bdag rgyal pos mtshon zhabs rim thubor gyur pa rnams la sminagling gter gsar yongasardzogs kyi dbang lung dang / a ti'i zab don snying po'i dbang dang khrid lung sogs gnang /rdzogs chen rin po che las dkon mchog spyi 'dus dang rig 'dzin srog sgrub kyi dbang lung tshang bar gsan/ de nas re zhig smin gling gi dus zing lhing 'jags byung ba dang bsdun/ slar yang rje btsun dpon g.yog sngar rgyun steng grwa rigs rnying pa 'gata dang bcas 'bras ljongs nas bod du chibs zhol bsgyur/ smin gling ri gzhol du slebs ma/ thag sngar lha'i dga' tshal dang mnyam pa'i gnas de gsang sngags pho brang tsam ma gtogs bla brang zung dang / mchod rten/ grwa shag gis mtshon gyang stong du rong nger 'dug pa la/ yab rje khu dbon rnams kyi sku dus su spo+od pa'i stobs 'byor longs spyod rnams dran te bzod brlag med pa'i sdug bsngal gyis mnar bar gsungs/ de'i tshe mi dbang pho lha tha'i ji bsod nams stobs rgyal nas

rnam thar 87rje btsun nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad gdung drag pos mjal bar byon te dbu zhwa dang na bza' gsol zhing / chibs rta dkar po sga srab rgyan gyis spras pa bcas phul/de nas dbu chos baspes pa rnams kyis bkur snyi'i zhabs tog dang bcas gzims chung bde chen yang rtser spyan drangs te mjal 'phrad ngang / grwa tshang 'dus tshogs su mang 'gyed dang sbyor 'jags mdzad/ de rjes klu sdings lha dbang dga' tshal gyi zhig gso tshugs shing legs par grub rjes rab gnas kyi cho ga bskyangs/ de nas kong por phebs rgyur yang re zheg dam pa'i chos kyi sbyin pas dbus gtsang / mnga' ris / lho mon/ lho brag /dwags po dang khams stod smad bar gsum/dbu ru ngang g.yo ru phyogs kyi ngad can pho mo chos spyan lngan pa mang po'i re 'dod skong bar mdzad pas phyogs kun tu grags snyan gyis khyab/ de nas kong por byon te 'gro don bskyangs shing rim par lha lngan du chibs kha bsgyur/ der rgyalaba'i dbang po skal bzang rgya mche mjal phyag tu byon/ gtsug phud 'bul bar mdzad de mtshan rje btsun shes rab sgron ma 'es stsal te me tog 'thor bar mdzad/ rtse'i 'phags pa letshe te shwa ra sogs gnas rten ngo mtshar rnams mjal/ bod 'bangs yun du bde ba'i smon lam gsungs shing 'chi med yang snying kun 'dus kyi sgo nas tshe sgrub dang / gdul bya dad can re la tshe dbang brgya rtsagater gsar drag dmar gyi smin byed dbang dang po ti'i lung rnams stsal/ gzhan yang skal lngan 'ga' zhig la rig 'dzin thugs thig

88 rnam tharadang / 'gyur med tshe dbang phun tshogs la byad grol dang tshe dbang rnams stsal/de skabs a/ rgyan smin grol gling gi zhig gso'i ar las tshugs shing mchod rten tsam ma gtogs phal cher grub/ de nas mkha' spyod bde chen gling ma yum phun tshosas dpal lems kyi gzims spyil phyis lo chen dharma shrīs bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi bsnyen sgrub mdzad pa nyid ha cang chung drags pa la/ rje btsun ṭ+wāṃl+lī'i gtso mo mchog gi gzims spyil du las dpon dge slong grags pas mdzad de bzhengs/ gcen khri rat+na bi dza dang / rje btsun mchog gis dbus grwa tshang dge bshes rnams kyis gter gsar bla ma zhi ba'i sgo nas rab gnas kyi cho ga mdzad cing bkra shis pa'i me tog 'thor / de'i tshe nam mkha' dwangs shing nyi khyim kyi 'ja' skor shar ba sogs dge mtshan mang du byung / de nas lo gsum du gcad rgya dam par bzhugs shing gter gsar drag dmar gyi ljags bsgen skyar gdab dang / gtso bor rdzogs rim gyi ting nge 'dzin kho na las ma g.yengs par thun mtshams rgyun gyi rnal 'byor dang sbrags sha 'ug gter byon thugs rje chen po zab lam bde gshegs kun 'dus phyi nang gsang gsum gyi basben sgrub rnams smin par mdzang// de ltar lo gsum gyi gcad rgya grol rjes skal lngan rnams la bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi zab khrid dang mkha' 'gro'i snyingathig rnams kyi khrid bka' stsal/ dgung lo so bzhir phebs pa me byi'i lor yab rje'i zhal slob 'gyur med rnam grol dang 'gyur med mthar phyin rnams la mkha'

rnamathar 89'gro'i zab khrid gsungs/ dgung grangs so dgur phebs pa na slar yang sha 'ug stag sgor chibs bsgyur thog bstan 'gro'i bde thabs ched bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi sgo nas sbyin sreg dang tshogs brgya rab gnas/ mkha' 'gro'i me mchod/'phrin bcol gnyer gtad/ dar dkar po dri ma med pa la bka' rtsom thog bod 'bangs bde ba'i smon lam bcas mdzad/ der tshogasapa'i skye 'gro dad can rnams la 'chi med yang snying kun 'dus kyi tshe dbang dang chos dang dam rdzas kyi sbyin pas tshims par mdzad pa sogs bstan 'gro la sman pa'i mdzad pa mang du mnga'/ de nas tshur chibs bsgyur gyis sa rta dgung lo bzhi btsur phebs pa'i tshe skal lngan rdo rje'i spun grogs nyis brgya bdun cu tsam la rdzogs chen a ti zab don snying po'i dbang khrid dang / rig 'dzin thugs thig /rdor sems thugs kyi sgrub pa/ bde gshegs kun 'dus bcas kyi dbang dang khrid lung rdzogs par stsal/ 'di'i skabs 'bras ljongs dzo+ogs chen pa byon te mjal 'phrad mdzad/ de nas mdo khams nas bla ma rta mgrin phebs pa la gter gsar dang / mkha' 'gro dhing thig gi dbang khrid/dong sprugs dang khros nag gi dbang rnams rgyas par stsal te lo gcig du bcad rgyar banugs / lcags sprel dgung lo 'e gnyis pa zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gsum nas lnga pa'i tshes lnga'i bar/ zhal slob lnga brgya dang drug cu'i skor la gsang ba snying thig ma bu'i dbang dang zab khrid smin par stsal ba'i skal bzang thob/ de rjes rdo rje phur

90 snangathar bu yang gsang spu gri'i bsten sgrub lo gtsig tu mdzad/ snga phyi kun tu bla ma gsang 'dus / rdor sems thugs sgrub/ 'jam dpal dregs 'joms rnams kyi bsnyen sgrub smin par mdzad de mawo ma'i dge ltas bzang po ci rigs pa byung / khyad par rig pa'i rgyal po'i ljags bsgen mdzad pa'i srod thun zhig la mdun gyi nam mkhar rig pa'i rgyal tsho sku g.yo med du chu ra gtseg gi bar bstan cing / rje ba.oṃ sgro sngon rgya gan du bram ze mo gzugs kyi nyi ma dang / dge slong ma dpal mo rnams kyi skye 'phreng du gzigs shing lung bstan thob/ snying thig ma bu gcig dril gyi gdams pa khrid yig bde chen lam bzang / de'i sngon 'gro chose spyod dang / gzhan yang rje ba'iṣ+ka kyi bla ma'i sa 'byor gdung ba'i mun sel/ gar dbang tshe dpag med kyi brgyud 'debs/ rdor sems thugs sgrub/ gcod khrid kyi brgyud 'debs/thugs thig sogs gter gsar rnams kyi brgyud 'debs/ dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi dbang chog skal bzang dgazha byed/ de'i khrid yig man ngag gsal sgron/rdo rje chos skyong rnams kyi bskang gso kun bzang rol marlo sogs snga phyir bka' rtsom gsar du mdzad pa mang du mchis/ de ltar zhabs rim pa rnams le lo'i dbang bzhi pas zin thor ma bkod pa las mnga' ris dang 'bras ljongar+sāsogs yul gru du mar zhabs kyis bcags shing gsol 'debs/ zhal gdams/ gsung mgur/dkar phyogs kyi lha'i gsol mchod sogs mang po yod ces rje btsun nyid nas

khothar 91gsungs par grags/ de nas sa 'brug lor mnga' ris gung thang rgyal po'i gdung tha sras lcam sku zhabs dpon g.yog rnams la mjal kha dang / tshe bdag drag dmar gyi dbang / spyan ras gzigs yi ge drug ma'i lha khrid rnams stsal/ gzhan yang 'bras ljongs rdzogs chen sprul sku'i yang srid dpon g.yog rnams ched bcar phebs pa la snying thig chen mo dang / mkha' 'gro 3nga thig /dkon mchog spyi 'dus/rig 'dzin srog sgrub/ yab rje bla ma'i gter gsar bcas kyi dbang dang zab khrid smin par gnang / de nas sgrub sde 'chi med bkod du phebs te lo ltar hor zla bzhi r+pānas dgu pa'i bar sgyu 'phrul gsang ba snying po'i rgyud kyi bshad pa mdzad de blo gsar rnams la thol byung gi shes rab bskyed pa'i thabs su sku ngal bskyangs/ de'i tshe 'khor rnams la kye ma rang re'i ma dgon du don mthar phyin pa shin tu dkon la byed lo thos lo tsam las mi 'dug ces gsungs shing rang gnas su phebs te phal cher bcad rgya mdzad/ lo ltar zla ba gsum pa shar mtshams su phyogs 'dus kyi chos zhu ba rnams kyi blo dang 'tshams pa'i re 'dod ltar dam pa'i chos kyi sbyin pas smin par mdzad / de dag gi skabs shig la mdo khams pa rdzogs chen bla ma dpon g.yog rnams la bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi zab khrid dang ri chos zab don gyi lung rnams gsungs / me phag nyor zla bzhi pa'i tshes brgyad nas bzung do nang pad gling sprul sku dpon g.yog gsum/ smin gling grwa mang dang / sog bu bsam gtan chos gling gi

92 sathar btsun ma mang po/ dbus gtsung gi zhal slob sogs 'dus pa brgya dang zhe bdun skor la thugs thig gi zab khrid smin par stsal/ sa byi hor zla gnyis par yab rje 'gro 'dul gter bdag gling pa'i dus mchod du nyang gter bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sgrub mchod sngar sroldolas lhag pa'i zhabs tog dang 'bul tshan gya nom pa'i sta gon thog dngos gzhi'i nyin tshogs phebs ngos 'dus tshogs yongs la phyag 'gyed dang bstan rgyun sbyor 'jags sogs mchod 'bulabasnyen bkur rgyas par mdzad / lung las re zhig gling 'dir mdzad pa rdzogs nas slar skye ba mi 'gru+on pa ltar gsungs na'ang / bu slob gdul bya rnams nas bstan 'gro spyi dang / khyad par 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i ring lugs la dgongs te/ thugs rje'i gzigs pa mi g.yo bar sku skye tshar gcig cis kyang phebs mdzod ces nan gyis zhus pa la/rje btsun nyid nas re zhig skye rgyun 'dis chod pa yin/ 'on kyang 'di'i 'og tu lan gcig rten dge slong zhig tu skye ba ‘then/ de yang 'phral du yong ba'i nges pa med/de dus nged rang rnams 'dzoms pa yong gsungs/ de nas datshing lo don gcig bzhes pa sa glang zla ba bzhi pa'i 'gor grwa tshang dang / bsam gtan chos gling sogs 'dus pa brgya dang drug cu'i skor la zab khrid kyi gdams pa rgyas par gnang /hor zla lnga pa'i tshes bcu gnyis nas do nang pa da gling sprul sku sogs don gnyer lngan pa'i skal ldan brgya phrag tsam la bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi zab khrid ma lus pa

rnam thar 93dzo+ogs par stsaldonas bka' las/ spyir rgyal ba'i bstan zhabs dang snying po'i bstan pa ni nyag shin tu phra bas nub ma rag la thug 'dug pas/ khyed rnams kyis nyams len la nan to mdzad dgos/ khyad par rang re'i chos rgyun rje gter chen bla ma'i zhal slob 'chad spel nus pa da rang nged tsam las med pa ltar 'dug pas/nged thos ga'akho dka' sbyong che yang chos rgyun la bsam pa'i ngang khyad du bsad nas da res gdams pa lhag ma ma lus pa phul ba yin pas/ da ni lus ngal zhing mig dbang yang 'gribs 'gro ba 'dug pas re zhig snod srid kyang / da res lta bu'i smin khrid byed pa zhig yong mi 'gro/ des na gzhan don gyi sngon du rang rgyud smin dgos pas thams cad kyis gtso bor nyams len la rang byan chud pa zhig mdzad dgos/ de thog nas 'chad spel gang nus kyi 'bad pa 'don dgos zhes bka' stsal bas der 'dus tshogs rnams mig mchi mas gang zhing yid dran pa stor ba ltar gyur/ mdor na bange chen shāl+lī'i gtso mo re nyid kyis 'dul byar gyur pa'i skal ldan rnams gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i gdams pa bdud rtsilta bus smin grol gyi lam la bkod de/ zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gcig nas cung zad sgun gyis zin pa'i tshul bstan pa la/ der zhabs brtan dang 'tsho byed kyi sman dpyad sogs zhus par mi bzhes shing / da rim 'gro ma byed ci byed pa yin gsungs/ gzims dpon 'gyur med g.yang 'dzoms la nga yi rjes gcod khyod kyis gyis/ nga rang gnyis 'brel ba nam yang mi spong zhes

94 rnam tharadang / de nasagasung bto de ting nge lon kho na la gnas shing spyan o du dril ba'i lta stangs las mi g.yel bar bzhugs pa ni/ don la rnal 'byu+or ma kun spyod kyi rgyud las/ khrag 'thung la sogs rnal 'byor ma/ /me tog sna tshoges lag na thogs / / rgyal mtshan ba dan sna tshogs dang / /sil snyan sgra ni sna tshogs kyis/ /'chi ba zhes pa rnam rtog sde/ /mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid par byed/ /ces 'byung ba ltar tshes bcu'i tho rengs kyi char gdul bya rtag lodzin ༅ rnams chos la bskul ba'i phyir/ sku gzhon nyams rgyas la gzi byin ldan pas skyil krung dang / phyag g.yas pa snyan gong g.yas kyi thad se gol mdzad pa'i brda dang / g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ spyan gyen du hril gyis dril ba dang 'dzum mdangs ldan pa'i ngang chos sku'i lta stangs kyis dbu gtsug cher 'phags pa'i dwangs ma'i zil pa rlung dang bcas pa khol zhing lud pa sobs ye shes gopa 'pho'i rtags ngo mtshar ba kun gyi spyod yul du bstan nas re zhig gzugs sku'i bkod pa zhi dbyings ka dag chen po'i klong du bsdus te/ rang snang 'od gsal gyi zhing khams mkha' spyod bde ba 'a po'i grong khyer du rig pa 'dzin pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi tshogs dpon du gshegs so/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu gsang sngags theg pa che/ /tshang la ma nor rig 'an brgyud pa'i lung / /ṭ+wāṃ ki'i zhal gyi drod rlangs tho le ba/ /marlo skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig/ //

sa thar 957/ khri rabs gsum pa rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal ni/ de yang rje 'di nyid kyi rigs rus kyi che ba gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa ni yab khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po 'gro 'dul gter bdag gling pa rtsal dang / yum za hor rgyal po gtsug lag 'dzin gyi dbon brgyud las 'khrungs pa phun tshogs dpal 'dzoms rnam gnyis la gdung 'dzin skyes mchog gsum byon pa'i tha chung ste/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing pho khyi'i khrusas zla'i yar tshos lnga la a rgyan smin grol gling gi gzims chung bkra shis snang ba'i khang bzang gi dbus su yum la gnod 'tshe med par sku bltams/yab rje rig waṃn gakho bdag gling pas brtsechen sa 'gror dbang phyug gi sku skye de ma thag pa yin zhes bslu med rdo rje'i lung gis dbugs dbyung / sku na gzhon pa'i dus nas chos 'chad pa dang dbang bskur ba/ gar 'chams dgrangs rol sogs kyis dus 'da' bar mdzad/ khyab bdag gter chen bla ma dang lnga rig smra ba'i dbang po lo chen chos dpal rgya marlo/ rta mgrin gyi zlos gar pad+ma 'gyur med rgya marlo ste yongs 'dzin dam pa rnam gsum 'bral med spyi bo'i rgyan du mdzes pa byas/de yang dgung grangs lnga drug tsam nas yab rje 'gro 'dul gling pa las bla ma zhi drag/rdor sems/ thugs rje chen po'i cha lag gshin rje dregs 'joms che mchog /tshe dpag med/ gsang 'dus/ dong sprugs/ b.lakha brgyad/ tshogs chen 'dus pa sogs dang / pad+ma gling pa/ kun skyong gling pa/ sangs rgyas gling pa/

96 /pathar rat+na gling pa/ zhig po gling pa/ mnga' bdag nyang gi gter chos/ rig 'dzin dngos grub rgyal mtshan gyi chos ba/kha byang gter sogs mdor na gter kha gong 'og dang / bla rdzogs thugs gsum gtsobo gyur pa'i bka' gter mang po'i dbang lung man ngag zab khrid gdams ngag ma lus pa chig brgyud bum pa gang las tshul du nod/lo chen chos dpal rgya mcho las/ sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i dbang / 'dus pa mdo dbang chen mo/ rog lugs phur pa'i dbang / dpal ldan dus kyi 'bor lo'i dbang yongs rdzogs/ sems sde ma bu bco brgyad/ bla ma dgongs 'dus/gu ru chos dbang gi bla ma gsang 'dus/ dong sprugs pad+ma brgya ldan sogs mtha' yas pa gsan/ mkhyen brtsenus pa'i mnga' bdag pad+ma 'gyur med rgya mtsho las/bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs lugs gsum gyi dbang rgyas pa dang / yang dag b.lakha ma / sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ rgyud sde lnga'i dbang / b.lakha brgyad bde 'dus kyi dbang rnams dang / yab rje'i gter gsar yongs rdzogs kyi bka' dbang /sgrub thabs 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang nang gi dbang rjes gnang dang bcas par gsan bsam rgya chen po mdzad/ bar skabs rje de nyid a rgyan smin grol gling dus 'gyur gyi skabs sdig to can rnams kyis brdzi bar ma nus par mon bod kyi sa mtha' rnams su re zhig byol nas rim bzhin rtsari'i brgyud khams phyogs su zhal phyogs te mkho khyim dgon du zhabs sor 'khod/ tshul 'di ni sngar yab rje gter bdag gling

rnamathar 97pas 'byung 'gyur gyi gnas rnams sgrib med mngon sum du gzigs te/ go 'jo phyogs su ma 'ongs par mkho ba'i khyim lta bu 'byung zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dus 'dir mkhas ba.oṃ bzang po'i rnam thar mchog tu mnga' ba 7skyabs rje mkho khyim rin po che 'gyur med mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i sku phreng dang po blam rnam grol bzang po mchog gi gtsos go 'jo mkho 67 dgon gong 'og gi dge 'dun dang / gzhan yang yul phyogs de'i mi sna che gras khag bcas kyis chibs bsu ser sbreng spros bcas kyi sgo nas gdan sa chen po mkho khyim dgon du gdan drangs/ gnas de'i yul dgon gyi bla dpon gyis gasdus ser skya grangs las 'das par rang gter gyis mtshon pa'i gter kha gong 'og gi dbang lung dang / zab rgyas chos kyi bdud rtsis skal ldan dpag tu med pa thar lam du 'dren par mdzad/ gzhan yang khams phyogs kyi snga 'gyur rnying ma'i chos sde chen po kaḥthog /rdzogs chen/ zhe chen sogs phyogs de'i rnying dgon che phra kun la zhabs kyis bcags/ bla chen dang dpon chen sogs ser skya gtso phal kun la sngar yongs 'dzin dam pa dag las ji ltar nod pa'i gter chos mtha' yas pa dang / mdo sgyu sems gsum sogs bka' ma'i phyogs kyi chos skor kun kyang lan grangs re zung ma 'chad pa med/ skabs der gu ru zhi drag la sogs yi dam du ma bsnyen cing drag po mngon spyod kyi las la mthu thob/ chos dang zang zing gnyis sha'i phrin las shin tu rgya che bar gyur te dngos po'i 'byu+or pa yang

98 rnamathararnam thos sras la mgran bzod pa lta bu gyur to/ /dgung grangs nyer dgu bzhes pa'i tshe gnam bskos 'jam dgrangs gong ma chen po'i thugs rje'i nyi mas bdud dmag ngan pa'i smag rum de dag pha mthar bskrad de spa bkong bar byas/ gangs can bod kyi lha gcig 'dzam gling skye dgu'i 'dren pa rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mtsho gru 'dzin 'jig rten dbang phyug gi pho brang chen po'i gser khrir mnga' gsol/ bod yul skye dgu so so'i lugs kyi chos dang srid kyi bya ba sngar lugs bzhin skyongs/ zhes bka' lung khyad par bsgrags pa las rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i nyin byed slar yang mgron du shar ba na/ dgon ma lag dang bcas pa sngar ltar lhogs te/ dbu che khur chen pa rnams kyi spyan 'dren byung / rta drel mdzo g.yag sogs gya nom pa'i dngos nor blo'i rwa ba las brgas ba'i 'bul mtshon dang bcas te 'phral du btegs/gru 'dzin 'jeg rten dbang phyug gi pho brang chen po'i yang thog tu rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mtshor mjal phyag mdzad/ 7gong sa mchog gis gong ma gter chen chos kyi rgyal po'i khri thog tu mnga' dbang bskur ba'i bskos cha dang 'ja' sa sogs tham ka stsal / rang zhabs pa rnams kyis bsu ba ser sbreng gis bkur snyi dang bcas smin gling gdan sar phyag phebs/ skabs der nam mkha' la 'ja' sprin 'khrigs pa dang / sa g.yo ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rnam 'gyur sna tshogs su byung zhing / dus gang gi tshe grwa rigs bu slob sku nye yon bdag sogs nye ring kun nas pad+ma'i mcho la

/pa thar 99ngang pa 'du ba bzhin slob ma stong phrag mang po'i dbus su mi waṃgs gdong lnga'i khri dpang mthon por zhabs zung bkod/ rim par zab rgyas chos kyi bdud rdzimatha' yas pas gzhan rgyud smin par mdzad pa'i phrin las bla na med pa byung / dam pa 'di nyid ni sngon nas gter chen nyid kyis phyi mtha' gzigs pas don gyi gdan sar khri gdon mdzad pa 'dra ste/ sku mya ngan las 'da' bar phyogs pa'i lo de'i nang du gcung kun dga' tshul khrims kyi do khur chen pos bshad 'gyur gsar bzhengs dang /chos 'bor lhun po'i steng du gser gyi rgya phibs bzo bkod ngo mtshar ba bsgrubs te mdzes par spras nas rab tu gnas par gsol ba sogs sngar spyi don khog phub tu gleng zin pa bzhin no/ /de ltar gdan sar phebs nas gtsug lag khang phan tshun sngar rgyun ltar gsos/ 'dus tshogs sngar yod rnams la bar skabs su 'dul khrims gtsang ma'i dag ther mdzad/ gsar zhugs rimacan khyon dge 'dun sum brgya brgas ba tsam bslab gsum dang 'khor lo gsum gyi bya ba'i gnas la bkod/sngar yab mes kyis srol gtod mdzad pa'i sgrub mchod nyams pa rnams tshul bzhin gsos / gar 'chams spyan gzigs la sogs pa'i yo byad sngon dus kyi gung tshang bsgrigs/ de nas dbus gtsang gnyis kyi sde 'khrug gi mthar sa sprel hor zla lnga pa'i tshes nyer lnga la phun tshogs sngebazhi'i dpal gyis mngon par phyug pa dpal mi'i dbang po 'gyur med bsod nams stobs rgyal mchog /'jam dgrangs gong

100 rnam tharam rgyal pos bod khri skor bcu gsum gyi rgyal srid la dbang bskur ba'i mnga' gsol legs skyes kyi mjal 'bul la phebs/ dad mos kyis gus shing btud de rkyen sel dbang sogs nus te ti shrīr bskur/ bsgen bkur gyi gnang skyes rgya cher stsal zhing yi rang ba'i bsngags brjod mdzad/ de nas rang dgon du gong ma'i rnam thar gyi rjes su nugs te dbang lung khrid sogs dang / khyad par gsang ba snying po'i rgyud kyi bshad pa nub tu nye ba slar 'chad nyan gyis spel nas sngar srol ltar chos kyi phrin las rgya cher bskyangs/ gsungs las skyes pa'i zhal slob kyi tshogs kyang gzhis byes gnyis kar gzhan don nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mang po ༷na te/de yang las bzhi'i phrin las la mnga' dbang 'byor ba'i bla ma rnam grol bzang po/hor bla ma gyur med skal bzang / dpal ri bla ma kun bzang 'od zer/ bla ma rnam rgyal grags pa/ mon yul the po bla ma/ bla ma pad+ma dar rgyas/ bla ma 'dren mchog / bla ma rig 'dzin rnams dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyis rgyal bstan rin po che bla nas blar 'degs pa la phrin las gzhan dring mi 'jog pa rdo brag rig 'dzin chen po'i mchog sprul/ rdzogs chen sku phreng gnyis pa 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ rje btsun ma mi 'gyur dpal sgron/ 'phyong rgyas dpal ri sprul sku/rgyan pa dge theg sprul sku chung ba/ kong po thogs chen sprul sku/ chab mdo 'phags pa lha'i sprul sku/ ba skal sprul sku/ rje drung sprul sku/ zangs mkhar

rnamathar 101sprul sku/ thang 'brog sprul sku/ rtseli sprul sku/ kaḥthog rig 'dzin chen sa/chos rgyal gling pa yab sras/ grub chen phrin las mthar phyin/ grub chen rat+na sed+me / shing rtsasprul sku/ zhe chen rab 'byams sprul sku/ mnga' bdag thong ston rig 'dzin rgya mcho/ gter chen nyi ma grags pa'i sprul sku/ za ra sprul sku sogs dang / gnung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i dbang phyug a rgyan skal bzang /65ོ rgyan chos grags/ mkhan chen 'gyur med don yod/ rab 'dra/mas smra ba chos grags / blo gsal rgya maḥkha so gas dang / lugs gnyis kyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa mi rje bsod nams stobs rgyal/ sde dge bstan pa tshe ring / mi rje mdo mkhar blo bzang bkra shis/ mtsho gesna rdzong dpon sogs dpon rigs dang rje rigs nams te mdor na rje 'di'i zhal slob dang yang slob kyis bod gangs can ljongs dang stod rgya gar nas smad rgya nag bar dkar 'byams su khyab te rgyal bstan rin po cher mdzad rjes zla med pa bskyangs/ mthar dgung grangs drug cu rtsalnga pa sa pho stag gi lor re 'ig gling 'di'i mdzad pa bsdus pa'i dus su babs par gzigs nas shar phyogs dwags po'i gnas 'ol khar phebs/ der rigs sras thu bo zham 'bring dang bcas pa la 'da' me ka'i zhol chems rgya cher stsal te/ nag zla'i tshes nyi shu la/ ngo mtshar ma 'a dbe'i pad+mo 'i ba mos waṃngs su sa shing rang snang 'od gsal gyi sku dbugs chen 'byin pa'i zhing khams nyams dga' bar bya rgyal khyung si nam 'phang

102 rnamatharabacad pa ltar gshegs/ sku gdung gdan sar spyan drangs te zhugs su phul ba sogs 'das rjes kyi bya ba rnams mthar phyung / dbu stod nang gzungs su bzhugs pa'i dngul dkar gyi byang chub chen po'i mchod rten bzhengs/ sngar gtsug las khang dbus ma gsang sngags pho brang du bzhugs pa las bstan pa 'phel grib kyi dbang las da lta gang du yod pa ni 'chad par dka' ba'i gnas so/ /yang das tshad ma gsum gyi nga ro yis/ /lta dman ri dwags tshogs rnams skrag mdzad pa/ /theg mchog seng ge'i sgra dgrangs sa gsum khyab/ /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig/ //

/pa thar 103tsha/ khri rabs bzhi pa gdung sras chen po 'gyur med pad+ma bstan 'dzin ni/ yab rje paṇ+ḍita bi ma la'i rnam sprul du lung gis zin pa khri rin chen rnam rgyal mchog dang /yum byang chub sems ma'i yon tan mtha' dag gis brgyan pa tshe dbang dpal 'dzoms gnyis kyi sras su dmar ser can zhes pa me mo sbrul gyi lor 'og min gnyis pa a rgyan smin grol gling gi gzims chung bkra shis snang bar dge mtshan bzang po du ma dang bcas te sku bltams/ sngon rabs phreng bar goms pa'i bzang po'i bags chags nye bar sad cing / yab rje dam pas thugs gtad byin rlabs las / ngang tshul zhi zhing des pa dang byams dang snying rje gtong ba la goms pa sogs dam pa'i yon tan rnams ngam ngam ro/gas kyis gsal/ na tshode ches phra ba'i dus nas kyang shes bya rig pa kun gyi gzhi ma yi ge 'bri klog sosas la tshegs med kyis goms pa mthar son/ dgung lo lnga pa'i steng rang lugs snga 'gyur ba'i pha chos rgyud sde kun gyi gzhi ma rtsargyud gsang ba snying po thugs 'dzin mdzad de tshogs rgyugs phul bas 'dus pa rnams ngo mtshar zhing mi phyed pa'i dad pa'i sa la bkod / de nas bzung spyir gzhung dang rig gnas du ma'i rtsab thugs 'dzin dang khyad par du chos rje smin gling pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin gter kha gsar rnying sogs b.lakha gter gyi 'don cha rgyugs 'dzin khag la thugs brtson mdzad/ gsan bsam gyi snod du gyur pa nas bzung gtso bo yab rje rig 'odzan chen po'i zhabs pad mnyes pa

104 rnamatharagasum gyi sgo nas spyi bo'i gtsug tu bsten pa'i mthus/ bshes spring / sdo/ma/ 'grel chen mo/ spyod 'jug sogs gzhung spyi dang / khyad par kun mkhyen chen po dang rig 'dzin 'jigs gling rnam gnyis kyi gzhung lugs dam pa du ma dang rgyud lung man ngag gi gnad mtha' dag 'dus pa rtsargyud gsang ba snying po'i bka' srol zur pa yab sras nas brgyud pa 7mes po lo chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung rab kyi zab don rnams la gsan bsam mthil phyin par mdzad/ mdor na thun mong rig gnas nas bzung mdo sngags dka' gter bdud rtsi'i chu klung gi rgyun grags che ba thams cad kyi dbang khrid gdams pa thams cad ngoms pa med par bum pa gang byo'i tshul du nod pas don gyi gdung 'dzin dam par dbang 'byor bas yab rje dam pa yang thugs dgyes pa'i rtser son/ gzhan yang khu mo rje btsun ma mi 'gyur dpal sgron/ gsung sprul lnga pa/ grub mchog rdo rje/ nyang ston rig 'dzin rgya mtsho rnams kyis gtsos grags che ba'i mtshan lngan gyi skyes chen dam pa ris su ma mchis pa du ma zhig kyang yul dus ci rigs par zhabs pad spyi bos len te gsar rnying gi gdams pa du ma zhig kyang gsan bsam nyams bzhes mdzad/ dus de tsam na mkhas grub kyi bo 'phang mthon por son te bod ljongs/ rgyal bstan yongasardzogs kyi mnga' bdas lta bur gyur/ yab chos gter gsar las thugs chen thugs thig /rngor sems/ legs dang / gter rnying las chos dbang gi bla ma

sa thar 105gsang 'dus/ nyang gi bka' brgyad bder 'dus sogs dang / gzhan yang bka' ma'i chog grwa brgyad sogs mdor na snga 'gyur gyi rgyud sde du ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dal zhal phye nas sgrub pa mdzad pas bsnyen sgrub kyi nyams lenamatha' dag rab kyi tshad du 'byol/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis la gding thob/ dag pa'i snang ba mtha' klas—/ gzhan phan gyi snying rje mkha' ltar brdal ba sogs yang dag pa'i dngos grusakyi mtshan ma mngon du gyur/ dkyil 'khor du ma'i las rab 'byams kyi sgo nas bod 'bangs mtha' dag gi phan bde dang bstan srid kyi zhabs rim chen mo/mchog dman bar ma'i skye 'gro kun gyi re 'dod rnams chos mthun yid bzhin du bskangs pas kun gyis smon pa'i gnas su bzhugs/ dgung lo nyer gnyis par yab rje rig 'dzin chen po nyid dgongs pa zhi dbyings su gshegs pa'i 'das rjes dgongs rdzogs su rgyud gzhung du ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi chos rgyun gsar du 'dzugs/sku gsung thugs kyi rten spyi dang khyad par yab rje rig 'dzin chen po'i gdung chen nugs su gsol ba'i mchod rten ngo mtshar dpal du 'bar ba bzhengs/ de dag ldorab tu gnas pa'i cho ga phun sum tshogs pa mdzad pa'i dga' ston dang 'brel dam pa 'di nyid kyang rje gter chen bla ma yid ba'in dbang gi rgyal po'i seng ge'i khri chen por zhabs zung bkod de mnga' gsel brtan bzhugs kyi rim pa rnams rang lugs kyi spros bcas kyi cho ga ltar rgyas par mdzad/ rgyal ba gong ma'i rnam thar bdag

106 snamatharagir bzhes te/ bstan 'gror sman pa'i thugs bskye da bla na med pa'i go cha bgos te kha ba ri pa'i skye 'gro spyi dang khyad par snga 'gyur ba'i gdul bya/ bye brag 'og min a rgyan smin grele gling pa'i dgon sde ma lag dang bcas pa'i chos gzhi la thugs brtsechen pos rjes su bzung ste sri zhu che thang du bskyangs/ bstan 'gro spyi sgos kyi dge mtshan mtha' dag dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad/ de ltar dam pa 'di nyid pha shul bus 'dzin zer ba ltar sku mched rnam gnyis chos dang mtshungs par sku tshe hril po bdag bas gzhan gces byang chub sems dpa'i bstul zhugs kyis bstan 'gro yongs kyi phan bde'i dge mtshan bla nas blar 'degs shing / snga 'gyur ba'i dbang lung bshad bka'i rgyun spyi dang chos rje gterdo chen sku mched kyi mdo sngags bka' gter yongs rdzogs kyi chos rgyun dang / phyag bzhes phrin sgrub rnams nyams pa sar chud mi nyams gong 'phel mdzad de phrin las mthar phyung nas/gdul bya nye bar gnas pa rnams la phyi mtha'i zhal chems dang gdams pa lhug par stsal te re zhig gzusas sku'i bkod pa chos kyi dbyengs su bsdu bar mdzad do/ /med byung a ti yo ga'i gseng lam nas/ /ma lus rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sku/ /khyab bdag 'jam dpal rdo rjer rab bsgrubs pa/ /marlo skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig/ //

snamathar 1077/ khri rabs lnga pa khri chen 'gyur med phrin las rnam rgyal mchog ni/ yab rje khri chen 'gyur med pad+ma bstan 'dzin gyi rigs sras su ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te sku bltams/ mtshan 'gyur med phrin las rnam rgyal du gsol/ gzhon nu'i dus nas dge ba'i bag chags mngon par sad cing / skyes thob kyi shes rab mchog tu gyur pa lhan skyes su mnga'/ yab rje dang khu bo sogs la bsten nas mdo sngags kyi gnas la gsan bsam sgom pa rgya cher mdzad pa dang / mkhyen rtogs kyi rtsal dzo+ogs pas gzhan la dbang bskur ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang /man ngag gdams pa dang / khyad par bsnyen sgrub las gsum gar thig dbyangs rol sogs cho ga phyag bzhes phra rags thams cad la byang chub par mdzad/ phyis yab rje 'i bar gshegs pa na dgongs rdzogs kyi phyir gdung mchod rgyas par bsgrubs shing phyi nang gi rten khyad par ༅ du ma gsar du bzhengs/ mi ring bar rang gi khu bo mkhan chen a rgyan bstan 'dzin rdo rjes/ mi 'jigs gdong lngas stegs pa'i gser gyi khri 'phang chen por mnga' gsol gyi rten 'brel rgyas par mdzad/ ji skad du mdo sde rgyan las/ mgo la sems can khur chen khyer ba yi/ /sems dpa' mchos rnam/sa ngal gyis 'gro li mdzes/ /zhes pa ltar dam pa rang nyid nas kyang gdan sa'i khur chen po bdag gir bzhes/ slar yang mkhan rin po che'i drung nas/spyir rang lugs rnying ma'i chos su gtogs pa nang rgyud sde gsum gyis mtshon bka'

108 rnam tharagater yongs rdzogs kyi dbang lung gdams pa rnams dang / khyad par rang gi gnog chos su gyur pa bla rdzogs thugs gsum gyis mtshon pa'i smin gling gter chen dang / lo chen rin po che rnam gnyis kyi bga' 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi dbang dang lung khrid gdams pa rnams gsan/ gzhan yang rig gnas che chung sogs mdor na rang gi khu bo'i thugs la ji ltaramanga' ba rnams bum pa gang byo'i tshul du nod cing mkhyen par mdzad/ de ltar gdan sa 'og min a rgyan smin grol gling gi chos rwa chen por dam pa gong ma'i phyag srol ma nyams par phrin las rnam pa bzhi yis gang la gang 'dul gyi tshul gyis chos 'khor btsugs pa sogs bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che mdzad/ mthar gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi nye rgyu la brten nas gzugs sku bsdus shing rnga yab dpal gyi ri bo pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang du gshegs so/ /ring brgyud bka' yi chu bo ma nyams shing / /sngon med dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i gsang gtam gnad/ /nye brgyud zab gter nor bu'i mdzod nas thon/ /mcho skyes rgyal ba'i ring lugs rgyas gyur cig/ //

rnamathar 109tsa/ khri rabs drug pa 'gyur med pad+ma dbang rgyal ni/ yab khri 'gyur med phrin las rnam rgyal gyi sras su 'khrungs shing gter chen rnam 'phrul du grags/ chung ngu'i dus nas bzang po'i bag chags mngon du gyur te yi ge 'bri klog sogs rnam dkar chos spyod kyi bya ba la dgyes shing dka' tshegs cher ma dgos par mkhyen/de nas ji skad pu bshes gnyen dam pa zhi zhing nyer zhi ba/ /yon ༅ lhag par brtson byas lung gis phyug /de nyid rab tu rtogs la smra mkhas ldan/ /brtseba'i bdag nyid skyo ngal spangs la brten/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rdor 'dzin bshes gnyen rnams las rig 'dzin gong ma'i phyag bzhes dang / mdo sngags kyi gzhung rnams la gsan bsam ma dman par mdzad/ khyad par yab rje rig 'dzin chen po dang rje ga'iphrin las chos sgron rnam gnyisagatsun gi nor bur bsten te ba/'a gter smin grol gyi rgyun dang / man ngag zab rgus thugs rgyud phyug par mdzad/ gzhan yang lhag pa'i lha rtsab gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub la rtag tu gzhol zhing / gong ma'i mdzad pa bdag gir bzhes te gdul bya rnams chos mthun gyi lam la bkod/bskyed rdzogs ting nge lodzin la dbang 'byu+or bas 'jis rten gyi chos dang grub mtha'i kha 'dzin la rtsis gdab mi mdzad pa sogs 'khor 'das re dwogs kyi gtad so zhig /skal ba dang lngan pa'i gang zag las can rnams la smin grol gdams ngag zab mo skog chos su stsal/ rdzogs sprul bzhi pa mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje sogs bstan

110 rmematharapa 'dzin pa 'i zhal slob mang du byung / ma/thar brgyud 'dzin bu slob rnams la tshe rabs kun tu dge ba'i tha tshig gi bslab bya mang du mdzad de re 'ig mtshan dpe'i gzugs sku pad+ma he ru ka snang srid zil gnon gyi thusas kar bsdus se / /mkhas r+shang grub pa brles pa'i skyes bu ngam pa gang nyid bstan 'gro la phan pa'i bka' drin dang / ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar mang du mchis pa gor ma chag kyang bar skabs kla klo'i dpung gis gtor bzhis si rkyen pas 'dir sa bon tsam las rnam thar phyag dpe tshang thub mi stsang bas 'brir ma nus lags/ /zab rgyas theg chen lung rtogs chu bo'i ma/dzod/ /meng byung rim gnyis lam gyi klu dbang brjid/ /dngos grub rinachen brgya yis yongs gang ba/ /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i ring lugs rgyas gyur cis/ ༈ rme—— ricicici

rnam thar 111lto/ rje btsun ma 'gyur med phrin las chos sgron ni/ yab 'gyur med phrin las rnam rgyal mchog gi rigs kyi sras mor ngo mtshar ltas bzang po dang bcas te sku 'i mtshan dpe'i pad+mor gsar du bzhad/ sku na gzhon nu'i skabs nas 'bri klog sogs yon tan thams cad la mkhyen rab shin tu rgyas/ khu dbon rnams dang rab 'byams pa dpal mgon sogs las mdo sngags kyi chos la gsan pa rgya cher mdzad de mkhas pa'i phul du phyin/ chos rje smin gling pa'i sgrub thabs 'dod 'jo bum bzang sogs gter gsar rnams dang / pad gling pa'i ngabang chog sogs mang po gsan te nges sasang don gyi bstan pa'i bdag por gyur/ rtsagasum lhag pa'i lha mang po'i bsgen sgrub la gzhol zhing grub pa'i rtags mngon sum mthun snang du grub/khyad par yab rje phrin las rnam rgyal las rdzogs chen gsang ba snying thig gi chos skor rnams gsan te sku tshe hril por thugs nyams su ba'es shing rtogs pa'i gdengs tshang mngon du gyur/ sna nga bzhi zad sar 'khyol zhing rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i brgyud 'dzin mchog tu gyur/ mkhyen kong rnam gnyis sogs kyis smi na gling pa'i chos skor dang rdzogs pa chen poklo nga chen snying thig sogs chos tshul rgya mamo lta bur rje ge'i ma 'di las sasan cing rim par phyogs kun tu khyab/ gzhan don du dbangacasogadams khrid sogs chos kyi 'khor lo'i mdzad pa dpag tu med pa bskyangs pas rje'il bya rgya che zhing slob tshogs grangs las 'das pa smin grol gyi gnas la bkod/
(k+ṣiṃñcharnye pakhripy-i rtibye0rdohā/rdo (ོgesnamyush+lau rmyublamon+tu+olharam̐dh+ramyu/༷sngu/bhā

sa thar 1137/ khri rabs bdun pa gnubs chen gyi sprul par grags pa khri chen 'gyur med sangs rgyas kun dga' dpal bzang po mchog ni/ chos kyi rgyal po a/ rgyan gter bdag gling pa'i zlos gar khri chen pad+ma dbang rgyal mchos gi rigs kyi myu gur mawo dpe'i ge sar gsar du bzhad/ sku na chung ngu'i dus nas 'bri klog sogs mthar phyin te mkhyen rab kyi blo gros rgyas/ yab rje mchog gis gtsos tshad thub kyi skyes chenadu ma las snga 'gyur bsha' gter gyis mtshon chos bka' dpag tu med pa bum pa gang le'i tshul du nod de thugs kyi bum bzang bdud rtsis yongs su gang bar mdzang /gzhanayang phyi nang gsang ba'i yon ༅ mtha' yasashing 'khor logasum gyi phrin las kyi 'jug pa rgya che bas nges don snying po'i bstan par bka' drin bla na med pa ni/rdzogs chen snying thig gtso bore gyur pa'i.a rgyanasmin grol gling nas brgyud pa'i gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i dbang dang smin grol gyi gdams pa sogs chos tshul rgya marlo rnams 'jam dgrangs mkhyen brtsedabang pos gsan te nye brgyud snying thig gi bka' babs / de las pad+ma gar dbang 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas kyis gsan nas snying thig ma bu'i khrid gzhung gsar du mdzad/ de ltar 'jam dgrangs mkhyen brtsedabang po dang / rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas/ 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas rnams kyis rje 'di dang / khri chen pad+ma dbang rgyal/ rje btsun ma phrin las chos sgron rnam gsum las gsan pa sogs las zhal slob dang yang slob kyis bod

114 rmapatharakhams tha gru kun la khyab par gyur to/ /mthar re zhig sku'i ngangos kyi gdul bya rjegs pa'i tshul gyis nang sasal chos sku'i dbyings su thim mo/ /bangag sngon brtson 'grus dang lngan pas/ /rtag tu bstun cing pha rol gnon/ /sems can thams cad bsgral don pu /bdag bstan yun ring 'bar gyur cig/ //zhetsho

rnamathar 115lnge/ khri rabs brgyad pa 'gyur med yid bzhin dbang rgyal mchog ni/ khri chen rdo rje 'chang chen ngo/ sangs rgyas kun dga' mchog gi sras su 'khrungs/ sngon goms kyi bag chags bzang po 'i mthu las phal pa'i bu+o spyod las 'das pa'i rtags mtshon mtha' yas pa mnga'/ ji skad pu yon tan ma 'u/sa brtson 'grus rjes 'gre 3nga / /bsod nams blo gros tshogs ni gnyis kyi rgyu/ /'es gsungs pa ltar brtson pa chen po'i sā+o nas yab rje sogs yongs 'dzin bshes gnyen du ma las gzhung lugs rab 'byams gsan te mdo rgyud bstan bcos kun la mkhyen rab kyi spobs pa mchog tu rgyas shing mkhas grub kyi go 'phang mthon por bshegs/gzhan yang / me tog gi ni ma/so lcog bzhin/ /dam pa 'i spyo da pa rnam gnyis/ te/ /'jig rten spyi bor bkur ba dang / /nags nyid du ni sanas pa 'o/ /zhes pa ltar bshang sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas rgyal bstan spyi dang khyad par snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa rin po che 'odzan skre nga spel gsum gyi phrin la sa 'gran zla dang bral/ ba'i stso nas 'brel tshad kyi skye 'gro rnams byang chen gyi sa la bkod pa'i phrin la sa mtha' yas nga zhig sto / bar na bas nges gsang snying po'i bstamyo pa'i gzi byin ma nyams/ nga/ra gong 'phel du bskye da pa so/sas༈ kyis blos gzhal ba'i gnas ma/ yi/na pa'i dri na las/ dang / phyi nang lasang gsum gyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa mchis mong kyang lo rgyus yig rigs shin tu dkon pas ji bzhin brjed pa/'i gnas su ma/ gyur nga
gyirmyo+o+o/ s+dza /pyuspyordzophro mūrdzi+o

rnam thar 117lto/ khri rabs dgu pa 'gyur med bde chen mchog grub ni/ khri chen 'gyur med pad+ma dbang rgyal gyi sras chung ba mkhan kun dga' tshul khrims rdo rjer grags pa mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan gyis mngon par mtho ba mkhan rabs kyi khrir banugs na yang / ji skad du gu ru chos dbang gyi rnam thar las/ yab spangs ston grub pa'i snying pos/ bla ma sangs rgyas snyi sgom la bdag tshangs par spyod pa zhu zhus pas/ darge slong sde brgyad las byang chub sems dpa' gcig 'gro don che bas / byang chub sems dpa'i gdung ma bcad ces 'byung ba ltar/ gcen khri 'gyur med yid bzhin dbang rgyal la gdung sras ma byung bas bstan rgyun la dgongs te bslab pa phul nas khri rabs dgu pa mdzad pas mtshan khri bde chen mchog grub tu gsol / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas rgyal bstan spyi dang khyad par snga 'gyur ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'dzin skyong spelagasum gyi phrin las 'gran zla dang bral bas rang lugs snying po'i bstan pa'i gzi byin ma nyams par byung / 'di la bi ma'i rnam 'phrul du grags pa'i rigs sras gcig 'khrungs shing 'jam dbyams mkhyen brtse dbang pos thugs snang dgyes pa chen pos mjal bar byon pa las/dam sri'i bar chang kyi dbang las sku na chung ngu'i skabs bla brang yang thog nas glo bur du g.yang gzar lhung ste gshegs tshul skor lo rgyus 'ga' zhig yod na'ang / rnam thar khungs thub dmigs gsal mjal ba'i skal ba ma byung bas 'dir 'ol tshod
྾ l+līwa06 pyaXskrewa byelngelngu s+hoñju+o/ my-iñja//

rnam thar 119lto/ smin gling khri rabs bcu pa 'gyur med den grub dbang rgyal ni/ nyag sras khri chen kun dga' bstan 'dzin nam pad+ma dbang chen dang / yum khri yid bzhin dbang rgyal gyi sras mo lnga'i tha chung bag dre'am 'chi med don ldan sgrol ma'i sras su rab byung bco lnga pa'i nang sku 'khrungs/ gzhon nu'i dus nas yi ge 'bri klog gis mtshon cho ga phyag bzhes sogs la sbyang brtson mdzad/ yab rje khri chen kun dga' bstan 'dzin sogs yongs 'dzin rnams las sde snod kyi gzhung mang por gsan bsam mdzad/ gzhung sa mchog gi bdag rkyen dang gzigs mthong rgya che'i thog gong ma'i khri la mnga' gsol/ rim par khri chen gong ma rnams kyi mdzad pa bdag gir bzhes te 'brel tshad thams cad chos dang zang zing gis bskyangs/ rim gnyis zab mo'i lam la brten nas hā+okha pa chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor lagacig tu brtson pas re dwogs spang blang gi mtshams las 'das pa'i gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa klong du gyur/ 'on kyang gdul bya bsod nams dman pa dang / rgyal 'gong dam sri'i cho 'phrul stobs su gyur pa las sku tshe smad tsam nas mdzad spyod rtsing por gyur pa sogs mdzad phrin gang cir legs nyes rtsis gdab med par thol byung gi spyod pa bskyangs / de'i tshe rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa thub bstan rgya mtshos a/ rgyan smin grol 'di snga 'gyur rnying ma ba'i chu 'go lta bur gzigs shing nyams rgud shugs che 'byung bar thugs la dwogs nas re zhig rdor 'dzin rnam grol rgya mtshoge khri tshab tu

120 sa tharabasko bar mdzad/ 'di la rnam thar kha gsal med kyang gong 'og bsdebs pa dang /ngag sgros khungs dag nges snyam pa kha cig ltar na/ khri chen 'di thun min gsang spyod kyi gnas la thugs gtad pas snga phyir rig ma mang du brten/ thog mar dwags po gronge pa'i sras mo skal bzang sgrol dkar dang 'dus pa las sras lcam dral drug tsam byung yang chung ngu nas gshegs/ yang mtshan mi gsal ba'i bdag mo zhig la sras mo rig 'dzin sgrol dkar zhes pa byung yang dgung grangs nyer gnyis las ma bzhugs/ de nas slar dwags po grong pa'i lcam zla ba sgrol ma khab tu bzhes pa las gdung sras sku bgres kun bzang dbang rgyal da ltar 'tsho zhing bzhugs pa dang / gdung sras sku gzhon 'jam dpal chos grags ste yab yum gcig pa'i sku mched gnyis las/ 'jam dpal chos kyi grags pa ni mkhan rabs dgu pa'i mdzad 'khur bzhes rgyu'i re 'dun dang thugs bzhed rgya che yod na'ang / nyag rong klu mo rab dgon par gdung brgyud sku ngo ma zhig gdan zhu dgos pa'i snyan gseng phul ba ltar byon zhing / gsan bsam slob gnyer gnang mus la kla klo'i btsan dbang 'og /rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu yos lor zhing khams gzhan du gshegs par grags so/ /smon log dam sri'i 'phrul dang rgya 'dre'i g.yul/ /kla klo'i sbyor ngan la sogs nag phyogs kyi/ /rtsub 'gyur ldang ba'i go skabs gtan bcom ste / mucho skyes ring lugs phyogs mthar rgyas gyur cig/ //

rnam thar 1217/ 7skyabs rje bdud lngoms waṃgs bral ye shes rdo rje ni/ a rgyan bde chen gling pa'i gter lung las/ ma 'ongs bod yul gangs ri rtsedasmu'i shar:rang byung phag mo'i gsang ba'i zhing khams su: rje yi rigs las 'brog ban rnam rol ni: dz+nyā na'i ming can sngags kyi brtul zhugs 'dzinaca cha lugs ma nges byis spyod shes rab phywa: gter gsar 'don nam gter rnying bstan pa skyong:'brel tshad rnga yab gling du 'dren pa 'byung: zhes pa bzhin bod rje gnya' khri btsan po'i brgyud pa/ spu bo kaḥganam rgyal po'i rigs brgyud yab kaḥthog sprul sku nor bu bstan 'dzin dang / yum rata gling gdung rigs rnam rgyal sgrol ma gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bco lnga pa'i shing 'brug lor ngo mtshar gyi rtags snang mtha' klas pa dang bces te sku 'khrungs/ de yang khrag 'thung bdud 'joms gling pas/ da ni snyigs ma'i dus mthar sbas yul pad+ma bkod du 'gro ba'i dus yin pas/ nged la re ltos 'cha' ba kun de phyogs su song dang / gzhon pa khyod tshosna ma slebs gong rgan po nga sngon la slebs pa zhig byed yong zhes sogs phyi mtha' gzigs pa'i lung bstan gsungs pa bzhin/ bdag nyid chen po de'i sku'i skye ba de ma thag pa yin pas sngon rabs rnams tha ler gsal/ sasung phye ba tsam nas gong ma'i mdzad pa rnams shar 4sdis gsungs pas phyogs kun tu rtsod med kyi sprul pa'i skur grags/ de nas rim (mezhin rje gong ma'i zhal slob phug sprul 'gyur med nges don dbang po dang / gling

122 rnamatharabla ma thub bstan chos 'byor sogs phebs nas/ khrag 'thung bdud 'joms gling pa'i sku skyer na bza' mtshan gsol khri 'don sogs mdzad/ yi ge 'bri klog sogs thun mong rig pa'i gnas rnams sbyang ba'i skabs mkhyen rab kyi rtsal kha me ltar 'bar bas gang gsan pa rnams brda bstan pa tsam gyis thugs su chud/ sdom gsum dang spyod 'jug sogs gzhung 'grel du ma sbyangs/ dgung lo lnga nas gter kha babs pa yin zhes bla ma dkonarab nas gsungs par grags/ khyad par nang thun min gyi rigs bdag /gong ma'i lung zin chos kyi bdag po phug khung sprul sku 'gyur med nges don dbang po mi lo bcu drug gi yun bsten nas/ rje mkhyen brtsedang 'jam mgon kong chen/ chosarje mi pham sogs nas brgyud pa'i gsang ba snying thig gi rgyud lung man ngag thams cad dang / gong ma bdud 'joms gling pa'i gter chos skor rnams rdzogs par gsan/ rje nyid kyi zhal nas/ rje drung byams pa'i 'byung gnas/ 'gyur med nges don dbang po gnyis nas rdzogs chen go brda 'phrod nges shes pyore zhus pa yin gsungs doltar skyabs mchogade gnyis las lam dang po sngon 'gro nas dngos gzhi'i bar gyi gdams khrid thams cad gsan/ shes rig rdo rje rnon po'i rgyud gsan pas rig rtsal chos rab rnam 'byed kyi shes rab klong brdol / rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde rgya mcho lta bu'i dka' gnad rnams rang grol du song / nged kyis gang shes pa rgyud 'di'i bka' drin yin nes yang yang gsungs/

sa thar 123de nas phug sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ gter marga 'di wom mgon rnam gnyis kyi phrin las yin/ ngas tshar lnga bton/ khyod kyis bcu 'don yong / rje gong ma'i zab chos rnams kyang maṇ+ḍal gyi tshul du nor bdag po'i lag tu 'phrod yod/ rtsaba'i bla ma'i b.lakha 'grub pa yin/ da ni nga'i bya ba rnams dzo+ogs pa yin/ sku mchog nas nyams bzhes dang / 'gro don gyis shig par gdams te/ rtogs pa don gyi rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol nas gsang sngags rnying ma'i bstanapa'i bdag por gyur/ de yang nyid kyi zhal nas kho bo chung ngu'i dus nas mthong snang mi 'dra ba sna tshogs dang /zab mo gter gyi las 'phro sad pa zhig yin/ zhes pa bzhin dgung grangs bcu gsum par 'od gsal gyi snang bar a rgyan chos kyi rgyal po yab yum dngos su mngal te mi min rang snang ston pa'i pha phog thob nas ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis shog ser phul ba sogs sa gter gyi bka' thog mar babs/ de nas bzung dag pa'i snang ba rab 'byams dang / rang gter rnams gar yod thogs med du gzigs / yang rtogs ldan bstan pa rab rgyas mdun nas/ smyo shul lung rtogs bstan pa'i nyi ma nas brgyud pa'i rdzogs chen snying thig ya bzhi'i dbang lung sogs mnangag myong khrid chen mo'i rgyun gsan/ de nas rim par yul dbus su byon/khamalori po che'i rje drung phrin las byams pa'i 'byung gnas sam bdud 'joms nam ma' rdo rje'i mdun nas/ rgyal btso rin po 〉 bklag lung phal so dang /
