124 sas gdams ngag mdzod/ gsang chen nges pa'i rgyud bcu bdun/ snying thig ya bzhi sogs 'od gsal dzo+ogs pa chen po'i chos rnams rdzogs par gsan pas/ nang thugs kyi sras gcig tu mdzad/ zil gnon lkom mkha'i rdo rje'i mdun/ kong sprul gro lod gsang sgrub kyi dbang dus su bla mas spyan cer gyis bdag la gzigs te/phaṭaḥ drag po zhig gnang rkyen gyis lus sems thams cad rjes med du khrolpogyis zhig nas dal cig gnas tshe/ 'o dbang don gyi ye shes de yin pas de nyid rab tu brtan par tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes gsungs pas nam du yang 'ju dran gyi ngal ba ma dgos par yang khrol le byung ba don brgyud kyi dgongs pa yin gsungs/ mdo khams rgya skor sprul pa'i sku kun bzang theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshanalas snga 'gyur rgyud 'bum sogs zab chos du ma gsan/ byang sems blo gros rgyal mtshan dang / dung dkar nges don rgya marlo gnyis kyi mdun nas rgyal bka' rin po che'i bklag lung yongs rdzogs re gsan/ sngags btsun dge 'dun rgya marlo las/ gter chen pad gling chos skor dang / kun mkhyen mdzod bdun sogs gsan/ smin gling rdor 'dzin rnam grol rgya marlo las/ bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sgrub dbang chen mo/chos dbang phur pa spu gri/ thugs chen yang 'dus sogs gzhung pod mang po dang /rnying rgyud phal mo che/ dbu ma'i lugs kyi byang chub sems sngom sogs gdams pa'i bdud rtsimang po dang / gsang chen mchog gi myur lam gyi steng nas yon smo

nasathar 125bdud rtsirgyud lung man ngag lag len dang bcas pa zhib rgyas dang / rig lon gter bdag gling pa'i phyag bzhes gsang chen rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i gar thig /dbyangs rol sogs smin gling gi phyag bzhes rnams gsan/ chos rje mi pham zhal slorgakhams nyan rong mkhan chen 'jam dpal bde ba'i nyi mngam phan bde'i 'odazer smin gling du bzhugs pa'i mdun nas/ snga 'gyur b.lakha ma dang / ba/'bargyad sgrub dbang chen mo/ sangs gling bla ma dgongs 'dus/ dpal gsang posnyingapo zur lugs kyi bzhad pa/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i 'grel chen sogs rgyud 'grel mang po dang / snying thig ya bzhi sogs 'od gsal gsang ba snying thigagiskor zab rgyas kyi chos tshul rgya mamo lta bu gsan pas/ khong bgazha drin che ba'i blam gnyis pa yin gsungs/ so byang sngags gsum gyi brgyud pa phal chera'adi nas bgrangs par mdzad/ gnas dus ci rigs par bī ma'i rnam rol smyo shul mkhan chen ngag dbang dpal bzang gi zhal slob bya bral sangs rgyas rdo rje/ bla ma.argyan rig 'dzin/ kaḥthog phyag tsha sprul sku/ mchog sprul 'gyur med rdo rje dang/ phu lung sangs rgyas sprul sku sogs skyes mchog khyad par canadu ma las zabachos mtha' yas pa gsan res mdzad/ gzhan yang a rgyan chos 'byor rgya marlo/ 'jam dpal tshul khrims grags pa/ pad+ma dbang gi rgyal po/ ngag dbang 'jigs med blo gros/ ngag dbang dpal ldan bzang po sogs bshes gnyen mang dubastenate

126 sa tharamado sngags kyi gzhung phran tshegs re gsan/ de dag kyang sgrub pa snying por gzhol bas nyams bzhes mdzad pa las yi dam lhag pa'i lha rab 'byams kyis zhal gzigs / khyad par sbas yul mkhan ljongs phun tshogs dga' tshal bsnyi gnas su / dpal rdo rje phur ye dngos grub brnyes/ phur pa thal 'byen bzhi'i dgongs pa bdud 'joms bsgom lcags spugri lam rim yongs dzo+ogs gto 'bebs mdzad/kyā tshe phug tu rdo rje tshe yi sgrub pa mdzad par tshe chang bdud rtsir khol ba sogs grub pa'i mtshan ma brles shing / bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag med pa'i zhal gzigs/bdud 'dul gro lod bsgrubs pas/ bdud 'joms rdo rje gro lod kyi dgongs pa'i gter kha babs/ mon spa gro stag tshang du rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub par bzhugs pas/nam mkha' 'ja' zer snatshogs pa 'bo+oba'i klong nas shog ser zheng kha sor bzhi srid du khru gang long ba'i mkha' 'gro'i brda risadapal rdo rje phur pa spu gri reg phung gi chos b.laphya yongs rdzogs babs/ gzhan yang thugs gter mcho skyes thugs thig dang mkha' 'gro thugs thig sogs yi dam rtsab gsum dang / bla rdzogs thugs gsum sogs kyi gter kha chen po babs par rtsasgrub tsam re phab nas/ gtso bor gter rming skyong ba las/ gter gsar gyi rtsol ba ma gnang / sa gter smu ru'i sgrub skor rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum sogs kong smad rgya la sum mdo dang / bsam yas mchims phu/ mon spa gro stag tshang sogs na bzhugs pa gnas dus kyis phyag

rnamathar 127son ma gyur/ mdor na yi dam rtsab gsum gtso bor byas pa'i lhag pa'i lha rab 'byams la gnas chen gangs brag rnams su lo zla zhag sogs sgrub pa mdzad pas/lha tshogs grub pa'i mtshanam brnyes te mchog thun dngos grub gnyis la dbang 'byor/gzhan don phrin las kyi rnam gzhag kyang / bla ma'i lung bstan bzhin/ rin chen gter mdzod dbang lung lan bcu/ pad gling chos skor lan gsum/ rje gong ma'i gter chos grangs mang / rgyal bka' rin po che dang / snga 'gyur rgyud 'bum bklag lung / bga' brgyad sgrub dbang chen mo/ kar gling zhi khro'i rgyab chos / 'ja' tshon pod drug /snga 'gyur bka' ma rin po che'i dbang lung yongs rdzogs sogs zab rgyas kyi 'khor lo mtha' yas pa bskor/ gsung gi phrin las kyang / mkhas pa mgu ba'i sdeb sbyor/ nyams myong gnad kyi man ngag dag gtsang 'dus gsal gyi rnam pa ༅/ rig 'dzin gter bdag gling pa'i gsung dang rnam dbyer med pa/ dgongs gter dang bstan bcos sna tshogs bka' 'bum pod nyi shu rtsalnga skor dang / snga 'gyurabaka' ma rin po che'i rgyab chos gsar bsgrigs dang bcas pod lnga bcu nga brgyad bcas bstan pa'i btsas su bskrun/ bya ba las kyi 'khor lo yang sbas yul pad+ma bkod du/ dge 'dun gyi sde rab sngags gnyis dang /gtsug lag khang sogs gsar du bzhengs nas phyogs der rgyal bstan dar rgyas su mdzad / dus 'gyur phyi mtha' gzigs pas gsung rten pod brgya phrag mang po rgya

128 rnapa thar gar 'phags yul du spyan drangs nas/ snga 'gyur bsha' ma rin po che deng sang dpe rgyun dang dbang rgyun gnyis /zhi srog mthud du byung ba 'di gcig pu'i ba/'a drin yang gzhal las 'das/ kong yul mtha' 'dul bu chu'i lha khang nyams gso mdzad/de dang nye bar zangs mdog dpal ri'i gtsug lag khang rten dang brten pa bcas pa gsar bzhengs dang / sngags sde bla ma gling sgrub grwa gsar 'dzugs mdzad pa las mkhyen rtogs grub pa'i dbang phyug mang po ༷r+sha/ rgya gar du marlo pad+ma'i sgrub sde / rdor gling tshes btso dgon pa/ o ri sa bdud 'dul rab brtan gling sngags sde / ka spugs zangs mdog dpal ri dang sgom grwa/ a rir ye shes snying po dang a rgyan chos rdzong / pha ran si'i rdo rje snying po dang a rgyan bsam yas chos gling sogs zhal bkod kyi bdag rkyen gnang nas bstan rtsabaskrun/ de dag tu gtor bzo rgyan bkod nas bzung phyag bzhes 'phrin sgrub thams cad smin gling gis khog phub par mdzad/ rgya bod kyi yul du chos lngor re re'i skabs smin gling khri chen/mkhan gcung rnam gnyis/ rdo brag rig 'dzin chen mo/ stag lung rtsesprul/ bya bral sangs rgyas rdo rje/ zhwa de'u 'khrul zhig sprul sku/ rigs sras phrin las nor bu rin po che/ rdzong gsar mkhyen brtserin po che/ gter ston sto mkha' dri med rab 'byums/ ri sprul rig 'dzin chos rgyal/ sngags ston tshe dbang dpal 'byor/bla ma pad+ma klong grol/ pad gling gsung sprul/ thugs sras sprul sku/ reb kong bla

/5thar 129ma shes rab rdo rje/ g.yag sde sngags ston mkhas btsun bzang po/ ri che sngags ston tshe dbang lha rgyal dang / sngags ston rdo rje rnam rgyal/ sngags ston dkon mchog 'byung gnas/ 'grug gi sngags ston kun bzang dbang 'dus/ 'brug bla ma dkar po dang bla ma nag po pad+ma dbang chen/ bla ma gser spang / bla ma snying khu/bla ma 'jam dbyangs/ bla ma 'chi med/ bla ma byang chub/ bla ma grags lngan sogs zhal slob mang du bskrun/ gzhan yang dad 'dus brgya stong khri phrag las brgal ba nub phyogs a ri'i yul tshun chad 'dzam gling yangs pa'i khyon 'dir 'gro don dang phrin las thams cad nam mkha'i pha mthar brdal zhing bsnan 'gro yongs kyi dpal mgon du dgung grangs brgyad cu rtsabazhir bzhugs/ mthar nub phyogs pha ran si dpa' bo ṭ+wāṃ ki 'dus pa'i bsnyi gnas su gzugs sku bkod pa bsdus zhing /sku gdung rin po che da ltar yang bal yul du bla ma mkhas btsun bzang pos legs par bskrun pa'i gtsug lag khang tsar+sha rgyan mdo sngags chos 'khor gling du mi dang mi min 'gro ba mtha' yas pa'i mthong thos dran reg gi rten bzang por bzhugs so/ /rgyal bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i sos bzang rtser/ /'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i tog mdzes pa/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan mtho/ /maḥdza skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig/ //

130 rnam thar 7/ 7smin gling khri rabs bcu gcig pa 'gyur med kun bzang dbang rgyal ni/yab rje 7khri rabs bcu pa 'gyur med don 'grub dbang rgyal dang yum rgyal ba'i yab gzhis dwags po grong pa'i lcam zla ba sgrol ma gnyis kyi rigs sras su ngo mtshar ba'i rtags snang mtha' klas pa dang bcas rab rgyal 1930 lcags lug zla ba 1tshes 1sko dge bar sku bltams/ chung ngu nas sngon gyi bag chags bzang pos dam pa'i rigs sad pa'i mthus 'bri klog sogs tshegs med par mkhyen cing /rdor 'dzin bde chen chos 'dzin sogs gdan sa'i rdor slob rnams kyi mdun nas rang lugs kyi chog phrin dgrangs rolagar thig sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes phra mo tshun chad legs par khong du chub par mdzad/ yab rje dang rang rigs khu dbon sogs khams kyi bla chen mang po'i mdun nas chos bka' mang du gsan/ khu bo mkhan gcung rnam gnyis drung nas bka' gter gsar rnying gi dbang khrid dang /mdo sngags kyi gzhung rnams gsan/ zhe chen rab 'byams snang mdzad grub pa'i rdo rje'i zhal snga nas rin chen sater mdzod chen mo dang / mkhyen brtserdo rje 'chang chos kyi blo gros las snying thig ya bzhi/ zhe chen kong sprul rin po che las zhe chen rgyal tshab pa'i bka' 'bum dang zab khrid mang po/ go 'jo mkhar legs sprul sku'i mdun nas 'jam mgon mi pham rin po che'i bka' 'bum sogs gsan/ gzhan yang rtsargyud gsang ba snying po'i rtsa'agrel sogs dang / smin gling sgos kyi gter

sathar 131kha'i skor a ti'i zab don snying po sogs la gsan bsam nyams bzhes mdzad/sgrub sde theg mchog chos gling du 'angam dpal gzhin rje gshed/ bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa/ gu ru zhi drag sogs lhag pa'i lha rab 'byums kyi bsgen mtshams lo bdun ring bzhugs nas snang grags lha sngags dbyer med du rgyas gdab par mdzad/ spyan ras gzigs dmar po/ thub dbang bdud 'dul ma'i man ngag bdud bzhi g.yul zlog sogs zab gter ci rigs pa'i bka' babs/ bod ljongs kla klo'i sto 'tshe skabs sngon gyi thugs bskyed dang smon lam gyi mthum rgya 'dre'i dpung gis brdzibar ma nus par 'go ba'i mos srung rnams kyis bya rog dang skyung sha'i gzugs su bstan nas lam ston zhus pa bzhin nye zho med par lho 'brug brgyud 'phags yul du phyag phebs/ rgya 'grug sa mtshams su chibs bsgyur skabs 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog gis rgyal ba gong ma rnams kyi chos dam gyi 'brel bar brten 'tshams 'dri'i mi sna ched gtong bskyangs/ 'phags yul ka spungs zangs mdog dpal rir 7skyabs rje bdud 'joms rin po che dang 7skyabs rje dil mgo ma.i brtserin po che rnam gnyis kyis dbus snga 'gyur spyi nga/nga bye brag gis gsol ba btab pa dang 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po'i bsha' lung bzhin sngon byon yar+pāmes khri chen gong ma dag gi mdzad sgo bzhin khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po khri chen gyi gser khrir mnga' 'bul rgyas pa zhus te gsang sngags snga 'gyur rnying ma'i bstan

132 na5tharapa'i bdag por mnga' gsol gzengs bstod mdzad/ 7skyabs rje na5 gnyis kyis kyang thugs khur gzigs pa rgya chen pos rnying ma bka' ma dang rgya chen bga' mdzod kyis gtsos chos b.lakha du ma mchod sprin du phul te lhan rgyas ka spungs zangs mdog dpal rir yun ring bzhugs/ skabs de dag tu 7skyabs rje bdud 'joms rin po che dang lhan cig sku ngal 'dzems med kyis bod bstan srid la sman pa'i zhabs rim sna tshogos thugs dam 'od gsal las shar ba bzhin mdzad kyang /bod ljongs spyi mthun gyi bsod nams dman pa dang / dam sri mi gzugs nyul ba bod kyi mtho rim bla dpon khag gcig log pa'i bsam sbyor dang / rgyab brten 'byung po'i cho 'phrul bcas kyis bar chad mang du brtsams pa ni/ ji skad du/ gu ru nyid dang khyed kyi bstan pa dang / /khyed kyi rjes 'jug rnams la than du blta/ /bka' drin khyad gsod log ltas 'bar sha ldir/ /dkon mchog rgyab bor blo gtad 'dre la bcol/ /ma rungs 'gong por rgyab brten blo gtad 'cha'/ khye nang dbyen sbyor phung 'khrugs byur sna 'dren/ /dman sa bzung yang phyogs lhung phrag dog ldang / /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar yi ger mang du bkod 'dod kyang re zhig spros pa bskyungs la/ zhal nas snyan du brgyud pa'i lo sgyus rjen pa rnams ni/snga 'gyur rnying ma ba'i gdan sa rnams dang / ri khrod kyi rnal 'byor/ grong gseb kyi sngags 'chang sogs la rlung ltar grags pa yin no/ /des na snga 'gyur gyi

sa thar 133mkhas grub zam ma chad par byon pa rnams ni thob dang go sa la re ba tsam yang med par / gangs ljongs lha mi'i bde thabs kho nar dgongs te las bzhi'i phrin sgrub dang / tha na gsol 'debs smon lam tshigs bcad rer yang bod khams spyi don du byang chub sems kyi brlan dang ma bral bar rtsagasum lha tshogs dpang du gsol te mdzad cing / nyin gyi bya ra mtshan gyi mel tshe kho nar thugs gzhol ba ma gtogs/bla dpon gzhan ltar phyi rol tshul 'chos kyis seng lpags rgyu+on te rang phyogs la chags / gzhan phyogs la sngang / go ling phran tshegs la snyems dang re dwogs kyi tha gus bcings/ lto ware ba gang la ngo dga'i gtam 'chal bshad/ nam zhig phrag dog gi nad bu langs te dgon bsgyur zhwa bsgyur byed/ yul lung dmag gis bkang / che btsan dug gis bsad/ ngan byas ngo sor 'khyer/ byas pa drin du mi bzo/ phyi la kha gtad mi dpogs/ nang dkrugs ngan bskul la mkhas/chos lugs khog tu bcug nas srid don gyi go sa dang rlogs pa 'dra bzung /nyams chung dang las 'bras khyad du bsad nas kha shed dang dpung pa 'gro sa e 'dug blta ba rnams dang nam yang mi 'dra bar gu yangs blo bde phyi nang rgyab mdun mtshungs shing gtam snyan po'i ngang nas mi tshe 'khyol 'gro ba de lha a rgyan pad+ma'i rjes 'jug gi khyad chos bla na med cing ngoms su chog pa zhig yin par chos 'byung rnam thar dang /rgyal rabs rnams las gsal ba bzhin 'dzam gling rgyal khams kun la da gzod snyan

134 sa saseng gsal 'debs zhar 'phros su thal lo/ de nas shing stag 1974 lor dpal sprul rdzong nang rin po che 'jam dpal blo gros dang / mkho khyim rin po che 'gyur med mdo rgyud rgya mtsho rnam gnyis kyis gdan zhus bzhin/ 'di ga 'phags yul byang phyogs r+sāla'i nags go dhe rā junar+shasnyo mina.a rgyanasmin grol gling nges pa don gyi dgazha ba'i tshal du zhabs sor bkod nas/ gdan sa 'dir gasmo chags bzhugs bzhin 7mkho sprul rin po che dang thugs bskyed lhan 'dzoms kyis smin gling rang lugs kyi tshes bcu/ dgu gto+o/ bka' brgyad/ tshogs 'a 'dus pa/ sgyu 'phrul zhi khro/ dong sprugs sogs sngar srol bzhin gsar 'dzugs mdzad pa dang / 7gong sa lha ma'i rnam 'dren rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyenapa'i mdun ched bcar gyis skutsho'i brtanabazhugs lan 'ga' phul ba don dam gyi brtan bzhugs su byung zhes gsung gi dbugs dgrang stsal te thugs snang gtsig 'dres su gyur/ res zhag zla mang por smi mawo 'od gsal gyi khor yug tu gzims pa/ bka' bsgo mdzad pas gdon bgegs 'dul ba/ byin rlabs gnang bas bar chad zhi ba/ lkog gyur gyi gnas thogs med du mkhyen pa sogs grub pa'i mdzad spyod ngo mtshar to mang po mthun snang du mnga'/ gzhan yang rje nyid kyi zhal gsung / lo na ni rgas shing 'bogs pa la/ /spyod pa ni byis pa'i spyod pa mā / khu yi yang kha la mi nyan pa/ /smyon pa gcig kun bzang dbang rgyal mkhyen/ /

sathar 135zhes sku'i snag gawo rgya ri a ma nor 'dzin la bla ma rgyang 'bod kyi gsol 'debs su gnang ba 'dis ni/ chos brgyad re dwogs kyi sgrog las grol/ 'khrul pa dbyings su zhig /nang snyems byed kyi bdud bzhi rtsad nas chod pa'i gnyug ma don gyi thol glu 'dren mchog gang gi thun min gyi rnam thar du shar ba bcas/ de ltar mnyam rjes ris med 'od gsal khor yug gi ngang / mthong thos dran reg gi 'gro ba rnams pad+ma 'od du 'dren pa sogs 'brel tshad don ldan som nyi bral ba ste/rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru dang rnam dbyer ma mchis par da lta bdag cag rnams kyi mgon dang / skyabs dang / dpung gnyen dang / gsang chen rdo rje snying po'i bstan pa'i srog shing dam par zhabs zung g.yo med rdo rje'i khams su brtan bzhin bzhugs pa lags so/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe rab brtan cing / /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang dar ba yis/ /chos srid mi nub nor bu'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs/ /mtshoge skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig/ //

136 /pa tharatsha/ a rgyan smin grol gling gi mkhan rabs dang po rgyal sras bstan pa'i nyi ma ni/kun 'dzin zhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa sa po phyi ba spyi lo 1'ja8 lor grwa nang dar rgyas chos gling du/ yab rje sngags ston chen po gsang bdag phrin las lhun grub dang / yum ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma mi'i sha tshugs su byon pa lha 'odzin dbyangs can sgrol ma gnyis kyi sras su sku bltams/ mtshan rgyal sras bstan pa'i nyi ma zhes bya bar gsol/ yab rje gsang bdag chen po dang / rigs kyi gcen po gter chen 'gyur med rdo rje rnam gnyis gtsug gi rgyan du bsten/ gzhan yang mkhan dkon mchog bstan 'dzin/ gong sa lnga pa chen po sogs yongs 'dzin gyi skyes chen dam pa mang du bsten/ snga 'gyur bka' gter gyis gtsos mdo sngags kyi chos tshul rgya mcho lta bu la gsan bsam rgya cher mdzad/ mtshan nyid theg pa'i gzhung lugs rnams la mchog tu mkhas par gyur/ gcung lo chen thams can mkhyen pa dharma shrī sku na chung ba'i dus 'dul ba'i brda chad dang lag len gyi slob khrid bskyangs/ phyis su 'phyongs rgyas dpal ri'i 'dus sde 'grims shing gar thig dgrangs rol sogs shes bya che phra ma lus pa thugs su chud/ thun mong rig pa'i gnas la'ang shin tu mkhas par grags/ rang phyogs bstan 'dzin gyi skyes chen dam pa bzang la mang ba rim par byon pa rnams kyi khyu mchog lta bur gyur/gter gsar chos bdag tu lung gis zin shing chos skor de dag la nyams bzhes

sathar 137mdzad na ring por 'arlo bzhugs kyis snga 'gyur bstan pa'i mes por gyur pa gdon mi za yang / bsnyen sgrub dus su yol bar brten sku tshe mthar ma phyin par/ dgung lo nyer bdun pa shing stag spyi lo 1674 thog ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas snang bcas sgyu ma'i gzugs sku re zhig chos dbyings zag pa med pa'i ngang du bsdus pa'i tshul bstan to/ /rmad byung za hor mkhan po'i spyod pa dang / /mtshungs med dpal lngan klu yi lta ba gnyis/ khung 'brel brgyud pa'i bgazha srol phyag rgyas btab / mucho skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig/ //ca

138 rnam sa7/ mkhan rabs gnyis pa lo ༄na thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos dpal rgya mtsho ni/ nges pa'i don du dus gsum rgyal ba kun dang rnam dbyer med par bzhugs kyang / mdo sde phal po che las/ byang chub rgya mamo rab brnyes gyur nas ni / khems ༅ rgya marlo rab tu smin bya'i phyir/ /byang chub sems bskyed rgya mcho ston mdzad cing / /mi 'grib spyod pa rgya mcho kun tu ston/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi sa sprul de 'dra'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar re zhig tshur mthong so skye'i snang ngor gsum lngan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i tshul gyis rnam par rol pa du mas gdul bya 'dul ba'i phrin las kyi cha shas sa bon tsam zhig 'god pa la/ sngon gyi dus su sprul pa'i slob dpon chen po'i dngos slob rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsalnga zhes yongs su grags pa'i ya gyala'od gsal rdzogasapa chen po'i sde gsum klong dga'i rgyud don mtha' dag thugs su chud cing / snang bzhi zad sar 'khyol ba'i mkhas grub kyi skyes bu lo tsā ba g.yu sgra snying po nyid/ snga 'gyur bka' gter bstan pa'i chu bo slar yang spel ba'i phyir bsam bzhin srid pa nye bar bzung ba ste/ gter lung las/ g.yu sgra'i rnam sprul blo ldan/ dhame'i ming: byang sems dad brtson snying stobs ldan pa 'byung:zhes dang / rdor sems thugs kyi sgrub pa'i lung byang las/ rgyal mo g.yu sgra'isprul pa ni: me khams shrī las kyi ming: zhes rdo rje lung gis bsngags pa ltar/gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi yang srid yab rje gsang bdag chen po khrin las

rnam thar 139lhun grub dang / yum shel dkar rdo rje mtsho'i sprul par grags pa rje rigs lha 'dzin dbyangs can sgrol ma la sras lcam sring bdun gyi lnga tshigs su rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing pho rta'i lor yor po grwa nang dar rgyas mos gling du ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas yum la gnod pa med par mtshan dbe'i dkyil 'khor gsar du bzhad/mtshan rig byed kyi gzhung las bsgres te legs pa don grub tu gsol/ yab rje gsang ba'i bdag pos bka' dgongs phur gsum dang pad gling gi gter chos phal mo ce sogs dbang bsha' mang du stsal/ dgung grangs dgu laphebs pa na yab rje gsang bdag chen po dag zhing du gshegs/ gdung mchod snye tshe sku gdung rin po che'i drung byon te gsol ba drug tu btab pa'i nub gcig gi gzim lam du yab rje bar snang la gshegs pa'i sku'i 'thu ba la 'jus/ rang yang bar snang la had kyis btegs pa dang lhan cig gnyid sad pa byung zhes gsungs/ rig 'dzin chenapo dgongs pa gzhan du gshegs rjes sku'i gtsen po rig 'dzin gter bdag gling pas thugs brtseb chen pos spyan ras kyis btsa' bas rjes su bzung ste legs par bskyangs / gzhan yang gcen rgyal ba'i sras po bstan pa'i nyi ma dang / bskyed yum lha 'dzin dbyangs can sgrol ma rnam gnyis nas kyang sku na gzhon nu'i dus nas chos sgor 'dren pa'i thabs la gzhol bar mdzad/ dgung lo bcu gsum par rje gto 'a bla ma'i drung du gtsugaphud phul te skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i dge bsgen gyi

140 sa sasdom pa nod/ mtshan bstan 'dzin 'jam dgrangs dbang por gsol/ dgung grangs bco lnga par thams cad mkhyen pa lnga pa chen po las rab tu byung ste mtshan ngag dbang chos dpal rgya mtsho zhes stsal zhing dge tshul gyi sdom pa phog /slar dgung grangs nyi shu par pho brang chen po sa ta lar rgyal ba'i dbang po nyid las bsgen par rdzogs / phyis gong ma'i lung gis bskul ba ltar dgung grangs nyer bdun pa lcags sprel nag zla'i tshes bcu gsum gyi nyi ma brgyad cha lus pa grib tshod skyes bu gcig dang rkang pa gnyis kyi dus su dbu ru gru 'dzin gyi pho brang chen por/ kha rag mkhan chen dkon mchogarbastan 'dzin zhal snga nas kyi dang / dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su tshigs gsum bar ma chad pa'i cho ga phun sum tsho+ogs pas bsgen par rdzogs/ dus kun tu bcas rang gi nyes ltung phra mos kyang ma gos pa 'dul 'dzin rgyu skar bcal du bkram pa'i dbus su nyi zla ltar gsal bar gyur/chu yos nag zla'i nang du rje gter chen bla ma las/ byang sdom bka' srol gsum gyi thugs bskyed dang / dgung lo bcu gnyis pa shing sbrul zla ba bdun pa'i tshes nyer lnga la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du rig 'dzin thugs thig gi dbang gsan/de'i tshe bum nang du me tog byung ba myu gu sngong po snye ma'i bar du smin pa dang / me tog gi char babs shing snyan pa'i sgra ldir ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i mngon rtags bzang po mang du byung / de nub rje nyid kyi gzim lam du'ang na bza' dkar po mnabs te

sa thar 141bu mo rgyan ༅ mang po dang 'grogs nas ri bo chen po'i ngos la 'dzogs shing nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar bar rmis pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas dbang gi brda don ma lus pa 'phrod cing yongs su smin pa dang / sdom pa gsum gyis thugs rgyud yongs su gtams par bzhugs/ rim par yi ge 'bri klog dang chog khrigs rnams la'ang byang chub par mdzad/ dasmung grangs bcu drug par gung thang paṇa chen bshes gnyen rnam rgyal las sgra ka lā pa dang sdeb sbyor gyi bshad pa/ lañca dang wardu la sogs yig rigs rnams dang lha bris sum rtags kyi bshad pa sogs brda sprod yan lag dang bcas pa/ dasmung grangs bcu dgu par mes po zlum po jode grub dbang rgyal gyi drung nas dgu mtha'i bsgyur bgos nas brtsams zhal lung ma bu'i gnad rnams la snang mun khor yug tu 'bad pa mdzad pas skar rtsis la thugs legs par 'byu+ongs/ gzhan yang dgrangs 'char gyi bshad pa dang 'khor lo'i ngo sprod / 'byung rtsis lda'u 'grim lugs rnams thugs su chud par mdzad/ gcen rgyal sras rin po che nas kyang rtsis kyi go ba'i phra gcod dang / rgya ston kame kun mkhyen las dus 'khor gyi rtsis dang sdeb sbyor rnams gsan/ phyis stag lung grub chen ngag dbang gzungs mchog las sa ra swasnyi'i ri mo dang / tsan dra pa'i yi ge bsdu ba dang ting mtha' sogs kyi bshad pa gsan/ rje gter chen bla ma las snyan ngag me long gi bshad pa gsan cing le'u gsum ka'i rtsom rgyugs phul/

142 sathar gzhan yang snga 'gyur rang lugs kyi gar thigadagrangs gsum rnams kyang dbyes phyin par sbyangs/ dus skabs ci rigs par spos khang pa rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i sher phyin gyi 'grelporkang dang don bdun cu'i bshad pa/ sa paṇa gyi sdom gsum rab dbye rnams gsan/ bstan rgyal sras bsnyan pa'i nyi ma las 'dul ba'i lag len dang brda chad la mkhas par sbyangs/ dgung grangs nyer bdun par sems nyid ngal gso/ 'dul ba'i spyi don lung rigs gter mdzod sogs gnung phal cher bzung ba tsam gyis dgongs don thogs med du shar/ khyad par bka' drin 'gran zla dang bral ba rje bla ma dam pa gter chen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs pad rtag tu spyi bor bsgen te kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer/ zur pa yab sras/rong zom chen po la sogs pa'i gsung rab rnams dang / snga 'gyur bka' ma mdo sgyu sems gsum sogs rgyud sde'i skor gyi dbang bga' bshad lung man ngag gi rgyun bzhugs so cag dang / sgrub sde spyi dang bye brag rnams dang / gter ma'i skor la rje nyid kyi gter gsar yongs rdzogs/ gzhan yang grub thob dngos grub/gnas brtan ldang ma lhun rgyal/ lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug /rgya zhang khrom/lha rje gnubs chung / mnga' bdag nyang ral pa can/ si ru chos dbang / pad+ma las 'brel rtsal/ gling pa bcu gnyis/ dri med rnamagasum sogs grags che ba'i gter ston mtha' yas pa zhig gi gter chos bla rdzogs thugs gsum/

sa sa 143ba/'a brgyad spyi sgos kyi skor sogs sgrub sde/ kun mkhyen lnga pa chen po'i gsung dag snang gsang ba rgya can gyis mtshon rgyud lung man ngag bga' gter dag snang gi rgyun ji sged pa dang / thams to kyi rtsabar gyur pa rnying ma rgyud 'bum gyi lung yongs rdzogs/ gsar ma'i phyogs kyang dgyes rdor kun rig mi 'khrugs pa sogs kyi dbang lung man ngag ma tshang ba med pa bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan/gzhan yang rdo rje brag rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma phrin las las/ dus 'bor yongs rdzogs kyi dbang dang / sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i dbang / bla ma gsang 'dus kyi rtsadabang sogs chos tshul mtha' yas pa gsan/ sa skya bdag chen kun dga' bkra shis las/ yang dag 'khon lugs kyi dbang dang / sdom gsum dang rigs gter gyi lung sogs gsan/ gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba rigs sras pad+ma 'gyur med rgya mcho las mnyam sbyor rigs bsdus kyi dbang dang / byang chub lam rim gyi khrid/ ding ri kun spangs pa blo gros brtan pa las zhi byed snga phyi bar gsum kha 'thor dang bcas pa'i dbang lung khrid gsum yongs rdzogs/ mkhas grub chos skyong rgyal mtshan las shangs lugs kyi dbang lung man ngag yongs rdzogs dang ma/ chen rin bzang las brgyud pa'i dus 'khor gyi dbang dang sbyor drug gi khrid sogs gsan/ grub pa'i dbang phyug blo gros rgya marlo las kyang / dus 'khor gyi dbang dang sbyor drug gi smin khrid/ jo lugs waṃgs byed kyi dbang rjes gnang

144 sathar bcas mtha' yas pa gsan/ rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' bstan dar las gsang bde 'jigs gsum/ rngog lugs kyi rdo rje sadan bzhi/ ma hā ma yā rnams dang /dmar po skor gsum dang gur zhal gyi rjes gnang rnams gsan/ bshes gnyen byams pa phun tshogs rnam rgyal las/ spyan ras gzigs seng ge sgra/ 'gro bzang lugs rnam sras dkar po tsho 'dzin/ spyan ras gzigs dpal mo'i lugs / gur zhal rnams kyi rjes gnang gsan/ sdom brtson kun dga' dar rgyas las 'dul ba me tog phreng rgyud/ sum brgya pa rtsa'agrel/ dbu ma rigs tshogs skor/ sdom pa nyi shu pa/ bla ma lnga bcu pa/ khro bo'i chos 'byung brgya rtsarnams kyi lung phal mo che dang / lung rigs smra ba'i dbang phyug sangs rgyas chos dar las/ dbu ma rtsa'ajug bzhi gsum/ rnam 'grel/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa/mngon pa mdzod/ 'grel chung don gsal/ sa paṇa gyi thub pa dgongs gsal/lung rigs gter mdzod rnams dang / skyi kun dga' bstan gsal las sgyu 'phrul phra mo'i skor mang po dang / zur cho stod lugs pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyi yig cha phran tshegs kyi lung / zhwa lu pa rin chen bzang po las dri med rnam gnyis kyi dbang lung / bka' 'gyur ba grub pa rdo rje las 'dul ba lung / mdo sde bskal ba bzang po/ brgyad stong pa/ nges don gyi mdo phran sogs dang / byams chos sde lnga/ spyod 'jug sogs mdo chos kyi lung mang po dang / 'bri gung sprul pa'i

sa thar 145sku las sgra mi snyan pa'i tshe dbang / tre bo sprul pa'i sku chos kyi dbang po las phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid dang / dbang phyug rdo rjes mdzad pa'i khrid yig /be har gyi sgrub thabs sprin nag 'khrigs pa'i lung rnams gsan/ dpa' bo sprul pa'i sku las phyag chen yi ge bzhi pa'i don tshigs bcad ma'i lung rnams zhus shing /'di dag gi tshul rgyas pa gsan yig rin po che logs su bzhugs par grags pa las mkhyen par 'tshal lo/ /mdor na gsar rnying ris med kyi yongs 'dzin bcu phrag gnyis las so so'i bka' srol tha dad pa'i mdo rgyud lung gi chos tshul rgya mtsho tshelta bu la ngoms pa med par gsan bsam mdzad pa'i tshul smos kyis mi lang ngo / /khyad par rtogs pa'i bstan pa sgrub pas 'dzin cing rim gnyis kyi ting lo4na zab mo la thugs ji ltar gzhol ba'i tshul ni/ de kho na nyid nges par bstan pa'i mdo las/shā ri'i bu gang gis bskal pa gcig tu nyan pa bas/ gang gis se gol gtogs pa'i yun tsam zhig de kho na nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin la nyams par bzhag pas bsod chums mang du 'phel lo/ /zhes dang / mdo sde rgyan las/ de ltar rnal 'byor can gyi sgom pa gang yin de ni don med min/ /de ltar bde bar gshegs pas bstan pa gang yin de yang don med min/ /gal te thos pa tsam gyis don mthong 'gyur na sgom pa don med 'gyur/ /gal te ma thos par yang sgom la 'jug na bstan pa don med 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sku na phra mo'i dus kho na nas

146 sathar sgom chenarganapo'i rnalathar gyi ngang tshul las mi 'da' zhing gang zan rang rgyud pa ltar lam rim bgrod kyi 'bad rtsol la ltos dgos pa med mod/ 'on kyang tshur mthong gdul bya'adul ba'i thabs kyi rnamabalam du 'khyer chug 'gyod pa med patshulakhrims dang / zhi bar gnas pa ting nge 'dzin/ chos rab tu sa par 'byed pa shes rab kyi phung po rnams kyis thugs rgyud phyur bur gtams pa la gnas pa dang / thabs bskyed pa'i rimopa rgyud gzhung gi dgongs pa ltar bskyed chog ma 'dres par tshang zhing /rang 'bras kyi khyad pargyuri sngags kyi mthu nus bskyed pa dang / ngo bo zhu bde'i bde stong gi rang bzhin/ byed las dag rdzogs smin gsum tshang ba ste khyad par bzhi ldan bskyed rim gyi gnad la bsten sgrub yan lag bzhi yis gzhung bsrangs zhing thugs nyams su bstar bas sgo gsum rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du ye nas mnyam par rdzogs pa'i don la dbang 'byor/ thun mtshams rgyun gyi rnal 'gru+or dang 'brel rtsab gsum gyi lhag pa'i lha rab 'byams kyi ljags bsnyen grangs dus mtshan ma'i tshul rnams kha skong dang bcas pa rgya cher thems/ dgung grangs nyer bdun pa lcags sprel lor rje bla ma dam pa las rig 'dzin thugs thigagi bsha' khrid gsan/chos skyong rgyal mtshan las bu chos drug gi khrid dang phyag rgya chen po ga'u ma'i khrid gsan cing 'bad pa chen pos bcad rgya mdzad pas zhi gnas kyi nyams 'khrungs/khyad par dgung grangs zhe gcig pa shing khyi'i lor mkha' spyod bde chen gling du sku

sa thar 147mtshams zla ba lnga tsam du bcad de/ bde gshegs kun 'dus phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bsgen sgrub smin par mdzad/ slar rje gasto chen bla ma'i drung nas thugs rje chen po bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi khrid ma bu yongs rdzogs gsan cing / rtsakhrid la snying rus bskyed nas bsgoms pas rdzogs rim rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i byed bcings kyis rtsarlung thig le dbumar dwangs pa'i lag rjes stong gags kyi rnam pa bde stong gi rol mor nyin mtshan khor yug tu 'char/ mi g.yo gsum lngan gyi thabs la brtenanos rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs rang rig dang dbyer med rtogs pa'i nyams myong gi sim pa thob/ phyis su'ang rje bla ma dam pa las snying thig rnam gnyis dang / kun bzang dgongs 'dus/ a ti zab don snying po/rdor sems kyi khrid yig ma bu/ klong sde rdo rje zam pa/ 'dus pa mdo dang sgyu 'phrul / dong sprugs kyi gzhung / khros nag /gcod khrid sogs bka' gter gyi zab khrid mang po gsan cing re re nas thugs la gzhol bas nyams snang gi 'bog thon / zab lam gyi tshul thams cad nyams 'og tu chud cing mtshan med dzo+ogs rim gyi gnad mthar thug pa rang rig ka dag gi gshis lugs 'gyur med spros bral dang / rtsal snang gi chos kun ris med sgyu ma lta bu'i rol par ma 'gags pa'i don la snang rig ngos bzung dang bral ba'i nges shes brtan po 'khrungs/ gzhan yang yos lo'i nang sku tshe la bar chad kyi mtshan ma phran bu shar ba yang rdor bzlas

148 rnamathar 'bum phrag gsum gyi sor chud/ mdor na mnyam gzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rang bzhin babs kyis bsam gtan gyi ngang la gnas shing / de ltar ma rtogs pa la dmigs med kyi snying rje chen po'i rtsal snang lha skur shar ba dang /skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo tho dabla ma dam pa la mnyes pa gsum gyis bka' lung las nam du'ang mi 'gongs pa'i thugs dam mdzad/ rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' dang bshes gnyen kunal dag snang yangs por sbyong ba las phyogs ris chags sdang mi mdzad pa sogs mdor na ri mtshams sdug rgur gyis byas yus tsam la ma ltos par sgrub brgyud gong ma'i mdzad pa shugs 'byung gis bskyangs/ bla med rdo rje theg pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi lam la brten nas yon tan dang drod rtags brnyes pa'i tshul sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba zab mo dag ni byis pa'i spyod yulalas 'das pa'i phyir yongs su rdzogs pa nam du yang 'chad par nus pa ma yin la cha tsam re ni mkhan po nyid kyis mdzad pa'i lo rgyus bden gtam rna ba'i bdud rdzisogs las shes par 'gyur ro/ /khyad par bstan 'gro'i don du bzang po'i phri na las kyi phyag rjes ji ltar bskyangs pa'i tshul ni/ mdo las/ dge slong dag gang zag gnyis po 'dis bsod nams mang po bskyed de/ sdig pa'i rtsab 'byen cing bdud dang g.yul 'gyeng par byed/ bdud kyi rgyal mtshan snyil bar byed/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan sgreng bar byed/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo skor bar byed do/ /

sa sa 149gnyis gang zhe na/ gang gus par byas te chos 'chad pa dang / gang 'di na smus par byas te chos nyan pa'o/ /de bas na khyod kyis gus pas chos bshad par bya zhing bla ma rnams la gus par byas te chos mnyan par bya'o/ /zhes dang / byams pa seng ge'i sgra'i mdo las/ gaṅgā'i bye sged waṃg rten gser dag gis/ /bkang sde gang la sbyin pa byin pa bas/ /dus ngan tshe na tshigs bcad gcig 'chad pa/ /de yi bsod nams ci 'dra snga mar med/ /ces sogs rgya cher gsungs pa ltar/rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa rgya mcho lta bur dbang 'byor ba'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyi thugs la brnags pa ston pa mnyam che/da zas gtsang sras po'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che spyi dang / khyad par gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bka' gter gyi ring lugs rnams dpag bsam ljon pa'i dga' tshal ltar thar 'dod skye rgu kun gyi phan bde'i dpal yon dam par gzigs nas/ lhag bsam gyi snying stobs phrag par bzhes shing zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshul la/ dgung grangs zhe brgyad nas drug cu rtsabazhi'i bar dbyar dgun gnyis su skal ba mchog dang ldan pa'i blo gsal rig pa 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun drug cu skor wartsargyud gsang ba snying po'i chos 'khor gtsobo ra mdzad de/ sdom gsum rnam nges/ phar phyin/ 'dul ba sogs thun min gyi bshad khrid mang du bskyangs/ snga phyir sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i dbang chen tshar brgyad/ mdo dbang chen mo tshar gsum/ dong sprugs tshar lnga/

150 rnam tharagazhan yang 'dus pa mdo dang / sgyu 'phrul drwa ba/ bgazha brgyad bder 'dus dang gsang rdzogs/ rdo rje gling pa/ rat+na gling pa/ pad+ma gling pa sogs kyi bka' gter dbang lung dang / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo/ shangs lugs rgyud sde lnga sogs kyi dbang dang rjes gnang zab khrid lung dang bcas pa mang du stsal/ mdor na gzhung khrid gang gsan pa thams cad lan grangs gsum bzhi re ma 'chad pa med pa lta bu dang / khyad par dpal ljan sa skya pa bdag chen ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis la gter gsar gyi dbang lung yongs rdzogs dang / thugs rje chen po'i smin khrid / phur pa yang gsang spu gri'i dbang sogs chos bka' shin tu mang po gnang /dgung grangs nga dgu pa chu 'brug lor bstan pa shar phyogs su dar ba'i lung bstan mngon du gyur nas mdo khams chab mdor spyan drangs pa bzhin byon te/ 'phags pa lha rgyal ba rgya mtsho / zhi ba bzang po/ ngag dbang mchog gi sprul sku bcas la gter gsar yongs rdzosas dang / bla ma gsang 'dus/ nyang gter drag dmar/phur pa spu gri/ na raka dong sprugs/ thugs rje chen po rgyal po'i lugs sogs gsar rnying ris med kyi dbang lung man ngag gi bdud rdzimang pos thugs rgyud smin cing grol bar mdzad/ gdul bya nye bar gnas pa rnams la sgra snyan sdeb sbyor sogs tha snyad rig pa rnams kyang don gnyer so so'i blo dang 'tshams par tshar lnga drug re ma 'chad pa med pa sogs/ mdor na dam pa 'di nyid kyi sku tshe ril por mkhas

sa thar 151tshul gsum gyis bstan pa'i bya ba rgya chen po mdzad pa'i ngang nas rdzogs pa chen po bya rtsol las 'das pa'i dgongs gamangonadu gyur te 'phags pa'i sa chen po la gnas pa ni rtsod pa med la/ bstan pa yun ring du gnas pa'i phyir sdom phrug dge slong bzhi brgya dang zhe bdun/ dge tshul chig stong nyis brgya go brgyad du longs pa dang /'dul gnung rgya mtsho'i bshad pa dang lag len gyi gces spras bzang po dag sa la spyod pa 'og min a rgyan smin grol gling du tshugs pa'i stobs kyis da lta'i bar snga 'gyur rnying ma pa la mkhan chen zhi 'tsho'i sdom rgyun las rab byung gi sde dang / gzhi gsum gyi phyag len ma nyams pa ni rje 'di nyid gcig pu'i bka' drin du 'khums/gzhan yang bka' gter gsar rnying gi bstan pa'i snying po gsal bar byed pa'i legs bshad kyi bstan bcos tshig snyan la brjod byed phun sum tshogs pa/ lung rigs tshad ma gsum gyi yon to bye bas 'byud pa/ legs bshad rin po che snom pa gsum gyi nyams len gzhung gcig tu dril ba'i bstan bcos 'gran zla bral ba mnga' ris paṇa chen pad+ma dbang rgyal gyi sngom gsum rnam nges la 'grel chen dpag bsam sge ma dang / deng sang snga 'gyur rnying ma pa'i dgon sde che phra yongs kyi phyag len du mdzad pa'i gzhi gsum kyi cho ga dang / 'dul ba'i las chog sogs kyis gces rgyu mtshan nyid theg pa dang / nang rgyud yo ga gsum gyi zab don gsal bar bkral ba dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i spyi don gsang bdag zhal lung

152 sathar dang / 'grel pa gsang bdag dgongs rgyan/ lung a nu yo ga'i mdo dbang chen mo rtsab yan lag dang bcas bi'i dgongs 'grel 'jug bde don tshang du gnang ba'i bka' drin gyis da lta yang mdo rgyud kyi dbang bshad bka' rgyun ma chad par bzhugs pa dang / be+e ro dngos byon gaphro chen chos kyi rgyal po'i zab gter gyi gsang ba zab mo rnams rgyud dkrugs pa bsdebs/ lung bcus pa bsrangs/man ngag gab pa mngon du phyung nas rdo rje'i tshig gis bkrol te zung 'jug gi go 'phang bde blag tu sbyin pa'i smin khrid/ rnam bshad sogs gsung gi cha shas re re'ang mkhas grub chos spyan ldan pa rnams kyis gzigs na ngo mtshar yid ches dang dad spro thob pa'i gnas su gyur pa kho na'o/ /de ltar yang kayag dge rtsemahā paṇ+ḍi ṭha zhal snga nas/ deng sang gi dus gu/ snga 'gyur badzi' ma'i phyogs la bshad sgrub kyi sbo ma nub tsam dang lung gi mtha' rten bar ma chad tsam du thos bsam byar yod pa de ni/dam pa de dag gi bsha' drin las byung bayinapar snga'agyur rjes zhugs da lta dang slad nas 'gru+on par 'gyur pa thams cad kyis shes dgos shing / sku mched de dag gis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos rnams kyang ngo bo'i sgo nas 'phags yul nas bsgyur ba'i sngon gyi slob dpon chen po rnams kyi bstan bcos dang khyad par dmigs su med pas legs bshad kyi che ba'ang mngon sum gyis grub cing / rang lugs bstan pa mun pa ltar mi gsal ba'i skabs su snang byed sgroname sbar bas 'chi ka ma'i bdud

sa thar 153rdziltar gyur pa'i phyir/ kun bzang r+sā 'alo dang / r+sā lo+o sogs rgyal dang rgyal ba'i gsung dang snyer med pas rim gro byed dgos pa'i phyir zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /gsung gi bdud rtsibazhes shing lung rtogs bzhad sgrub kyi lang rlo mchog tu rgyas pa'i slob tshogs kyang sa skya'i bdag chen ngag dbang kun dgazha bkra shis / chab mdo'i 'phags pa lha rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ 'bri gung dkon mchog phrin las bzang po/ stag lung bstan 'dzin srid zhi rnam rgyal/ 'brug chen thams cad mkhyen pa/ sgam po mchog sprul/ mtshur phu'i rgyal tshab tre ho/ lho brag gsung sprul/ thugs sras khyad par rgyal sras pad+ma 'gyur med rgya mablang lcam dral rnams dang / 'od mchog sprul sku/ thang 'brog sprul sku/ bon lung sprul sku/yon tan sprul sku/ khams sprul ngag dbang kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ ras pa sprul sku/ dpal ri sprul sku/ zangs mkhar sprul sku/ da la'i hu thog thu ngag dbang bshad sgrub rgya marlo/ rong pa rdzogs chen pa/ khams rdzogs chen sprul sku gong 'og gnyis/ ka'ig rgyal sras bsod nams lde'u btsan/ khams go 'jo blo bzang yongs 'du dang shes rab 'od zer/ lha ba.oṃ chen po gang shar rang grol/smra bo cog gdung brgyud me rag bla ma sogs skabs de'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes chen phal mo ches zhabs la ma btud pa med pa lta bu bka' srol gyi bstan pa 'dzin nus pa'i bshes gnyen mang du bskrun/ de dag las mched pa'i slob ma yang slob

154 sathar bad+ku lon dang ba.a pa ni sa chen tsho khyon 'di yongs su khebs pa lta bur gyur/gzhan yang chen po'i go sar bzhugs pa'i skyes chen/ lung rigs smra ba'i mkhas pa / nyams myong ldan pa'i grub thob/ dpon chen dang dpon phran sogs mi chen grangs kyis mi lang bas zhabs la gcigs shing gsang gsum gyi dgongs spyod rgya marlo lta bu la mos pa brtan po thob/ de ltar rgyal ba'i gdung lon pa dang /chos kyi mdzod 'dzin pa dang / gdul bya'i lhag ma skyong ba'i mdzad pa rnams re zhig bstul la nye zhing / mchog dman bar mas bsdus pa'i skye dgu thams cad mngon mtho dang nges par legs pa'i lam la bkod pa'i chos kyi phrin las rgya cher bskyangs / mthar dgung grangs drug cu rtsabazhir phebs pa rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i gser 'phyang me bya'i lor bod bstan srid kyi lar rgya mi shes/ phyogs lhung phrag dog gis dug chus phung khams skye mched brtas pa/ 'gro ba mang po ngan song gi g.yar sar gom bstabs 'khyor ba la ji mi snyam pa'i blostobs rdo rje bragaltar sra ba / gzhung lugs gdams par shar zhing grub mtha' thams cad 'gal med du rtogs pa'i glogros kyi mig bsdongs pa bod kyi chos byed ngan dgu tshang ba kha cig gis rgyu byas/ sngar nas mtha' dmag kla klos bod khams za sems kyi sprin nag bdud rlung 'tshub pa'i rkyen byas te/ log smon stobs su gyur pa sog po jun gar ba hor tha'i ji'i dmag dpung gis/ snga 'gyur bstan pa 4na pa'i skyes bu dam pa mang du

sa sa 155dkrongs pa'i dus ngan gyi khug pa long long por shar ba dgung grangs drug cu rtsalnga pa sa khyi hor zla dang po'i tshes nyer bzhi'i thog /lha ldan pho brang chen po'i mdun pad+ma rags gsar gyi thad du spyan drangs te 'o brgyal ba'i gnas su sbyor bar brtsams pa na / ji skad du sdud pa las/ dpa' bo gar spyod shes rab pha rol phyin pa yin/ /khams gsum yang dag 'das las rnalopar grol ba yin/ /nyon mongs bsal bar gyur kyang skye ba ston par byed/ /rga dang na dang 'chi ba med kyang 'chi 'pho ston/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sa thob kyi skyes bu chen po rnams ni sprul bsgyur tshad med pa la dbang 'byor bas skye 'chi rang mtshan pa ye nas mi mnga' bas na/ skad cig la byang chub sems dpa'i smonalayo'abum phrag grangs med bgacigatu bsdus pa'i snying po 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smerbe lam ljags thog tu gsungs te/ mgon po kun gyi drung du bdag mchingo/ zhes pa'i tshig mtshams su zab lam 'pho ba chen po'i mtshams sbyor gyis mkha' spyod pad+ma 'od kyi grong khyer du gshegs shing re zhig gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus pa'i tshul bstan pa na/ gshed ma rnams kyang ci bya cal med kyis yu yu bur gyur te kha skyengs gsogs ngo mtshar ba'i rnamathar matso yas so/ /de ltar smin gling gdung rabs rim byon nas gnam bskos dga' ba brgya ldan gzhung sa dga' ldan pho brang la 'brel zab pa dang / kha tsha dgos ca gasgrigs kyi mdza' bar gnas pa'i mthar thug gi 'bras bu lta bu byung zhing / de'i

156 sathar tshe lo rgyus rnams su sog dmag bod du lhags zer yang / bod ljongs spyi la gnod 'tshe ma byung zhing / bod kyi grwa phyi'i dmag sgar sogs 'khor lo'i sna ga gsos pa rnams gnyid du song ba dang / bod kyi lha sde mi sde thams cad mnyam bsdebs rogs dan ma byung zhing / rang dbang gtsang ma'i rgyal khab tu skad kyang mtha' dmag 'gog srung med par ci bder btang ba bcas kyis/ snga 'gyur bstanapa'i chu 'go spyin gling gi gdan sa la mthong chos myong 'gyur lta bu'i gyong rgud tshabaspoche byung ba'adir da dung blo dang lngan pa rnams kyisacags shing dgrad par 'os so / khartsebs sku yi sha khrag dang / /'cho ba yongs su btang gyur cing / /yan lag nying lag btang ba yis/ /chos tshul rnam par 'phel gyur cig/ //

sa thar 577/ rgyal ba'i sras po 'gyur med yid bzhin legs grugani/ a rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i lung gis bsngags pa ba ro'i rnam 'phrul 'gro 'dul gter 'a chos kyi rgyal po la/ sras gsum dang sras mo gcig ste rigs sras bzhir banugs ༅ gnyis pa ste/ de yang skyed yum za hor rgyal po gtsug lag 'dzin gyi dbon brgyud las mched pa rdo rje phag mo'i rnam 'phrul du lung gis zin r+pāsun tshogs dpal 'dzoms kyi sras su sa mo lug gi lor mkha' spyod bde chen gling du ngo maḍā ba'i ltas dang ba.a te mawo dpe'i dkyil 'khor krod/ sku chung ngu'i dus nas dad pa dang nges 'byung shes rab snying rje sogs theg pa 'a tsho rigs kyi nus pa thams to lhan skyes su mnga'/ 'ag rten mig gcig bya rgod pa mkhas grub chos skyong bzang po'i yang srid 'khrul med du gsal por gyur/ yon to kun gyi gzhi ma 'bri klog nas bzung rig gnas gzhung lugs mang po thugs su chud par mdzad/ khyad par gar thig dbyangs gsum gyis mtshon bka' gter chog khrigs dang bcas pa'i rang lugs phyag bzhed sogs la mkhyen rab phul du gyur/yongs 'dzin dam pa yab rje chos kyi rgyal po dang / khu bo lo chen rnam gnyis las dbang lung zab khrid dang man ngag yongs rdzogs bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan/kun mkhyen sto shrī las bsgen par rdzogs te dge slong gi dngos por grub/'dul mngon phar phyin sogs mdo sngags gzhung lugs rab 'byams la gsan bsam

158 rnamatharasgom gsum mthar phyin par mdzad de sngom brtson gnas lnga smra ba'i mkhas grub chen por gyur/ rigs kyi gcung rin chen rnam rgyal sogs kyis gtsos slob tshogs rnams la mdo sngags rig gnas rnams dang / thun min gter gsar rdor sems sogs kyis mtshoni dbang lung gdams pa du ma stsal ba sogs rlabs chen bstan 'gro'i dpal du gyur kyang / nag phyogs log smon can rnams kyi dbang du song nas re zhig gzugs sku'i bkod pa gzhan don du bsdus so/ /yod med phyogs rer zhen pa'i dmigs gtad zhig /mthar 'odzin lta ba'i 'dzin stangs drung nas phyung / /gzhi lam 'bras bu snang stong zung du 'jug /marlo skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig/ //

rnam thar 159tsha/ sngags rab 'byams pa 'gyur med a rgyan chos gragasani/ g.yoru grwanang pa'i khyim tshang phyug po 'ig gi bu ru 'khrungs/ gter chen rin po ches smin glingathog mar phyag 'debs gnang skabs lnga pa chen po'i bka' dgongs bzhin/ grwa rgul bsdus pa'i gras nas rje 'dis chos sgor zhugs pa mdzad de/ 'bri klog sbyong bdar sogs nas dbu brtsams rgyugs cha gsum pa'i rab gyi blo 'dzinargyugs smrodadang /zhar la gtor bzo gar thig dgrangangacu rol sogs sbyang brtson skabs dang bstunanas mdzad pas/ grwa gzhon mang po'i gral nas yon to gyi rtsemor son/ dgungagrangaX bcu pa tsam nas rang mnyam grwa gzhon mang po dang bcas/ lorānalasadage tshulamye sngom pa nod/ gakho snyo rin po ches rang nyid kyi gcung rgyal sras bstan nyi dang/ lo chenaganyis la phyi mtha' gzigs pa'i ma 'ongs lung bstan du chos grags 'dirang re'i bstan pa la phan mkhan zhig 'ong bar 'dug pas/ khyed gnyis nas 'jilathun mong thun min phyi gzhung rig gnas skor slob ston gang thub gyis zhes phebs pabazhin/gabo ra gter chen rin po che dang lo chen/ mi 'gyur dpal sgron lhan rgyasadang /rdo brag rig 'dzin chen po sogs mabs grub du ma las gsan bsam nan tan mdzad/dgung lo nyer gcig par lo chen rin po ches mkhan po mdzad de/ dge 'dun rgungs tshang ba'i dbus su tshigs gsum rim nod kyis bsnyen par dzo+ogs/ brtanatshakhaX kyi yon tan phul du phyin pas re 'gar sminagling 'dul ba'i sngom rgyun du bzhugs pad

160 sa sayin / 'dul ba phar phyin mngon mdzod sogs kyi bshad khrid gting dpog pa dang /lhag par gter r+sā rin po ches btso ma'i chos sde spyi dang / bye brag sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i dbang gis smin par mdzad/ lo chen las/ gsang ba snying i rgyud kod slob dpon r+sā po'i lta phreng / sangs rgyas gsang ba'i lam rim sogs rgya 'grel dang / sgrol g.yung sa gnyis dang / rong klong sa gnyis sogs bod 'grel du ma la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs bcad/ smin grol gling gi tshogs chen du gsang snying gi bshad rgyugs phul ba na/ tshig don gnyis spu'i cha nas skyon dang dri mas ma gos pa'i legs bshad phun sum tshogs par dam pa rnams kyi yid dbang 'phrogs par gyur/ gter chen sku mched lhan rgyas sas dbyes pa rab kyi rtsemor son te/rdo rje theg pa'i sngags rab 'byams pa zhes pa'i mawo gnas dang bcas rdor 'an mkhan po gnyis kyi go sar dbugs dbyung nas brgyud 'dzin gyi skyes mchog tu gyur/slar yang rgyal sras rin sa rigs chos gnyis kyi brgyud 'dzin rtogs pa don gyi rgyal tshab yin pas de'i mdun nas 'od gsal rdzogs pa 'a po gsang ba snying thig gi rgyud lung man ngag gis gtso bor byas pa'i dbang khrid gdams pa thams to bskyar te rdzogs par gsan/ bar skabs ci rigs par rtsab gsum gyi bsgen sgrub sogs thugs dayonyams bzhes kho na la brtsonapar mdzad pasagrub pa'i rgyal sa mthon por phebs shing don brgyud kyi dgongs pa mngon du gyur/ lhag par lo bco lnga'i ring lo

sathar 16chen mdun nas gsang snying gi bka' khrid yang yang gsan cing /gzhan la 'doms pa'i chos 'chad kyi mkhan po yang mdzad/ gsang snying spyi don ngo mtshar mā chos grags zin bris su grags pa de yang rje 'dis mdzad/sog dmag gis nyer 'tshe skabs smin grol gling skas sa ma thun bar ga'i skyong mdzad pa'i gtso tso na pas bstan pa la bka' drin shin tu che/mdo stod smad yul dbus sogs kyi grwa sa chos rgyun rnams kyis zhabs la ma gtugs pamed pa so so'i gsanayig sdom rgyun rnams su gsal ba ltar mdo sngags rab 'byams chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor bas 'gro don mkha' khyab tu brdal/ de ltar don gnyis lhun grub kyi ngang nas gzugs sku'i bkod pa re zhig gdod ma'i nang dbyengs su bsdus so/ /thugs sras zhal slob kyi tshogs kyang rab 'byums 'gyur med chos ldan/grub dbang shrī na tha sogs don brgyud kyi rtogs pa 'dzin pa'i skyes mchog mang po khams bod kun tu byon pa yin no / /'tshe se 'di sku mched gnyis ka'i zhal slob yin yang brgyud pa rin rnam nas 'byung ba ni gong gsal ltar lung zin bka' babs dbang du byas pa ste/ 'byul zhig sangs rgyas dbon pos gu ru grags pa 'od zer lung zin chos bdag yin pas brgyud pa'i gtso bor bzung ba bzhin yin no/ /gzhan gyis khro dang mardzo sogs nye bar rjeg /gshe dang mtshang 'gru la sogs gnod kun la//dran shes brtan pos gnyen po legs brten nas//rtag tu bzod pa'i go cha bgo bar shag/ //

162 rnamatharatsa/ sngags rab 'byams pa a rgyan dpal mgon nam grub dbang shrī na tha ni/rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa dang sku'i gnyen wo tu 'gro zhing bod yul dbus su ngo mtshar gyi rtags snang bcas bltams/ sku chung dus nas dam pa'i rang bzhin rtsol med du mnga' zhing / 'bri klog sogs tshegs med par mkhyen pas skyes thob kyi shes rab mnga'/ rim bzhin a rgyan smin grol gling gi chos grwa chen por bzhugs / gdan sa der smin gling khri chen mkhan chen rnam gnyis dang / rab 'byams 'gyur med chos lngan dang / gzhan yang dus de tsam na bzhugs pa'i skyes chen mang po'i zhabs la btud de/ smin gling gter gsar skor dang / snga 'gyur bka' ma/ gsang ba snying po'i rgyud bshad/ sdom ṭika dpag bsam sge ma/gsang bdag zhal lung dang / dgongs rgyan sogs gsan bzhes kyis smin grol gling pa'i blo rgyugs thams cad rdzogs par mdzad de sngags kyi rab 'byums pa'imatshan rtags bzhes pas rab 'byams a rgyan dpal mgon zhes mtshan du grags/rten rab byung ngur smrig rdo rje 'an par bzhugs/ rdzogs chen gsang ba snying thig gi rgyud lung man ngag gi gtso bor byas pa'i rig 'dzin gter bdag gling pa yab sras nas brgyud pa thams cad lo mang gi bar sngags ram pa a rgyan chos grags las bum pa gang 'byo'i tshul du rdzogs par gsan/ nyams bzhes kyis gnad du dril bas rtogs pa khyad nga/ra can 'byungs/ sku btsun zhing mkhas btsun bzang gsum

rnam thar 163'dzoms pas stod smad bar gsum gyi grwa sa chos brgyud 'ong ba rnams la bka' drin dang bstan pa spyi la phyag rjes che/ rab 'grums o jos kyi rjes su 'di nyid smin gling rab 'grums kun gyi phul phyin yin/ bcom ldan 'das gzhin rje gshed/bka' brgyad bder 'dus sogs kyi bsnyen sgrub la gzhol zhing bskyed rdzogs kyi gnad la sbyangs pas grub pa'i mtshan ma mngon du gyur te/ yi dam lhag pa'i lhas zhal gzigs nas dngos grub rnam gnyis la bde blag tu spyod pa'i grub pa'i dbang phyug chen por gyur/ grwa phyi nang bsam yas sogs yul dbus phan tshun kun tu byon te/ dpal gsang ba snying po gtso bor mdzad de chos 'khor bskor bas 'gro phan dang phrin las rgya che/ don du bla ma dang lhag pa'i lhas rjes su bzung zhing rig 'dzin gyi sa la bzhugs pa'i grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po zhig yin te/ 'jigs med gling pas/ bcom lngan 'das gshin rje gshed dang / bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i grub thoge/ zhes nas gsang bsnying thig gi dbang lung man ngag sogs zab chos rnams gsan pa yin zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /'di'i phrin las kyi gar+sā 'a rig 'an chen po 'jigs med gling pa la/ rgya bod nges pa'i man ngag zam ma chad pa 'od gsal gsang ba snying thig gi zab chos rnams phul ba de lags te/ nyag bla pad+ma bdud 'dul gyis/ gangs seng ge gcig la seng phrug gcig /de nyung ba'i skyon gyis gos ma myong / /sgo khyi mo gcig la khyi phrug dgu/ /

1sto satharade mang ba'i yon tan ngas ma mthong / /gsungs pa bzhin chal chol gyi slob tshogs khri phrag mang po 'dzomasapa las lhag pa'i 'od gsalasnying po'i bstanasrog la sman nges pa'i 'gro don rgya 'a po byung ba yin no/ /de ltar mdzad pa phrin las mthar phyinarnam skal lnganagyigadul byadapag tu med gango mtshar dad pa'i r+sāl bkod de / re zhig dgongs pa gdod ma'i nang dbyings chen po ga la ba der bsdus so/ /rje de'i rnam thar rgyas pa gang na'ang mi banugs pa lasmyo shas mkhanabo'ajam rdor gyis 'jigs gling rnam thar dang gsan yig /so thar sngom rgyun smin lugs brgyud 'debs rnams dang / ngag sgros khung ldan gyis zur brgyan te rnam thar gsar du bsgrigs gnang mdzad pa las btus pa yin no/ /mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i bsod snyoms zas kyis 'cho/ l+leng drung ci+og bu tsam gyi gnas mal dang / /rnyed sla phyag bdar khrod pa'i ngur smrig gos/ /gzhan gyis spyad zin sman la bsten par shog/ //

/5 thar 165sto/ dpal mkhas pa'i dbang po slob dpon bkra shis rgya mtsho ni/ mdo khams byang rgyud dzochu dang nye bar 'bar chung zhes pa'i rigs su rta lo rgyal zla'i tshes bco lngar 'grungs/ rdzogs sprul rin po ches mtshan pad+ma 'gyur med nam grol zhes rang gi bla ma gter bdag gling pa'i sku skyer gsungs/ dgung lo brgyad nas bzung 'bri klog la sbyang ba mdzad pas tshegs med par mkhyen pa sogs skyes thob kyi shes rab phul du byung / bcu dgu par bla ma /me ye shes la gtsug phud phul ba'i ma 'gyur med bkra shis rgya mtshor btags/ nyer gcig par ru dam rdzogs chen dgon du byon/ rdzogs sprul gnyis pa 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin las mkha' 'gro snying thig gi dbang lung khrid sogs nyams khrid du ma dang /dzo+ogs chen gsang ba snying thig gong 'og gi gdams pa la sbyangs nas sems nyid kyi bdar sha chod/ chos nyid yid dpyod du ma lus par rig stong rjen pa'i ye shes mngon du gyur/ bla slob thugs yid gcig 'dres kyis gdams pa'i gtad rgya sogs gnang zhing grub pa'i sa mthor gshegs/ lho pa khams sprul rin po che ngag dbang kun dga' bstan 'dzin rdza rgyud du phebs pa mjal zhing rab tu byung /rkang rtsa bla ma dar rgyas las mdo dbang chen mo gtad rgya dang bcas pa gsan/gzhan yang smin gling gter gsar zhi khro mkha' 'grerdzo nying thig sogs zab chos mang po gsan/ nyer gsum par yul dbus lha lngan du jo shāka sogs la mchod

166 rnam thara'abul gnas skor du phebs/ rgyal ba skal bzang rgya marlo dang mjal/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal sogs mngal te rgyud dang man ngag mang po rdzogs par gsan/grwa thang mkhan rje drung kun dga' mkhyen brtsephun tshogs las/ rgyal sras rin rnam sogs dang lhan rgyas smin gling gzim chung kun dgazha pho brang du rgyal bka' rin po che'i lung zla ba lnga'i bar gsan cing / phyis khams phyogs kun tu rgya cher spel bar mdzad pas bka' 'gyur pa bkra shis rgya mtsho zhes mtshan chags pa de yin/rin rnam lhan du rgyal dbang lnga pa'i dag snang rgya can dang / smin gling mos skor gsar rnying bka' ma sogs gsan/ lo chen ska ba dpal brtsegs rnam 'phrul smin gling pa don yod dpal bzang las khyim nas khyim med par bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes nas gsum lngan rdo rje 'dzin pa gser gyi ri bo ltar bzhugs / slar khams su phebs te dzorgyud stod smad 'go log sogs lho byang gi yul kun tu rgyal bka' rin po che dang rdzogs chenasnying thig sogs kyi chos 'bor bskor bas 'gro don mkha' mnyam du byung zhing / mdo khams 'dir grub dbang rdzogs chen pa'i rgyun 'dzin mchog gyur du phebs pa yin no/ /rdo rje theg pa'i chas gos rgyan dang rol mo'i rnam bshad sngags 'chang rgyan gyi me tog tu grags pa yang rje 'di nyid kyis mdzad pa yin/ 'di'i sku skye rgyal sras gzhan phan matso yas yin palogong ma'i bag chags kyis rgyal bka' rin po che lhan skyes su gsal ler

rnam thar 67thugs la mnga' bar grags so/ /de dag gi zhal slob yang slob dang bcas pa'i tshogs kyis snying po r+sā gyi bstan pa la bya ba mdzad de da lta'i bar 'dzam gling yangs pa'i khyon 'dir mtha' rgyas su bzhugs pa rig 'dzin gter bdag gling pa'i slob tshogs kyi skor mdor bsdus tsam smyo shul mkhan po'i legs bshad las 'byung ba bzhin bkod pa'o/ /bag yod mthun pa'i rlung gis tshul khrims gzings/ /mngon mtho rin chen gling bgrod thar pa'i nor/ /lhag bsam rgyal mtshon rtsemor yongs bkod nas/ /'gro rnams phan bde'i 'dod dgus tshim byed shag/ //dzad ske

168 /pa tharathā/ mkhan rabs gsum pa mkhan chen / shī ya na'am a rgyan bstan 'dzin rdo rje ni/yab rje rin chen rnam rgyal dang yum tshe dbang dpal 'dzoms gnyis kyi rigs sras gnyis par rnga chen zhes pa chu khyi lor bkra shis pa'i ltas bcas sku 'khrungs/ dad pa dang snying rje sogs dam pa'i ngang tshul lhan skyes su mnga' zhing rgyal mo g.yu sgra'i rnam 'phrul du grags/ dgung lo chung ngu nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che'i sgor nugs nas yab rje dam pa sogs nas dbang lung man ngag zab khrid bum pa gang byo'i tshul du nos zhing thugs rgyud legs par gtams/ sgra snyan rtsis dkar nag sogs thun mong rig gnas spyi dang / 'dul mngon dbu tshad phar phyin sngom gsum ste pod chen drug gi steng rgyud 'grel gsang bdag dgongs rgyan bcas gzhung tshogs de dag thugs 'dzin gnang zhing rigs lam las drangs pa'i bshad sbyangs mthar phyin par mdzad pas mkhyen rab kyi pad+mo bzhad de mkhas pa'i phul du son/dgung lo bco lnga'i thog mdo sngagarnga she gzhung brgya smra ba rab 'byams pa 'gyur med 'phel rgyas las tshigs snga ma dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ gter gsar sogs lhag pa'i lha du ma'i bsgen sgrub mthar phyin par mdzad de mkhas grub chen po'i sa la gshegs/ khyad par dgung lo rnyi ro/ra phebs pa lcags sbrul cho 'phrul zla ba'i gral tshes bco lnga'i nyin dge ba'i bshes gar+sā chos sding pa sngags rngorib 'grams smra ba dharma wa tod dam 'gyur med chos lngan mkhan po mdzad de/ dad pa'i dge

sa sa 69'dun grangs tsha ba'i dbus su bsgen par dzo+ogs pa'i dge slong gi dngos por grurgachi 'dul pha brda 'chad dang lag len kyang mkhas par sbyong brdar mdzad/mos grwa chen po 'di'i chos kyi khri la zhabs pad bkod nas mkhan por mnga' gsol/rgyalabastan rinapo che ā+odagongs pa'i sdom phrug dge slong dang dge tshul bar ma rab byung sogs mang du bsgrubs/ mdor na mkhas btsun bzang po'i rnam thar phul du byung ba 'chang nas gzhan don 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi phrin las rgyas shing rgyal bstan spyi dang bye brag gter chen bla ma'i bstan pa la mdzad pa gong 'phel bskyed/lhag par khams phyogs kyi bstan rgyun la'ang b.lakha drin phyag rjes che bar grags/khyad par gasko'agyur med pad+ma bstan 'dzin ri ye dgongaspodzo+ogasasuphyi sa gi rtenabazhengs bsha' chos 'chad spel sogs mthar chags su mdzad/ rigs kyi dbon rin po che khri chena'agyur med phrin las sa rgyal marja zhadze+ebacas ladabang lung 'chad spel khri 'don sogs mdzad pa mtha' rgyas su grub/ de ltar rlabs wo bstan 'gro'i mdzad pa mthar phyin te re zhig zhi ba r+sā por gshegs so/ /bdag gis sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas/ /nyan thos pha dang ma dang ni/ /drang srong dag la mchod byas pas/ /bstan pa yun ring 'bar gyur cig/ //

170 rgopa tharalto/ mkhan rabs bzhi pa gsang sngags bstan 'dzin ni/ yab rje khri chen 'gyur med pad+ma bstan 'dzin gyi sras su bkra shis pa'i ltas du ma dang bcas te sku bltams / mtshan gsang sngags bstan 'dzin du gsol/ chung dus su sngon gyi bag chags sad pa'i stobs kyis yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa mngon du gyur/phyis bla ma mang du bsten nas rig pa'i gnas thun mong dang thun min mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs mtha' dag la gsan bsam mthar phyin par mdzad/ gzhan yang dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba las bsgen dzo+ogs kyi sdom pa bzhes shing 'dul ba'i lag len rnams dbyes phyin par thugs su chud de rim par mkhan khrir phebs/yul dus ci rigs par dge tshul slong gi snom pa dar spel gnang ba dang / khyad par snga'agyur bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa rin po che gsal bar mdzad pa sogs mdor na gdul bya'i blo dang 'tshams pa'i chos kyi dga' ston rgyun mi chad par stsal bas bstan 'gro'i don rgya cher mdzad nas mthar mkha' spyod zhi ba'i dbyengs su gshegs so/ /bskal ba bye ba du ma/ra bdag /sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong gyur cing / /byang chub don du thos btsal bas/ /bstan pa yun ring 'bar gyur cig/ //

/pa thar 171stso/ mkhan rabs lnga pa a rgyan chos 'phel ni/ khri 'gyur med phrin las rnam rgyal gyi sras su 'khrungs/ khri rabs drug pa 'gyur med pad+ma dbang rgyal dang rje btsun phrin las chos sgron gyi sku mched du gyur/ gzhon nu'i dus nas dam pa'i spyod pa lhan skyes su mnga'/ 'khor ba'i phun tshogs la thugs dgrang ste mkhan chen gsang sngags bstan 'dzin las rab tu byung zhing dge tshul slong gi bslab pa bzhes/ ris med kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang du bsten nas mdo sngags gzhung lugs rnams la gsan bsam gyis mthar phyung / sngom gsum mig 'bras ltar gces par gzung zhing bla dpon mi drag rnams dang 'dris rtog mi mdzad cing 'jig rten chos brgyad la dug gi sdong po ltar gzigs/ gdul bya nye bar gnas pa rnams la mkhan rabs gong ma'i mdzad pa bdag gir bzhes te/ 'dul khrims 'bogs shing skal pa dang 'tshams pa'i chos bstan pa sogs bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la gzhol ba dang / rtag tu dben pa kho nar thugs dgyes shing spong ba bsam gtan gyi 'khor lo la brten pa'i thun dang thun 'tshams kyi rnal 'byor las rim gnyis zung 'jug gi gnas lugs mngon du gyur/ gsang bdag dgongs rgyan gyi bsdus don sa bcad nor bu'i phreng ba sogs bstan bcos dga' zhig kyang mdzad par grags/ mthar rig 'dzin pho mo rnams kyis bsu ba dang bcas mkha' spyod pad+ma 'od kyi zhing khams su gshegs so/ /bsam gtan rnam thar

sa thar 173tsha/ mkhan rabs drug pa dur smrig rgyal mtshan 'chang zhing dam pa'i tshul dgus mdzes pa mkhan wo rig 'dzin bzang po ni/ 7skyabs rje bdud lngoms rin po che'i gsung mkhan brgyud rnam thar kha skong las/ yab yum gyi mtshan kha gsal med kyang smyos rigs su 'khrungs par bzhed/ kha cig chos rgyal rat+na gling yam̐ gdung brgyud du 'khrungs par bshad/ smin gling dkar chag ngo mtshar shel gyi a tī las/ khri rabs drug pa yab rje 'gyur med pad+ma dbang rgyalagyi sras su sku bltams par bzhed/ gang ltar cho 'brang phun sum tshogs par 'khrungs shing /gzhon nu rtsed 'jo la gnas pa'i dus nas kyang dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma las gsan bsam rgya chen po mdzad/ dgung lo nyer gcig par mkhan chen a rgyan bstan 'dzin rdo rje las rab tu byung ste bsnyen par rdzogs/ gzhi gsum gyi phyag len sogs mdo phyogs kyi gsan sbyong bag phye bas kyang zhib pani ji skad du mdo las/ji ltar lo thog thams to sa la ni/ /brten nas skyon med par ni skye ba ltar/ /de bzhin tshul khrims brten nas chos dkar mchog /snying rje'i chus brlan pas ni rnam par skye/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin lung rtogs kyi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa mtha' dag skye ba dang / gnas pa dang / 'phel ba'i rten tshul khrims kyi bslab pa kho nar thugs gzhol ba dang / khyad par rang lugs bka' gter bstan pa rgya mtsho'i smin grol rgyab rten dang bcas pa bum pa gang byo'i tshul du nos/ a rgyan

74 satharasmin grol lding ༷ sdukhan khri la bzhuX skabasdu mdo kams sde dasdo nas 'jam stingaX mardzu ba/'a dbang po ༷༷ ༷ yi gsan bsngis sna dbus phabs skabasdu mkhan pha raX won bzang po 'ad kau kya gtsos dad pa' dgaḍidun graXs tshang ba' mdun nasarda snyan rdzogs sdom pa ༷༷sa pa sogs bstan pa 'asdul rgyas kya sonartsalta bur gyuX ta mkhas ba.oṃ bzang pa' mdzad pa phul du byung sdu yan noshi/ /bdaX sngon sdig pa' sems mā rnams//byaXs pas ༷sal bar smaṭ+wāṃ byas nga /khag pa gsum la rab bkod pas//chos kya mchod sbyan rgyas gyur cag/ //40zhetrī skre

sa thar 175lto/ mkhan rabs bdun pa kun dga' tshul khrims rdo rje ni/ smin gling khri rabs bdun pa khri chen 'gyur med sangs rgyas kun dga'i sras su sku bltams/gsan bsam rgya mtsho'i pha mthar son cing / dgung lo'i dus skabs dang bskun te mkhan chen thub bstan rgyal mtshan las bsnyen par rdzogs nasa.a rgyan smin grole gling gi mkhan khrir phebs/ spyir mdo sngags chos tshul rab 'byams 'chad spelasogs bstan pa la mdzad pa rgya che/ lhag par dgon sde nang gi dge 'dun gsar bus mtshon khams bod phyogs kun nas rang lugs snomargyun donadu gnyer ba rnams la bslab nor gyi rgyun spel bar mdzad pas bstanapa mi nub yun du gnas pa'i btsas su gyur/ 'on kyang mnga' bdag nyang ral pa can gyi rnam thar las kha che paṇa chen shākya shrīs/ khyed yab sras byang chub sems dpa' chen por 'dug pas/ kho bos byang chub sems dpa'i gdung gcod mi nus/ rten 'di kas 'gro don che gsungs nas ma gnang zhes 'byung ba bzhin bakhen khri yid bzhin dbang rgyal gyi gdung brgyud kho du nye ba thugs kyis ma bzod de pad gling bayo pa sa bzang bde r+sā rdo rje la re bskul phul kyang gsan du ma ba.a par brten rje rang sgro bslab pa phul nas khri 'dzin mdzad dgos pa byung ngo / /bdag sngon thabs shes gyur pa na/ /sems mā lta ngan las bsgral zhing / /yang dag lta la bkod byas pas/ /chos ni rnam par 'phel gyur cig/ //

76 sa thar 7/ mkhan 'a lkom dpa.ā+obade ba'i nyi ma'am 'gyur med phan bde 'od zer ni/skobla gter ston rang rig r+sā 'i sku mawo du 'khrungs/ dbu phar/ 'dul mngon/ tshad ma sogs kyi gzhung lugs la gsan sbyangs kyis mkhas pa'i phul du smicing rigayam̐ sas lnga ā+omakha thogs med/smyo shal lung rtogs/bla marang rig kang sprul/ rje masto brtsesogs las mdo sngags spyi dang /sa rgyalagasang bsnying po sogs snga'agyur mdo sgyu sems gsum ā+ogasan sbyangs/btso ma/ gter mang/ smin lugs kyi dbang tso lung khrid sogs rdzogs par gsan nas gad45 ༅ masgo du gyur/ r+sām mgon mi pham rin po che thun minagyirigs bdag tu bsnyen te rdzogs r+sā snying thig 'a mo dang /'jam dpal zhi drag gi rgyud lung man ngag la sbyangs/ dbang gi dkyil 'khor du gsang mtshan 'jam dpal bde ba'i nyi ma zhes gnang nas don gyi rgyud 'dzin du gtad rgya stsal/sgrub pas lha mchog de nyid kyis ye shes kyi skus rjes su bzung zhing / wom dpal dgrangs kyi rigs sngags grub/ rang gnasa.a bse klu mo rab dgon du banugs / gsang snying 'grel chen zur lugs su bkral ba sogs gzhung 'grel mang du brtsams/ nyag stod smad nas lho go 'jo tshun gyi slob tshogs brgya stong mang po la/ r+sā re bzhin gzhung lugs dang / thun min rdzogs wo man ngag skor / tha na sman dang / rtsis rig rmya gyi chos khrid ༅ grangs re gnang ba

sathar 177sogs bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher gnang / gdan sa der rten dang brten pa'i gtsug lag khang ngo mtshar sprul pa'i lha khang du grags pa dang / gzhan yang sku gsung thugs rten mtha' yas pa bzhengs/ bshad grwagasar 'dzugs sogs bya ba las kyi 'khor lo rgya che/ barma lon rig 'an klong gsal snying tsho skye matso rang dbon mchog sprul chos rdor dang / sras mo kun bzang chos sgron/ mchog sprul pad+ma sa rgyal dang sprul sku.a ngag rin po che sogs byon/ de dag gi tsha bo yang tsha zhal slob sogs mkhan slob mchosasprulamang po r+sāsteng gang btsam khams klu mo rab gdan sar byon nas bstan pa dar rgyas byung ba dang / khyad par gter bdag gling pa gshegs khar da ste shar phyogs su gom pa bdun 'gro dgos pa yod ces/ma 'ongs par khri rabs bdunagyi rjes shar phyogs nas gdung chos kyi brgyud pa gso bar lung bstan gnang don banin/ bod gnung sa skyabs mgon thub bstan rgya ma྾ bkas gan po gasto snyo rang rig rin po che smin gling gdung rigs gso bar gdan zhus bzhin rang mched dang lhan cig smin gling du byon/ der bka' gter spyi dang smin lugs kyi dbang khrid gdams pa/ rgyud bshad rdzogs chen sogs 'jam mgon rnam gsum nas brgyud pa mtha' dag gi chos 'bor mdzad pas dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi gdul bya dpag tu med pa 'dus te smin gling gdan sa'i srog mthud du gyur/ gdan sa der thugs sras gtso bo rang dbon mkhan

178 sa sa gcung sa gnyis dang / skyabs rje bdud 'joms rin po che sogs phebs nas bstan pa'i rtsalag dam par gyur/ skyabs rje bdud lngoms rin po ches so byang sngags gsum gyi brgyud pa phalacher 'di las 'dren par mdzad cing / ba/'a drin che ba'i bla ma rnams gsum gyi nang tshan yin/ mthar rang yul khams nyag rong du byonachug don gnyis lhunagrub kyi ngang gzugs sku dgengs su bsdusapar snyigs ma'i gdung khru gang tsam du gyur/ sa g.yo ba dang me tog gi char/ 'ja' 'od kyi drwa ba sogs gdul bya rnams ngo mtshar dad pa'i gnas la bkod par mdzad do/ /ngan song gnas gsum sdug bsngal drag pos mnar/ khaṃ dang 'dod lha 'gyur ba'i duḥkhas gzir/ /gzugs dang gzugs med 'du byed 'ching bas bcings/ /'khor ba'i rang mtshang mngon sum mthong bar shog/ // ci ci ci

sa go 1797/ rdor 'dzin mkhan po ngag dbang nor bu ni/ g.yo ru grwa'i phyogs su sku 'khrungs / gzhon nu'i dus nas smin grol gling gi grwa sar bzhugs te 'bri klog nas brtsams thunamong gi sang sgrig slob gnyer cho gachos spyod blor 'dzin gan thig dgrangs rol gtor bzo sogs kyis mtshon dgon sde'i phyag len che phra gang la'ang mkhas pa'i rtser son te bstan pa'i mig yo du gyur/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gzhung smin grol bskyed rdzogs zab gnad la thos bsam sgom gsum gyi rtsal rdzogs/lhag par mkhan chen tshul khrims rdo rje gtso bor gyur pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams las sdom pa gsum gyi bdud rtsis thugs rgyud gtams/ mdo sngags gnyis kyi gzhung dang ba/kha gter man ngag las khrigs kyi skor la mkhas pa'i phul du phyin/ dus skabs ci rigs par slob tshogs rnams la gsang snying gi bshad pa khyab brdal du gnang ba sogs smin grol gyi chos sgo yangs por phyes/ tshoges chen gyi byang 'dren bgrang bya bcu phrag lhag pa mdzad cing / de nas rdor 'dzin mkhan po'i go sar phebs te a rgyan smin grol gling gi 'dus sdes mtshon snga 'gyur chos sde rnams su mdo sngags kyi phyag bzhes gtsang ma rang lugs ma nyams pa'i rgyun bskyangs par mdzad do/ /ye shes don du bdag gis sngon/ /dka' thub nags dag bsten byas shing / /bstan bcos du mar nyer bsten pas/ /bdag gi bstan pa 'bar gyur cig/ //

180 rnam tharatsa/ mkhan rabs brgyad pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse'i nor bu ni/ yab rje khri tshab pad+ma dbang chen dang / yum khri yid bzhin dbang rgyal gyi sras mo bag gro lags sam 'chi med bde ldanasgrol ma rnam gnyis kyi sras su rab tshes shing sbrul lor smin grol gling du sku bltams/ sku tshad rdzogs pa dang 'bri klog nas bzung lha bris dang /gso ba rig pa sogs thun mong rig gnas spyi dang / smin grol gling gi 'don chos phyag bzhes rnams rdor 'dzin bgres gzhon rnams kyi mdun nas gsan sbyong dpyis phyin par mdzad/ khyad par rdor 'dzin ngag dbang nor bu'i mdun nas bsnyen par rdzogs shing sku yon phal cher thugs rdzogs su bzhes te/ bslab pa'i gnas mtha' dag la thabs mkhas kyi sgo nas nyes pas ma gos par mdzad/ mkhan po nyid las snga phyir bka' gter thig tshoni gyi bya ba spyi dang / mdo sngags kyi chos tshul mtha' yas pa gsan/ khyad par khu bo mkhan chen 'jam dpal bde ba'i nyi ma'i mdun nas bka' gter gnyis kyi dbang lung dang / rdzogs pa chen po'i chos skor phal mo che gsan nas khong rnam gnyis rtsaba'i bla mar bzung / nyag rong klu rab dgon nas bstan pa'i bdag por gdan zhus 'byor bar zhabs bskyod de bstan pa 'dzin skyong dang / nyag khog dgon sde mang po'i dge 'dun rnams la bslab snom 'bogs pa dang / ser skya mang po dbang khrid kyis re 'dod bskang ba bcas bstan 'gro'i mdzad pa bla na med pa bskyangs/ bar skabs de phyogs rgya jag gis 'tshe

sa sa 181bas bzhugs sos bde min byung rkyen go 'jo khul du phebs/ smin gling dgon lag rtse rong brag nag dgon du zla ba mang po bzhugs nas dgon pa'i sgrig dang /cho ga phyag bzhes/ dus mchod khag gi gar 'chams bcas ma dgon smin grol gling bzhin dag ther mdzad/ de ga'i dge 'dun rnams dang yul mi bcas so so'i 'dod chos kyis re ba ji lta bar bskang / brag dgon 'dus pa'i sder smin gter rdzogs r+ṣa a ti zab don snying i dbang dang khrid lung bas stsal/ de rjes bar bar zlashasda tsam phyogs phebs gnang dgos rigs ma gtogs mkho khyim dgon du lo ྅rngo gsum tsam rgyun bzhugs mdzod/ dgon par gzigs bskyangs dang smin lugs phyag bzhes la 'gal 'dzol byung rigs dag bcos dang / dge 'dun gsar zhugs rnams la rab byung bsnyen rdzogs gnang / sa ngan go 'jo phu mda'i dgon khag gi bla sprul dge 'dun rnams dang / khyim pa bcas sems khrid zhu mi nyinare mi grangs wu skor las mi nyung bar sems sgro chos skur rtogs pa'i ngo sprod rgyun du stsal/ bka' las/ go 'jo ba skya ser thams cad kyis sems khrid sems khrid ces lab mi mang bas/ 'di yang yul 'di'i chos skal zhig 'dra bsams nas gnang rkyang byed kyin yod ces phebs par thos/ mkho dgon bla sprul 'dus yongs dang / rgya ra dgon gyi bla ma dge 'dun yongs rdzogs de bzhin go 'jo phu mda'i dgon khag gi dge 'dun/ mi dmangs bcas chos zhu ba mdun

182 rnamathar brgya skor la snga 'gyur bka' ma'i dbang bka' yongs rdzogs stsal/ gter sras 'chi med rin po che mdun nas bdud 'dul gakho chos yongs rdzogs kyi dbang lung gsan / smin grol gling du zhe chen rab 'byams sku phreng drug pa'i mdun rin r+sā gter mdzod kyi bga' dbang lan gcig gsan/ 'brug nas gter chen rdor gling gdung phrengarje ye shes seṅge ched du gdan nas rdor gling chogaskor yongs rdzogs gsan rnayomiring bar sminagling dge 'dun rnams dang phyogs 'dus bla sprul rnams la slar stsal / de bzhin rje gter snyo bla ma'i bka' 'bum gyi lung yang stsal/ go lngo kha legasasprul sku pad+ma kun grol mdun nas 'jam dgon mi pham rin po che'i bgazha 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung gsan/ zhe chen kong sprul rin po che'i mdun nas zhe chen rgyal tshab kyi bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung gsan/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtserin po che mdun nas snying thig ya bzhi'i dbang khrid lung bams gsan pa sogs gsan bsam dang nyams bzhes mdzad pa shin tu rgya che bas smos par ma langs / mdor na de skabs khams dbus kyi bla chen dang mkhan chen su dang mjal 'phrad mdzad na'ang mkhyen rtogs phul du phyin pas thugs yid 'phrog te zab lam gyi gdams pa mang po gsan res ma mdzad pa med/ mkho khyim dgon du bzhugs pa'i skabs shig sbyin bdag zhal slob khang gsar a rgya bla ma zhu ba zhig gis gri zhig khyer 'ong nas/ nang gi dad rten du gri 'di la mdud pa zhig skyon rogs zhes u nan gyis

rnam thar 183zhu ba phul bar zhal bzhes ma gnang / bla ma tha/ tshugs che bas gcung sprul sku pad rnam gyis a rgya bla ma nasa'adi ltar u tshugs zhu bar snying rje ba 'dug /khyed kyis mdud pa mabaskyon na ngas rgyag gas zhus pas nu ngo ma lngog par mdud pa bskyon pa da lta kho pa tsho'i nang la yod/ a rgya bla ma nas tha/ nan chen pos zhus pa'i bshags par ba/kha 'gyur tshar gcig dag sgrogs zhus pa khul der yongs grags yin/yang rtserong brag nag dgon du dbang sgrub gnang nyere skabs dung chos de tshur bzhes nas sib smyug snag tsha med pas dung chos steng phyag bris gnang ba/ yi ge lanyu'i gzugs kyi ma ṇi 'bur dod byung ba da lta brag nag dgon par dbang po'i spyod yul du yod / dus dbang gis bstan pa nyag phra ba thugs la brnags pas/ smin gling gdung sras rnam gnyis/ rdor brag rig 'dzin chen po/ rgyas sras rin po che/lha lung gsung sprul lding che lcog gra rin po che sogs phyogs mtha'i bla sprul mang po dang / smin grol gling gi dge 'dun bgres gzhon bzhi bcu skor lasdom gsum rnam nges/ gsang snying dgongs rgyan dang spyi don zhal lung sogs sgyu 'phrul gyi 'grel pa 'dra min dang / mdo sngags gzhung lugs gang rigs kyi chos thun re dus 'gyur ma byung bar nyin ltar chag med stsal bar/ 'jam dgrangs mkhyen brtserdo rje 'chang gis smin grol gling du ya bzhi'i bsha' chos mjug tu bsngags brjod chen po gnang / de bzhin rnyed bkur gyi dngos po rnams skabs skabs grwa tshang la mang ja/

84 satharanyin 'khyongs/ mchod rdzas rigs 'bul sbyor gnang ba sogs sa dkar gyi mdzad rlabs gzhan 'gran bral/stag lung rtsespru.ā+orin po che bshad sgrub nyin byed phrin las dpal bzang mchog dang / zhwa di'u 'byul zhig rin po che/ mkho sprul rin po che mdo d+ku rgya marlo sogs bstan pa lonapa'i bzhes gaskoslob tshogasamang du byung / gdul bya skal ba dang lngan pa rnams kyi ngor gsang snying rgyud kyispyi don mdzod kyi lde'u mig la mchan 'grel bkod pa dang /gdams ngag tshig don bzang tsho rdo rje'i mgur glu ngo ma' gnad don dril rgapusnyi gasmo su longar+sāpa banugs/lho kha khul du lha rje dkon stabs gsol sman nu bcar ba chen por ngo srung dang /nyams chung la khyad gsod gnang srol med pa la brten nas/dus 'gyur skabs su rgya mi'i las rogs pa 'dod don sgrub mkhan rnams nas snyad 'dogs nu yul ma brnyed pas/ rgya nag dpon rigs sas kyis kyang mdzad pa ā+obasngags brjod kyis lho kha o thang krang chus chos donadabusayonagyi mtshanagasto 'buladagospobyung ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa mang du mnga'/ mthar dgung grangs drug cu re bzhi phebs pa phyi lo 96rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa pho sprelagyi lo sa zla'i gasto stong nyin gzugs sku bkod pa re zhig bsdus pa'i tshul bstan to//'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu//bde ba thams to 'byung ba'i gnas//bstan pa rnyed dang bkur snyi dang //ba.a te yun ring gnas gyur snyo/ //

rnamathar 1857/ be+e ro dngos snang smin gling bcung rin po che ngag dbang chos grags ni/yab khri tshab pad+ma dbang chen nam 'gyur med kun dga' bstan 'dzin dang / yum khri rabs brgyad pa 'gyur med yid bzhin dbang rgyal gyi sras mo tha chung 'chi med bde ldan sgrol ma gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bco lnga pa'i sa sprel 19yo lor smin grol gling du sku 'khrungs/ dam pa 'di dang khri 'gyur med don grub dbang rgyal/pad rnam rin po che/ mkhan chen ngag dbang mkhyen brtsenor bu rnams yab gcig par brten da lta'i khri rin po che'i khu bo dang / yang pad rnam rin po che/ rje btsun tshe dbang lha mo'am sangs rgyas chos sgron/ ma yum bde chen dbang mo rnams ni gcung rin po che dang yum gcig par song rje btsun dang ma yum ni da lta'i khri rin po che'i a ne+er phebs pa yin no/ /gang ltar bcung rin po che 'di gzhon nu nyid nas khams dbus kyi bshes gnyen mang po tshul bzhin bsden nas smin grol man ngag rgya marlo lta bur gsan bsam sgom gsum mdzad/ dgung lo nyer gcig pari rdor 'dzin mkhan chen ngag dbang nor bu las bsnyen par rdzogs te 'dul ba'i kun spyod gtsang ma la rtag tu thugs gatshe la/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum dang / nyams rtogs kyi dasongs pa 'i ce la ma/the 'ing bar skabs sku'i gasko khri rabs bcu pa 'gyur med jon grub dbang rgyal gyi gdung sras sku na sro bas smi na gling khri tshab mdzad de/bar lam smi na grel gling bi bstan pa nyapas chag byung ba rnam sa slar gso mdzad cing

186 rnamatharalha khang dang rten gsum bzhengs pa dang / dge 'dun zhal grangs ldab spar mdzad pa dang b.lakha gter dbang lung gi rgyun tshugs pa dang 'dul ba'i sdom rgyun spel ba sogs bstanapa spyi dang khyad par snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa ldomadzad rjes lhag par che/ deng dus 'dir yang snga 'gyur bstan pa'i mig rgyan du a rgyan smin grol gling pa'i srolargyun ma nyams par bzhugs pa yang rje de nyid kyi bka' drin lags/mthar rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags sprel 1980 lor lha ldan 'phrul snang gi gtsunalagakhang gi nub byang 'jam dgrangs shar du mgo zla'i tshes gnyis nyinare zhig sku gshegasapa'i tshul bstanaskabs ngo mtshar kunayid 'phrog pa'i mtshan lobyung ba ni gang nyid bzhugs yul gyi khor yug tu gnas pa'i skye bo rnams dang lhag par gam bcar ba rnams kyi 'dren byed kyi yul du mngon sum grub pa lags so/ /mkhan slob dge ba'i bshes la mchog tu dad/ /tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod la gcig tu gus / k+ṣe snod lung la rab sbyangs bslab pa gsum/ /mngon par rtogs pas bdag rgyud phyug par shog/ //

rnamayo 1877/ 7skyabs rje zhwa di'u 'byul zhig rin po che ngag dbang chos kyi blo gros ni/yar 'brog gi khul du sku 'byungs/ chung dus nas dam pa mang pos ye shes kyi gzigs pas rje gong ma gter chen 'khrul zhig mdo sngags gling pa'i yang srid du gser khri rin po cher mnga' gsol/ yongs lodzan bshes gnyen du ma las brda dag nas bzung dbu ma/ sher phyin/ 'dul ba/ mngon pa sogs mdo sngags rig pa'i gnas logasan sbyangs rgya cher gnang / smin gling gcung 'gyur med chos kyi gragasapa las mkhan chenazhi 'tsho'i sdom rgyun gyis bsgenaparardzogs sku shinatu btsun zhing / phyis dus 'dir sngom brtson sde snod 'dzin pa thams cad kyi gtsug gi rgyan du gyur/ smin gling mkhan chen las dpal gsang ba snying po'i rgyud 'grel sogs rdo rje theg pa'i gnung gdams ngag mang du gsan/ 7skyabs rje bdud 'joms rin po che las rin chen gter mdzod dang / rnying ma bga' ma sogs dang /rang gang rdo rje phur paspu gri regaphung sogs mo gasto rnams gsan nas de'i chos bdag tu lung gis bsngags/ 7skyabs rje mkhyen brtserin po che las rgyal bka' rin po che dang / gdams ngag mdzod sogs smin grol rgya marlo lta bu gsan bzhes kyis thugs yid gcig 'adz+res kyis rang gter pad+ma tshe'i snying thig gi rtsaba'i chos bdag tu'ang lung gis bsngags te gter chos thams cad dzo+ogs par gsan/khyad par du thun min rigs bdag gangs ri thod dkar du nākhri rig 'dzin chos nyid
