188 rnamatharabazang mo las 'od gsal gsang ba snying thig dang / rdzogs chen yang ti nag po/mkha' lding gshog rlabs sogs rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i chos tshulamatha' dag gsan nas rtogs pa don gyi brgyud 'dzin chen por gyur/ dus kyi 'pho 'gyur skabs bal po'i sbas yul shar khum bu thub bstan mdo sngags chos gling rten dang brten pa bcas gsar du bzhengs nas gdan sa gtso bore mdzad/ rab sngags sogs dge 'dun gyi sde mang por snga 'gyur bka' ma dang / rin chen gter mdzod chen po'i smin grol sogs kyi chos 'khor dang / rdzogs chen yang ti nag po sogs kyi dbang khrid gdams ngag mang du gnang / gzhan yang rgya bal/ 'bras 'grug sogs phyogs kun tu dge tshul slong gi sdom rgyun gnang ste dam chos 'dul ba rin po che'i bstan pa la bya ba bla lhag tu mdzad/ gsung rtsom gyi tshoges kyang rdzogs chen yang ti nag po sogs kyi dbang dang chog sgrig /khrid yig sogs man ngag yig cha mang du bzhugs/ khyad par bzhugs sgar ghā ram sa lar 7skyabs mgon rgyal ba'i dbang po mchog gi mdun lo lngar ched bskyod kyis/ snga 'gyur bka' gter rgyud lung man ngag bi zab chos bdud rtsi lta bu chos sprin du phul bar mdzad pas/rig 'dzin gong ma rnams dang 7rgyal ba'i dbang po sku phreng rim byon nyi zla zung 'brel lta bu/ dam tshis lar rgya'i mdud pa nag phyogs bdud rigs rnams kyis bzhig tu med pa ra thugs snang gcig 'dres kyi rgyun ma nub pa ra bzhugs pa sogs rnam

rnam thar 189dkar gyi mdzad pa mtha' yas 3nga / da ltar lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba kun gyi mgon skyabs dpung gnyen dam par 'tsho zhing gzhes la/ slad mar yang sku tshe bskal ba rgya mtshore bzhugs shing mdzad phrin nam mkha'i khyon la dbang sgyur ba dang /thugs kyi bzhed don mtha' dag lhun gyis 'grub par rtsagasum lha tshogs rnams la gsol ba rtsebaṇig tu 'debs pa lags so/ /mdo sngags chos tshul tshang la ma nor ba/ /mkhas shing grub bsnyes rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i srol/ khrib bstan snying po gsang sngags snga 'gyur ba'i/ /bstan pa 'phel rgyas 'dzam gling khyab gyur cig/snyo

190 rnamathar tsa/ mkhan rabs dgu pa bstan pa rin po che'i gsal byed dam par gyur pa mkhan chen ngag dbang mkhyen rab rgya mtsho ni/ cho rigs mdo khams sa ngan dang 'dabs sbyar go 'jo ta ra tshang a drung ru pa'i mi brgyud gong ma bkur lugs/'og ma skyong lugs/ mnyam por ga'abs lugs sogs lha chos mi chos kyis phyug pa/ dgra mgo yan par mi gtong zhing gnyen la nang gzhin zab pa pho rgod btsan phrug lta bu mang du byung ba las/ mes po gdugs dkar gyi brgyud du lcam dral ming sring gnyis shig byung ba'i ming po yab nyi ma dgra 'dul dang / 'brangs brgyud gcung rin po che ngag dbang chos grags dang yum gcig pa 'od gsal lha las mched cing kha ragasmyos kyi gdung brgyud du gtogs bam yum bde chen dbang mo gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags khyi mchu zla'i tshes bco lnga spyi lo 1970 zla dang po'i tshes lngar lho kha'i brgyud spro khang gling ka'i skyed tshal du sku 'khrungs / me 'grug 1976 lo nas bzung khro ru mkhan rin po che tshe rnam sku mdun nas yi ge 'bri klog dang sman gzhung la slob sbyong mdzad/ sa rta 1978lor dus gsum mkhyen pa lha thog rin po ches smin gling mkhan rabs brgyad pa'i sprul par ngos 'dzin gnang / chu phag 1983 lor skyabs rje mkho khyim rin po che'i sku mdun nas sum rtags sogs thun mong rig pa'i gnas spyi dang khyad par smin grol gling gi cho ga dang phyag bzhes sogs la slob gnyer lo bzhir gnang ba dang 'brel/

rnam thar 191me yos 1987 lor rgyal ba rin po che'i b.lakha bzhin bzhugs sgar dha rasma lar 7gong sa mchog dang lhan du 7skyabs rje dil 'go mkhyen brtserin po che'i sku mdun nas sgyu 'phrul gsang ba snying po'i chos skor yongs rdzogs gsan/ 7rgyal ba rin po che mchog gi sku mdun nas kyang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chen yongs rdzogs nod/ me stag 19sko6 lo nas bzung rnying ma'i bshad grwa chen por zhugs te 'dul ba mngon pa sher phyin dbu ma tshad ma sogs la slob gnyer gnang ba dang /7skyabs rje grub dbang pad nor rin po che las bka' gter gyi tshoms chen po gnyis dang / bla ma dgongs 'dus/ dpal sprul 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po'i gsung 'bum/ kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i gsung thor bu'i skor dang gnam chos kyi dbang lung bcas thob/ sa 'brug 1988 lor bshad grwa'i dbyar kha'i gung seng skabs bal yul du 7skyabs rje mkhyen brtserin po che'i sku mdun nas khrid yig ye shes bla ma sogs rdzogs pa chen po'i chos skor du ma gsan/ lcags rta 1990 lor 7skyabs rje mkhyen brtserin po che dang 7skyabs rje mkho sprul rin po che rnam gnyis kyi bga' bzhin 'khrul zhig rin po che'i sku mdun nas dge slong gi sdom pa snang de/ lo ltar bcom lngan 'das kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i dus bzang po dang bstun dge 'dun brgya phrag brgal bar rab byung gi sdom pa spel bzhin pa dang /lcags lug 1991 lor skyabs rje mkhyen brtserin po che'i sku gshegs rjes

192 rnamathar 7skyabs rje smin gling khri rin po che'i sku mdun nas kyang skyar rdzogs pa chen po'i chos skor du ma gsan/ chu sprel 1992 nas bzung smin grol gling gi bshad grwa chen po la chos khrid gnang mgo brtsams/ de dang dus mtshungs nyi hong sogs la bod kyi nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs kyi gzhung rnams slob khrid gnang bar 'dzam gling mi rigs mang pos dga' gus tshad med zhus/ chu bya 1993 lor bal yul du a rgyan sprul sku tshe dbang dpal 'bar rin po che'i sku mdun nas sems khrid kyi chos skor du ma gsan/ shing khyi 1994 lor rnying ma'i dgon sde khag nas re bskul nus pa bzhin rnying ma'i smon lam tshogs chen gyi tshogs gtso gzhon pa'i las 'gan ba'es te phyag las gnang bzhin pa ma tshad lo ltar zla ba gsum bzhi la sku mtshams bcad rgya bzhugs mus dang / rab rgyal me glang 1947 lor 7skyabs rje stag lung rtsesprul rin po che bshad sgrub nyin byed phrin las bzang po mchog a rgyan smin grol gling du zhabs sor 'khong pa'i drung / snga 'gyur rnying ma bka' ma'i dbang lung zab rgyas nus/ lcags 'brug 2002 lor 7skyabs mchog zhwa de'u 'khrul zhig rin po che ngag dbang chos kyi blo gros las thugs rje chen po bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi dbang bskur dang / bka' srung gi srog gtad rnams thob pa bcas chos dang 'brel ba'i phrin las rgya chen po gnang ste sku 'tsho zhing gzhes la/ zhang rin po che 7skyabs rje smin gling khri chen mchog dang / 7skyabs rje mkho sprul rin po che rnam

gsum thugasabaskyedarmadadubyungaba'i~Xṭ+wāṃdīsakyis/ dengagi'i.ebhergyanaṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ grol gling gi dgon pa dang bshad grwa sgrub grwa bcas par yi+on yongs dge 'dun pa grangs lnga brgya nye bar bshad sgrub thos bsam gyi bya bas dus 'da' ba sogs bstan 'gro'i gsos sman du bzhugs shing/ slad du'ang gsang gsum nyer 'tsho med par bstan 'gro'i don chen rgyun mi 'chad pa 'byung bar smon no/ /'og min sa la spyod pa a rgyan zhing / /smin grol lam mchog rnga yab gling pa'i srol/ /nges don rdo rje snying po'i dga' tshal che/ /srid mtha'i bar du mi nyams 'phel rgyas shag/ //

194 mjugabyangaslar smras pa/tsa/ nges 'byung gser gyi sa gzhi brdal ba la/ /skyo shas chu gter rlabs kyis bsrubs pa'i mod/ /'phags nor gser ri'i 'phreng bas khor yug mdzes/ /tshuspya khrimyus bslab pas bdag rgyud gtam par shag /g.yeng med n+ya gro dha'i rtsa ba brtan/ /dga' bde'i lo 'dab yol gor 'khyil gyur cing / khren sbyangs 'bras bzang g.yur du za ba'i dpal/ /ti5 'phyon bslab pas bdag rgyud phyug par shag /kun rtog chu 'dzin stug po'i smag rum kun/ /rnam dgrod dri gzhon gsar pas bud cing bskrad/ /mun sel nyi zla'i snang ba 'char byed pa/ kheswā rabu bslab pas bdag rgyud grol gyur cig /gzhung lugs grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i mching rnam cher/ /rnam dpyod lung rigs gru bzang rlung shugs rtsen/ /legs bshad nor bzang zong sis dga' ston 'gyed/ /'anād la zla med dbyeg gnyen mnyam gyur cig /ma nor lam phyogs zung 'jug garnyi'i sgras/ /lha mi dga' ba'i dga' ston spel mkhas shing / /skal dman mu stegs rna bar zan pa'i gshed//rtsod+ma mdzad chos kyi grags pa mtshungs gyur cig /rgyal bstan sum rtsen lha yi khang bzang ngogs/ /rnam/ ma/nga gzhung lugs dbang po'i snang brnyan bkra/ /skal lngan 'chi med tshogs kyi 'dod rga'i gter/ /rtsomyu mkhas dpa' bo gnyis par nyid gyur cig /phyi snod dag pa zhing dang gzhal med khang / /nang bcud dag pa lha

mjugabyang 195tshogs rdul sged bzhin/ /sems rgyud dag pa ye shes rgya mtshos brgyan/ /thabyās mchog bde ba chen po'i bkra shis shag /yod med mtha' bral gsang ba mchog gi gnas/ /ngo bo nyid med rdzas btags yul las 'das/ /ming tshig ma grub rnam thar gsum gyi dbyengs/ shesu rab stong nyid zab mos bkra shis shog /bka' gter ring lugs dri med yan lag brgyad lngan 'i/ /chu bo yongs rdzogs 'og min gnyis pa'i rdzing ring ngogs/ /gdan rarbas mkhan brgyud pad+ma'i 'phreng ba lan tshar can/ /las can skye rgu'i mgul du spud la cis mi 'tshengs rab dkar legs spyad kha 'bab klung gi rgyun bzang po/ /lhag bsam ma dros gdengs can bdag po'i mthu dpal gyis/ /dus gsum dge tshogs dgrar gyi nyal 'akro dang 'grogs te/ /dpag med rnam mkhyen chu gter nyid dang 'dres gyur cig /sangs ljongs ris med shing rta rin chen che brgyad kyi/ /lung rtogs chos 'khor rtsibs stong 'bar bas phyogs kun tu/ /mthar 'dzin ngan goms sha ra na tshogs skrag byed cing / /phun tshogs thar pa'i dga' tshal bzang por bgrod gyur cig /de ltar 'og min a rgyan smin grol gling gi gdan rabs mkhan brgyud rnams kyitsho rnam par thar pa dpal g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i dga' sto na zhes bya ba 'di ni/ bstan pa rin po che'i gsal byed dam par gyur pa don gyi sladadu mtshan nas smros na 7mkhan sprul ngag dbang mkhyen rab rgya mtsho mchog dang /

196 mjug byang7gsang i bstan pa'i sgron me 7skyabs rje mkho sprul rin po che mdo rgyud rgya maspya sa gnyis kyi bka' lung spyi bo'i rgyan du babs pa las/ rtsom sgrig tshogs gtso sprul sku thub bstan brtson 'grus sam grags pa rgyal mtshan mchog gi bkod khyab 'og /dngos kyi phyag las pa slob dpon 'gyur med kun bzang bstan rgyas/ slob dpon pad+ma rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon shes rab 'gyur med/ slob dpon 'gyur med theg mchog rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon 'gyur me da ye shes phun tshogs bcas 'dul 'dzin btsun pa rnam lngas mtshams sbyar zhing / dpal ldan 'grug yul gyi btsun pa 'gyur med mtha' yas dang 'gyur med bstan pa rab rgyas gnyis nas 'phrul yig phab bsgyur mdzad pa bcas/ sna tshoges zhes pa chu pho rta'i lo sa zla'i tshes bco lnga nas mkhas blun/ kun gyi gzigs bde bklag chog tu bsgrigs shing nus bcos thog/ sprel zla'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes bcu slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pa lho nub 'o ma can gyi marlo gling du sku 'khrungs shing gnas gsum gyi da ge' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams tshogs 'khor dga' ston gyi 'du ba la longs su spyod pa'i dus tshes phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin / snga dro nyi ma rtseshar la mjurga/ rdzogs par bgyis pa ste mnyam med zas gtsang sras po'i ring lugs sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad kyi bstan mya 'dzam gling yul phu+o+ogs kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas shing / bstan lon gyi skyes bu r+sā po 7gong sa lha mi'i rnam 'dren mchog gi dbus ris med bla sprul rnams kyi sku tshe

brtan cing mdzad 'phrin phyogs brgyar 'phel ba dang / rang cag rnams kyi me tog gang la phog pa'i lha skal smin gling gdan rabs kyi 'phreng ba rin po che gang dag mtha' ya/sa pa'i gdul bya rnams kyitsho ngor slad du'ang zam ma chad par 'byon zhing / mi 'jigs chos kyitsho khri la dbang 'byu+or ba'i sgo nas kun bzang thugs kyi bstan pa mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan du gyur cig/ /dge'o/ /bkra shis// //
